  WL.ReleaseCheckMatrix = {
    definitionFor(gateId) {
      for (let i = 0; i < WL.RELEASECHECK_GATE_DEFINITIONS.length; i++) if (WL.RELEASECHECK_GATE_DEFINITIONS[i].gateId === gateId) return WL.RELEASECHECK_GATE_DEFINITIONS[i];
      return { gateId:gateId || 'G??', gateName:'Unknown Gate', ownerModule:'unknown', severity:'high', requiredAction:'Define this gate before proceeding.' };
    },
    line(gateId, status, message, relatedFailureIds, requiredAction, extra) {
      const def = this.definitionFor(gateId);
      return Object.assign({
        gateId:def.gateId,
        gateName:def.gateName,
        status:status || 'PASS',
        severity:def.severity,
        message:WL.U.norm(message || def.gateName),
        ownerModule:def.ownerModule,
        relatedFailureIds:Array.isArray(relatedFailureIds) ? relatedFailureIds : (relatedFailureIds ? [String(relatedFailureIds)] : []),
        requiredAction:requiredAction || def.requiredAction
      }, extra || {});
    },
    resultFromLines(lines) {
      let result = 'PASS';
      for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
        const s = lines[i] && lines[i].status || 'PASS';
        if ((WL.RELEASECHECK_STATUS_ORDER[s] || 0) > (WL.RELEASECHECK_STATUS_ORDER[result] || 0)) result = s;
      }
      return result;
    },
    statusCounts(lines) {
      const counts = { PASS:0, WARN:0, FAIL:0, BLOCKED:0 };
      (lines || []).forEach(function (l) { counts[l.status] = (counts[l.status] || 0) + 1; });
      return counts;
    },
    gameplaySnapshot(root) {
      return WL.U.safeJson({ player:root.player, body:root.body, progression:root.progression, inventory:root.inventory, abilities:root.abilities, quests:root.quests, actors:root.actors, places:root.places, time:root.time, dirty:root.dirty && root.dirty.targets });
    },
    flagsIncludeUnsafe(flags) {
      flags = flags || {};
      const unsafe = ['generatedCardsEnabled','manualMutationCommandsEnabled','economyEnabled','craftingEnabled','investigationEnabled','reputationEnabled','domainEnabled','absorptionEnabled','advancedCombatEnabled','warfareEnabled','multiProtagonistEnabled'];
      return unsafe.filter(function (k) { return flags[k] === true; });
    },
    knownFailureCoverage(root, options) {
      options = options || {};
      const missing = options.missingFailureId || (options.faults && options.faults.missingFailureId) || '';
      return WL.KNOWN_FAILURE_MATRIX.map(function (f) {
        const gateDefined = (f.gates || []).every(function (g) { return WL.RELEASECHECK_GATE_IDS.indexOf(g) >= 0; });
        const testDefined = (f.tests || []).every(function (t) { return WL.REGRESSION_TIERS.some(function (r) { return r.tierId === t; }); });
        const ruleDefined = !!f.ownerModule;
        let status = f.status;
        if (missing && f.failureId === missing) status = 'missing';
        if (f.currentStage && (!gateDefined || !testDefined || !ruleDefined)) status = 'missing';
        return {
          failureId:f.failureId,
          title:f.title,
          currentStage:!!f.currentStage,
          ownerModule:f.ownerModule,
          ruleDefined:ruleDefined,
          testDefined:testDefined,
          releaseGateDefined:gateDefined,
          status:status
        };
      });
    },
    regressionTierSummary(root, options) {
      options = options || {};
      const missingTier = options.missingTier || (options.faults && options.faults.missingTier) || '';
      return WL.REGRESSION_TIERS.map(function (tier) {
        const tests = WL.REGRESSION_MATRIX.filter(function (t) { return t.tier === tier.tierId; });
        let status = tests.length >= 1 ? 'covered' : 'missing';
        if (missingTier === tier.tierId) status = 'missing';
        return { tierId:tier.tierId, name:tier.name, required:!!tier.required, plannedTestCount:tests.length, minimumTests:tier.minimumTests, status:status };
      });
    },
    runGateRecords(root, options) {
      options = options || {};
      const faults = options.faults || {};
      if (!root || typeof root !== 'object') root = WL.StateManager.root();
      if (WL.FoundationDepthReview && typeof WL.FoundationDepthReview.ensureDepthSchemas === 'function') WL.FoundationDepthReview.ensureDepthSchemas(root);
      const lines = [];
      const add = (gateId, ok, passMessage, failMessage, failureIds, blocked) => lines.push(this.line(gateId, blocked ? 'BLOCKED' : (ok ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'), ok ? passMessage : (failMessage || passMessage), failureIds || [], null));
      const addWarn = (gateId, message, failureIds) => lines.push(this.line(gateId, 'WARN', message, failureIds || [], 'Acknowledge limitation or add a deeper future spec.'));
      const buildOk = /^0\.16\.0-releasecheck-regression-matrix-hardening/.test(WL.BUILD_VERSION) && /ReleaseCheck and Regression Matrix/.test(WL.BUILD_STAGE || '');
      add('G01', buildOk && !!WL.RELEASECHECK_MATRIX_LOCK_VERSION, 'build identity/version/stage aligned for V0.16', 'build identity or V0.16 lock missing', ['F011']);
      const requiredBuckets = (WL.ROOT_BUCKETS_ALL || []).filter(function (b) { return !root[b] || typeof root[b] !== 'object'; });
      const ledgerOk = root.operationLedger && root.operationLedger.permanentKeys && root.operationLedger.rewardKeys && root.operationLedger.cardKeys && root.operationLedger.sourceUseKeys && Array.isArray(root.operationLedger.recentKeys);
      add('G02', requiredBuckets.length === 0 && ledgerOk && root.cards && root.features && root.features.generatedCardsEnabled === false, 'state schema and required buckets healthy', 'state schema missing buckets/ledger/card flags: ' + requiredBuckets.join(','), ['F021','F022']);
      const rtOk = root.runtime && typeof WL.Runtime.makeReturn === 'function' && typeof WL.Runtime.failSoft === 'function' && typeof WL.Runtime.shouldSuppressEventScan === 'function' && typeof root.runtime.lastAppliedOutputHash === 'string' && typeof root.runtime.suppressEventScanForCommandOutput === 'boolean';
      add('G03', rtOk && !faults.missingCommandSuppression, 'runtime hook, fail-soft, suppression, and duplicate fields present', 'runtime hook/suppression/duplicate fields missing', ['F022','F024']);
      const cmdOk = WL.CommandRouter && WL.CommandOutputFormatLock && typeof WL.CommandRouter.safeRoute === 'function' && root.features.manualMutationCommandsEnabled === false;
      add('G04', cmdOk && !faults.commandOutputParsed, 'commands are inspect-only, aliases safe, mutation commands disabled', 'command output or manual mutation command safety broken', ['F024']);
      const unsafeFlags = this.flagsIncludeUnsafe(root.features || {});
      const blockedDeferred = unsafeFlags.length > 0;
      add('G05', !blockedDeferred, 'all deferred systems disabled', 'deferred system enabled without required mini-spec/tests: ' + unsafeFlags.join(', '), ['F014','F017','F018','F024'], blockedDeferred);
      const beforeParser = this.gameplaySnapshot(root);
      try { if (WL.EventScannerLite) WL.EventScannerLite.scanText('You pick up the parser-test apple.', 'output', root); } catch (e) {}
      const parserNoMutation = beforeParser === this.gameplaySnapshot(root);
      const parserOk = WL.EventScannerLite && typeof WL.EventScannerLite.scanText === 'function' && WL.EventScannerLite.shouldScanSource({sourceHook:'context'}, root).allowed === false && parserNoMutation;
      add('G06', parserOk && !faults.parserDirectMutation, 'parser source gate rejects non-canon and parser is read-only', 'parser can scan unsafe source or mutate state', ['F006','F003','F009','F015']);
      let propOk = false;
      try {
        const testRoot = WL.StateManager.init({});
        const hit = WL.EventScannerLite.scanOutput('You pick up the iron key.', testRoot)[0];
        const prop = WL.ProposalBuilder.fromHits(testRoot, [hit], 'output')[0];
        propOk = !!(prop && prop.localClausePreview && prop.target && prop.proposalOnly && prop.canCommitDirectly === false);
      } catch (e) { propOk = false; }
      add('G07', propOk && !faults.proposalMissingLocalClause, 'proposal source/local/target binding and no-direct-commit present', 'proposal binding missing or direct commit possible', ['F006','F008','F023']);
      const valOk = WL.CanonValidator && typeof WL.CanonValidator.validateAll === 'function' && typeof WL.CanonValidator.validateClause === 'function';
      add('G08', valOk && !faults.canonValidatorMissing, 'CanonValidator clause-level gate present', 'CanonValidator missing or unsafe clause rules unavailable', ['F003','F004','F005','F006','F009','F015','F023']);
      const sanOk = WL.Sanitizers && WL.Resolver && WL.Sanitizers.cardTrigger && WL.Sanitizers.cardTrigger('street') === '' && WL.Sanitizers.cardTrigger('Sturdy Oak') === 'Sturdy Oak';
      add('G09', sanOk, 'resolver/sanitizers include owner-specific cleanup and broad trigger rejection', 'resolver/sanitizer or broad trigger guard missing', ['F001','F002','F008','F012','F018','F019']);
      const regOk = WL.ReducerRegistry && WL.ReducerRegistry.LEDGER_ORDER === 'check_mutate_record_dirty_audit' && typeof WL.ReducerRegistry.ownerForFamily === 'function';
      add('G10', regOk && !faults.rejectedCanReachReducer, 'ReducerRegistry owner map and non-accepted block present', 'ReducerRegistry unsafe owner routing or rejected-result path detected', ['F003','F006','F019','F023']);
      const reducerOk = WL.InventoryReducer && WL.InventoryReducer.defensiveLocked && WL.AbilityReducer && WL.AbilityReducer.defensiveLocked && WL.BodyReducer && WL.BodyReducer.defensiveLocked && WL.PlaceReducerLite && WL.PlaceReducerLite.defensiveLocked && WL.TimeReducerLite && WL.TimeReducerLite.defensiveLocked && !faults.reducerGuardsMissing;
      add('G11', reducerOk, 'owner reducers have defensive unsafe-flag guards', 'owner reducer defensive guards missing', ['F003','F004','F005','F006','F009','F013','F015','F023']);
      const ledger = root.operationLedger || {};
      const ledgerOk2 = ledger.permanentKeys && ledger.rewardKeys && ledger.cardKeys && ledger.sourceUseKeys && Array.isArray(ledger.recentKeys) && WL.OperationLedger && !faults.cleanupDeletesDurableKeys;
      add('G12', ledgerOk2, 'OperationLedger durable/recent/reward/card/source buckets present', 'OperationLedger bucket or durable key policy missing', ['F010','F023','F019','F022']);
      const dirtyOk = WL.DirtyQueue && WL.DirtyQueue.inspect(root).filter(function (r) { return r.status === 'FAIL'; }).length === 0;
      add('G13', dirtyOk, 'DirtyQueue DirtyTarget schema/dedupe/cap present', 'DirtyQueue schema or dedupe/cap gate failing', ['F019','F020','F022']);
      const beforeContext = this.gameplaySnapshot(root);
      try { if (WL.ContextBuilderLite) WL.ContextBuilderLite.build(root, 'context mutation probe'); } catch (e) {}
      const contextNoWrite = beforeContext === this.gameplaySnapshot(root);
      const contextOk = WL.ContextBuilderLite && WL.ContextBuilderLite.inspect(root).filter(function (r) { return r.status === 'FAIL'; }).length === 0 && contextNoWrite;
      add('G14', contextOk && !faults.contextMutation, 'ContextBuilderLite packet budget/audit is read-only', 'ContextBuilderLite can mutate gameplay or lacks packet/budget gates', ['F020']);
      const cardOk = WL.CardSyncLite && WL.CardApiAdapter && WL.CardSyncLite.inspect(root).filter(function (r) { return r.status === 'FAIL'; }).length === 0 && root.features.generatedCardsEnabled === false && root.features.protectedCardWritesEnabled === false && !faults.storyCardImportsCanon;
      add('G15', cardOk, 'CardSyncLite protected dry-run mirror and generated-card disabled gates pass', 'CardSync live/generated/prose-import/broad-trigger safety failing', ['F019']);
      const migrationOk = WL.MigrationManager && WL.MigrationManager.inspect(root).filter(function (r) { return r.status === 'FAIL'; }).length === 0 && !faults.storyCardImportsCanon;
      add('G16', migrationOk, 'Migration/quarantine is conservative and inactive', 'Migration/quarantine imports unsafe data or lacks schema', ['F021']);
      const cleanupOk = WL.CleanupManagerLite && WL.CleanupManagerLite.inspect(root).filter(function (r) { return r.status === 'FAIL'; }).length === 0 && !faults.cleanupDeletesDurableKeys;
      add('G17', cleanupOk, 'Cleanup caps logs/queues without active truth or durable key deletion', 'Cleanup/performance gate unsafe', ['F022','F025']);
      let helpHonest = true;
      try { helpHonest = /Deferred:/i.test(WL.CommandRenderer.help(root)) && !/generated cards.*active/i.test(WL.CommandRenderer.help(root)); } catch (e) { helpHonest = false; }
      add('G18', helpHonest, 'command renderer honesty checks pass', 'commands hide deferred state or imply inactive systems are active', ['F024','F003','F006','F023']);
      const coverage = this.knownFailureCoverage(root, options);
      const currentMissing = coverage.filter(function (c) { return c.currentStage && c.status !== 'covered'; });
      const tiers = this.regressionTierSummary(root, options);
      const missingTiers = tiers.filter(function (t) { return t.required && t.status === 'missing'; });
      add('G19', currentMissing.length === 0 && missingTiers.length === 0, 'current-stage known failures and regression tiers covered', 'missing known-failure or regression-tier coverage', ['F025']);
      const salvageOk = WL.LegacySalvageLedger && WL.LEGACY_SALVAGE_LEDGER && WL.LEGACY_SALVAGE_LEDGER.length >= 6;
      add('G20', salvageOk && !faults.legacySalvageMissing, 'old fix salvage ledger classifies old work as evidence/rules/tests', 'old fix salvage coverage missing or old patch copied blindly', ['F001','F021','F025']);
      const playerTests = WL.FoundationTestHarness && WL.FoundationTestHarness.runPlayerBreakerCheck ? WL.FoundationTestHarness.runPlayerBreakerCheck() : [];
      const playerOk = playerTests.length >= 14 && playerTests.every(function (t) { return t.ok; });
      add('G21', playerOk && !faults.playerBreakerMissing, 'player-breaker adversarial tests pass', 'adversarial player-breaker coverage missing or failing', ['F006','F003','F009','F015','F023','F024']);
      const packageOk = WL.SECTION_ORDER && WL.SECTION_ORDER.length === 25 && WL.RELEASECHECK_GATE_IDS.length === 22 && /Code Pass 1/.test(WL.BUILD_STAGE || '') && WL.MVP_DISABLED_SYSTEMS.length >= 10;
      add('G22', packageOk, 'package scope/readiness/deferred-system boundaries clear', 'package readiness or Code Pass scope unclear', ['F025']);
      addWarn('G22', 'Code Pass 1 remains foundation-limited; advanced systems are intentionally deferred.', []);
      return lines;
    },
    buildRecord(root, options) {
      const lines = this.runGateRecords(root, options || {});
      const counts = this.statusCounts(lines);
      const result = this.resultFromLines(lines);
      const coverage = this.knownFailureCoverage(root, options || {});
      const tiers = this.regressionTierSummary(root, options || {});
      const record = {
        turn:WL.U.nowTurn(root),
        result:result,
        buildName:WL.BUILD_NAME,
        buildVersion:WL.BUILD_VERSION,
        schemaVersion:String(WL.SCHEMA_VERSION),
        checkedAtTurn:WL.U.nowTurn(root),
        passCount:counts.PASS,
        warningCount:counts.WARN,
        failureCount:counts.FAIL,
        blockerCount:counts.BLOCKED,
        passes:lines.filter(function (l) { return l.status === 'PASS'; }),
        warnings:lines.filter(function (l) { return l.status === 'WARN'; }),
        failures:lines.filter(function (l) { return l.status === 'FAIL'; }),
        blockers:lines.filter(function (l) { return l.status === 'BLOCKED'; }),
        deferredSystems:WL.MVP_DISABLED_SYSTEMS.map(function (s) { return WL.ReleaseCheckMatrix.line('G05', 'PASS', 'deferred system disabled: ' + s, [], 'Keep disabled until mini-spec unlock.'); }),
        knownFailureCoverage:coverage,
        regressionTiers:tiers,
        notes:['ReleaseCheck is non-canon and may audit only.', 'Generated cards, manual mutation commands, economy, crafting, investigation, reputation, domain, absorption, advanced combat, warfare, and multi-protagonist remain disabled.']
      };
      if (root && root.audits) {
        if (!Array.isArray(root.audits.releasecheckRecords)) root.audits.releasecheckRecords = [];
        root.audits.releasecheckRecords.push(record);
        WL.U.capArray(root.audits.releasecheckRecords, 12);
      }
      if (root) root.releasecheck = Object.assign(root.releasecheck || {}, { lastRecord:record, gateRecords:lines, knownFailureCoverage:coverage, regressionTiers:tiers, matrixLockVersion:WL.RELEASECHECK_MATRIX_LOCK_VERSION });
      return record;
    },
    renderRecord(record) {
      const lines = [];
      lines.push('Status: ' + record.result);
      lines.push('Build: ' + record.buildName + ' / ' + record.buildVersion);
      lines.push('Schema: ' + record.schemaVersion);
      lines.push('Mode: Code Pass 1 foundation; advanced systems deferred.');
      lines.push('Summary:');
      lines.push('- Passes: ' + record.passCount);
      lines.push('- Warnings: ' + record.warningCount);
      lines.push('- Failures: ' + record.failureCount);
      lines.push('- Blockers: ' + record.blockerCount);
      lines.push('Critical Gates:');
      record.passes.concat(record.warnings, record.failures, record.blockers).forEach(function (l) { lines.push('- ' + l.status + ' ' + l.gateId + ' ' + l.gateName + ': ' + l.message); });
      lines.push('Known Failure Coverage:');
      record.knownFailureCoverage.forEach(function (c) { lines.push('- ' + c.failureId + ' ' + c.status + ': ' + c.title); });
      lines.push('Regression Tiers:');
      record.regressionTiers.forEach(function (t) { lines.push('- ' + t.tierId + ' ' + t.status + ': ' + t.name + ' (' + t.plannedTestCount + ' planned checks)'); });
      lines.push('Deferred Systems:');
      WL.MVP_DISABLED_SYSTEMS.forEach(function (s) { lines.push('- disabled: ' + s); });
      lines.push('Result: No gameplay state was changed by ReleaseCheck.');
      return lines;
    },
    runBC16SelfTests() {
      const results = [];
      const add = (id, ok, label) => results.push({ id:id, ok:!!ok, label:label });
      const preserveState = globalThis.state;
      const preserveFaults = WL.__BC16_FAULTS;
      try {
        globalThis.state = {};
        let root = WL.StateManager.root();
        let rec = this.buildRecord(root);
        add('BC16-001', (rec.result === 'PASS' || rec.result === 'WARN') && rec.failureCount === 0 && rec.blockerCount === 0, 'fresh safe build passes foundation gates with only honest warnings');
        root = WL.StateManager.init({}); root.features.generatedCardsEnabled = true; rec = this.buildRecord(root); add('BC16-002', rec.result === 'BLOCKED' && rec.blockers.some(function (b) { return b.gateId === 'G05'; }), 'generated cards enabled becomes BLOCKED');
        root = WL.StateManager.init({}); root.features.manualMutationCommandsEnabled = true; rec = this.buildRecord(root); add('BC16-003', rec.result === 'BLOCKED' && rec.blockers.some(function (b) { return b.gateId === 'G05'; }), 'manual mutation commands enabled becomes BLOCKED');
        root = WL.StateManager.init({}); delete root.operationLedger.rewardKeys; rec = this.buildRecord(root); add('BC16-004', rec.failures.some(function (f) { return f.gateId === 'G02' || f.gateId === 'G12'; }), 'missing operationLedger rewardKeys fails');
        root = WL.StateManager.init({}); delete root.runtime.suppressEventScanForCommandOutput; rec = this.buildRecord(root, { faults:{ missingCommandSuppression:true } }); add('BC16-005', rec.failures.some(function (f) { return f.gateId === 'G03'; }), 'command output suppression missing fails');
        root = WL.StateManager.init({}); rec = this.buildRecord(root, { faults:{ parserDirectMutation:true } }); add('BC16-006', rec.failures.some(function (f) { return f.gateId === 'G06'; }), 'parser direct mutation path fails');
        root = WL.StateManager.init({}); rec = this.buildRecord(root, { faults:{ proposalMissingLocalClause:true } }); add('BC16-007', rec.failures.some(function (f) { return f.gateId === 'G07'; }), 'proposal missing local clause fails');
        root = WL.StateManager.init({}); rec = this.buildRecord(root, { faults:{ canonValidatorMissing:true } }); add('BC16-008', rec.failures.some(function (f) { return f.gateId === 'G08'; }), 'CanonValidator missing fails when reducers active');
        root = WL.StateManager.init({}); rec = this.buildRecord(root, { faults:{ rejectedCanReachReducer:true } }); add('BC16-009', rec.failures.some(function (f) { return f.gateId === 'G10'; }), 'rejected result reaching reducer fails');
        root = WL.StateManager.init({}); rec = this.buildRecord(root, { faults:{ contextMutation:true } }); add('BC16-010', rec.failures.some(function (f) { return f.gateId === 'G14'; }), 'context mutation path fails');
        root = WL.StateManager.init({}); rec = this.buildRecord(root, { faults:{ storyCardImportsCanon:true } }); add('BC16-011', rec.failures.some(function (f) { return f.gateId === 'G15' || f.gateId === 'G16'; }), 'Story Card text import path fails');
        root = WL.StateManager.init({}); rec = this.buildRecord(root, { faults:{ cleanupDeletesDurableKeys:true } }); add('BC16-012', rec.failures.some(function (f) { return f.gateId === 'G12' || f.gateId === 'G17'; }), 'cleanup deleting durable keys fails');
        root = WL.StateManager.init({}); rec = this.buildRecord(root, { faults:{ missingFailureId:'F006' } }); add('BC16-013', rec.failures.some(function (f) { return f.gateId === 'G19'; }) && rec.knownFailureCoverage.some(function (c) { return c.failureId === 'F006' && c.status === 'missing'; }), 'known failure missing coverage fails G19');
        root = WL.StateManager.init({}); root.features.craftingEnabled = true; rec = this.buildRecord(root); add('BC16-014', rec.blockers.some(function (b) { return b.gateId === 'G05'; }), 'deferred crafting enabled without spec is BLOCKED');
        globalThis.state = {}; root = WL.StateManager.root(); const before = this.gameplaySnapshot(root); const out = WL.onInput('/releasecheck'); root = WL.StateManager.root(); const after = this.gameplaySnapshot(root); add('BC16-015', /^\[WorldLedger\]/.test(out) && before === after, 'ReleaseCheck command is non-mutating for gameplay buckets');
      } catch (e) {
        add('BC16-ERR', false, 'BC16 self-test exception: ' + String(e && e.message || e));
      } finally {
        globalThis.state = preserveState;
        WL.__BC16_FAULTS = preserveFaults;
      }
      return results;
    }
  };

  // Replace legacy gate records with the V0.16 structured gate system.
  WL.ReleaseCheckLite.runGateRecords = function (root, options) { return WL.ReleaseCheckMatrix.runGateRecords(root || WL.StateManager.root(), options || {}); };
  WL.ReleaseCheckLite.buildRecord = function (root, options) { return WL.ReleaseCheckMatrix.buildRecord(root || WL.StateManager.root(), options || {}); };
  WL.ReleaseCheckLite.renderRecord = function (record) { return WL.ReleaseCheckMatrix.renderRecord(record); };
  WL.ReleaseCheckLite.run = function (root) {
    root = root || WL.StateManager.root();
    const record = WL.ReleaseCheckMatrix.buildRecord(root);
    const out = WL.ReleaseCheckMatrix.renderRecord(record).map(function (line) {
      if (/^- PASS/.test(line)) return line;
      return line;
    });
    // Keep compatibility with old PASS:/WARN:/FAIL: line parsing.
    out.push('PASS: ReleaseCheckRecord schema active: ' + WL.RELEASECHECK_MATRIX_LOCK_VERSION);
    out.push('PASS: gate ids registered: ' + WL.RELEASECHECK_GATE_IDS.length + '/22');
    out.push(record.warningCount ? 'WARN: ' + record.warningCount + ' honest limitation warning(s)' : 'PASS: no warnings');
    out.push(record.failureCount ? 'FAIL: ' + record.failureCount + ' gate failure(s)' : 'PASS: no gate failures');
    out.push(record.blockerCount ? 'BLOCKED: ' + record.blockerCount + ' blocked activation(s)' : 'PASS: no blockers');
    if (root && root.features && root.features.manualMutationCommandsEnabled === true) out.push('FAIL: manual mutation commands enabled');
    if (root && root.features && root.features.generatedCardsEnabled === true) out.push('FAIL: generated cards enabled too early');
    if (WL.LegacySalvageLedger && WL.LegacySalvageLedger.inspect && WL.LegacySalvageLedger.inspect(root).filter(function (r) { return r.status === 'FAIL'; }).length === 0) out.push('PASS: Legacy salvage control map audit clean');
    return out;
  };

  };

    runBC17SelfTests() {

        const oldText = (typeof WL.SourceText === 'string' ? WL.SourceText : '');
        add('BC17-PKG-001', !(WL.CommandOutputFormatLock && WL.CommandOutputFormatLock.noInstallPattern && WL.CommandOutputFormatLock.noInstallPattern.test(oldText)), 'Library source text does not contain embedded install-wrapper instructions');

      return results;

  WL.PRODUCTION_PACKAGE_AUTHORITY = 'AIDRPG Final Build Planning Package v1.4.23 repaired final with Production Chunks 01-25';
  WL.PRODUCTION_CHUNK_01_LOCK_VERSION = 'worldledger.production.pc01.foundation-freeze.v18_0';
  WL.PRODUCTION_SEQUENCE_STATUS = 'production_chunk_01_of_25_foundation_freeze';
  WL.RC_ASSEMBLY_TARGET = 'WorldLedgerV0.18.0_RC_ASSEMBLY_START';
  WL.PC01_ACCEPTED_BUILD_TITLE = 'WorldLedgerV0.18.0 — Core MVP Foundation Script / RC Assembly Production Chunk 01 Foundation Acceptance and Freeze';
  WL.PC01_SCOPE_NOTE = 'Production Chunk 01 accepts and freezes the Code Pass 1 foundation. It is not a full gameplay-feature unlock.';
  WL.PC01_OLD_EVIDENCE_SOURCES = Object.freeze([
    { file:'AIDRPGv1-1-6-cleanpass-final.txt', role:'stable shell / hook wrapper evidence', use:'source for what hook safety and persistent shell structure must preserve', paste:false },
    { file:'aidrpgv1-3-8.txt', role:'late patch-loop evidence', use:'source for replay, age, denial, and fast-path risks to convert into gates', paste:false },
    { file:'aidrpgv1-4-4_FIXED_UNCOMPRESSED.txt', role:'route/time/reputation repair evidence', use:'source for future owner reducers and contradiction checks, not a live patch layer', paste:false },
    { file:'aidrpgv1-5-0_FINAL_UNCOMPRESSED.txt', role:'inventory/time/named item recovery evidence', use:'source for future event validators and item ownership tests', paste:false },
    { file:'aidrpgv1-8-2_NATURAL_CONFIRMATION_REPAIR.txt', role:'natural confirmation and parser safety evidence', use:'source for false-canon/player-identity/quote/scene safeguards', paste:false },
    { file:'c25u5.txt', role:'late build / major-memory evidence', use:'source for future production chunks after foundation freeze', paste:false }
  ]);
  WL.PC01_FOUNDATION_COMMANDS = Object.freeze([
    'help','version','sheet','status','inventory','abilities','quests','actors','location','time',
    'debuglast','cardaudit','contextaudit','stateaudit','ledger','dirty','migration','quarantine',
    'releasecheck','startupaudit','schema','schemaaudit','owners','commandformat','commands',
    'statemanager','integrity','repairlog','runtime','hookaudit','runtimecheck','failsoft',
    'audit','ledgercheck','commandrouter','commandcheck','parser','parsercheck','proposal',
    'proposalcheck','validator','validatorcheck','resolver','resolvercheck','controlmap',
    'salvage','borrowledger','supportdepth','supportschemas','supportcheck','playerbreakercheck',
    'regressioncheck','runfoundationtests','gatecheck','releaseprofile','knownfailures',
    'regressionmatrix','bc16check','foundation','codepass','foundationcheck','hookcheck','packagingcheck'
  ]);
  WL.PC01_EXTRA_COMMANDS = Object.freeze(['pc01','pc01check','foundationaccept']);
  WL.PC01_REQUIRED_TESTS = Object.freeze([
    'PC01-001 Build identity stable',
    'PC01-002 Foundation commands registered',
    'PC01-003 Hook exports exist',
    'PC01-004 Deferred flags remain disabled',
    'PC01-005 Command output non-canon',
    'PC01-006 Story Card text non-canon',
    'PC01-007 Context text non-canon',
    'PC01-008 Player-breaker minimum set passes',
    'PC01-009 Regression baseline passes',
    'PC01-010 ReleaseCheck no fake pass',
    'PC01-011 Duplicate output no repeat effects',
    'PC01-012 Foundation accepted marker writes once'
  ]);
  WL.PC01_RELEASE_GATES = Object.freeze([
    'PC01-G01 V0.18.0 RC assembly identity active or accepted freeze version active',
    'PC01-G02 AIDRPG/WorldLedger bridge present',
    'PC01-G03 root key remains stable',
    'PC01-G04 required foundation commands registered',
    'PC01-G05 hook exports present',
    'PC01-G06 deferred feature flags disabled',
    'PC01-G07 CardSync dry-run/generated disabled',
    'PC01-G08 manual mutation commands disabled',
    'PC01-G09 command output suppression active',
    'PC01-G10 duplicate output replay protection active',
    'PC01-G11 player-breaker minimum set registered and passing',
    'PC01-G12 regressioncheck registered and passing',
    'PC01-G13 support layers non-canon',
    'PC01-G14 ReleaseCheck does not fake PASS',
    'PC01-G15 foundation accepted marker present only after checks pass'
  ]);

  WL.ProductionChunk01 = {
    lockVersion: WL.PRODUCTION_CHUNK_01_LOCK_VERSION,
    statusFor(ok, label, failStatus) { return { status: ok ? 'PASS' : (failStatus || 'FAIL'), label: label }; },
    requiredCommands() { return WL.PC01_FOUNDATION_COMMANDS.slice(); },
    missingCommands() {
      const dispatch = WL.CommandRouter && WL.CommandRouter.activeDispatch || {};
      return this.requiredCommands().filter(function (cmd) { return !dispatch[cmd]; });
    },
    unsafeFlags(root) {
      if (WL.ReleaseCheckMatrix && typeof WL.ReleaseCheckMatrix.flagsIncludeUnsafe === 'function') return WL.ReleaseCheckMatrix.flagsIncludeUnsafe(root && root.features || {});
      const flags = root && root.features || {};
      return ['generatedCardsEnabled','manualMutationCommandsEnabled','economyEnabled','craftingEnabled','investigationEnabled','reputationEnabled','domainEnabled','absorptionEnabled','advancedCombatEnabled','warfareEnabled','multiProtagonistEnabled'].filter(function (k) { return flags[k] === true; });
    },
    ensureAcceptanceRecord(root) {
      root = root || WL.StateManager.root();
      if (!root.meta || typeof root.meta !== 'object') root.meta = {};
      if (!root.meta.foundationAcceptance || typeof root.meta.foundationAcceptance !== 'object' || Array.isArray(root.meta.foundationAcceptance)) {
        root.meta.foundationAcceptance = {
          accepted:false,
          acceptedVersion:'',
          acceptedFromVersion:'0.17.0-foundation-codepass1-candidate',
          acceptedStage:'',
          acceptedAtTurn:0,
          acceptedByCommand:'',
          requiredChecks:WL.PC01_RELEASE_GATES.slice(),
          lastResult:'unknown',
          warnings:[],
          blockers:[],
          notes:['Production Chunk 01 acceptance metadata is diagnostic only; it is not gameplay truth.']
        };
      }
      const rec = root.meta.foundationAcceptance;
      if (!Array.isArray(rec.requiredChecks)) rec.requiredChecks = WL.PC01_RELEASE_GATES.slice();
      if (!Array.isArray(rec.warnings)) rec.warnings = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(rec.blockers)) rec.blockers = [];
      if (!Array.isArray(rec.notes)) rec.notes = [];
      if (typeof rec.accepted !== 'boolean') rec.accepted = false;
      return rec;
    },
    commandSuppressionActive(root) {
      return !!(WL.Runtime && typeof WL.Runtime.setCommandSuppression === 'function' && typeof WL.Runtime.shouldSuppressEventScan === 'function' && root && root.runtime && typeof root.runtime.suppressEventScanForCommandOutput === 'boolean');
    },
    duplicateProtectionActive(root) {
      return !!(WL.OperationLedger && typeof WL.OperationLedger.has === 'function' && typeof WL.OperationLedger.add === 'function' && typeof WL.OperationLedger.tryAdd === 'function' && root && root.operationLedger && root.operationLedger.permanentKeys && Array.isArray(root.operationLedger.recentKeys) && WL.Runtime && typeof root.runtime.lastAppliedOutputHash === 'string');
    },
    supportLayersNonCanon(root) {
      root = root || WL.StateManager.root();
      let contextReadOnly = false, cardSourceRejected = false, contextSourceRejected = false, cardDryRun = false, migrationConservative = false, cleanupSafe = false;
      try {
        const before = WL.ReleaseCheckMatrix && WL.ReleaseCheckMatrix.gameplaySnapshot ? WL.ReleaseCheckMatrix.gameplaySnapshot(root) : WL.U.safeJson({inv:root.inventory, body:root.body, quests:root.quests, actors:root.actors, places:root.places, time:root.time});
        if (WL.ContextBuilderLite && typeof WL.ContextBuilderLite.build === 'function') WL.ContextBuilderLite.build(root, 'PC01 context read-only probe');
        const after = WL.ReleaseCheckMatrix && WL.ReleaseCheckMatrix.gameplaySnapshot ? WL.ReleaseCheckMatrix.gameplaySnapshot(root) : WL.U.safeJson({inv:root.inventory, body:root.body, quests:root.quests, actors:root.actors, places:root.places, time:root.time});
        contextReadOnly = before === after;
      } catch (e) { contextReadOnly = false; }
      try { cardSourceRejected = !!(WL.EventScannerLite && WL.EventScannerLite.scanText('You pick up the Crown of Dawn.', 'story_card', root).length === 0); } catch (e) { cardSourceRejected = false; }
      try { contextSourceRejected = !!(WL.EventScannerLite && WL.EventScannerLite.scanText('You pick up the Crown of Dawn.', 'context', root).length === 0); } catch (e) { contextSourceRejected = false; }
      try { cardDryRun = !!(root.features && root.features.cardSyncDryRun === true && root.features.generatedCardsEnabled === false && root.features.protectedCardWritesEnabled === false && WL.CardSyncLite && WL.CardSyncLite.inspect(root).filter(function (r) { return r.status === 'FAIL'; }).length === 0); } catch (e) { cardDryRun = false; }
      try { migrationConservative = !!(WL.MigrationManager && WL.MigrationManager.inspect(root).filter(function (r) { return r.status === 'FAIL'; }).length === 0); } catch (e) { migrationConservative = false; }
      try { cleanupSafe = !!(WL.CleanupManagerLite && WL.CleanupManagerLite.inspect(root).filter(function (r) { return r.status === 'FAIL'; }).length === 0); } catch (e) { cleanupSafe = false; }
      return contextReadOnly && cardSourceRejected && contextSourceRejected && cardDryRun && migrationConservative && cleanupSafe;
    },
    playerBreakerPasses() {
      const tests = WL.FoundationTestHarness && WL.FoundationTestHarness.runPlayerBreakerCheck ? WL.FoundationTestHarness.runPlayerBreakerCheck() : [];
      return tests.length >= 14 && tests.every(function (t) { return t.ok; });
    },
    regressionBaselinePasses(root) {
      root = root || WL.StateManager.root();
      if (!(WL.CommandRouter && WL.CommandRouter.activeDispatch && WL.CommandRouter.activeDispatch.regressioncheck)) return false;
      if (!(WL.ReleaseCheckMatrix && typeof WL.ReleaseCheckMatrix.buildRecord === 'function')) return false;
      const rec = WL.ReleaseCheckMatrix.buildRecord(root, { skipPC01:true });
      return !!(rec && rec.failureCount === 0 && rec.blockerCount === 0);
    },
    releaseCheckNoFakePass(root) {
      try {
        const safe = WL.ReleaseCheckMatrix && WL.ReleaseCheckMatrix.buildRecord ? WL.ReleaseCheckMatrix.buildRecord(root || WL.StateManager.root(), { skipPC01:true, skipFinalReadiness:true }) : null;
        const unsafeRoot = WL.StateManager.init({});
        unsafeRoot.features.generatedCardsEnabled = true;
        const bad = WL.ReleaseCheckMatrix && WL.ReleaseCheckMatrix.buildRecord ? WL.ReleaseCheckMatrix.buildRecord(unsafeRoot, { skipPC01:true, skipFinalReadiness:true }) : null;
        return !!(safe && safe.failureCount === 0 && safe.blockerCount === 0 && bad && bad.blockerCount > 0);
      } catch (e) { return false; }
    },
    inspect(root, options) {
      root = root || WL.StateManager.root();
      options = options || {};
      const rows = [];
      const rec = this.ensureAcceptanceRecord(root);
      const missing = this.missingCommands();
      const unsafe = this.unsafeFlags(root);
      rows.push(this.statusFor(/^0\.18\.0-rc-assembly-pc01-foundation-acceptance-freeze/.test(WL.BUILD_VERSION), 'PC01-G01 build identity active: ' + WL.BUILD_VERSION));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(!!(WL.AIDRPG_WORLDLEDGER_BRIDGE && /WorldLedger/.test(WL.AIDRPG_WORLDLEDGER_BRIDGE.implementationName || 'WorldLedger')), 'PC01-G02 AIDRPG/WorldLedger bridge present'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(WL.ROOT_KEY === 'worldledger', 'PC01-G03 root key remains worldledger'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(missing.length === 0, missing.length ? 'PC01-G04 missing foundation commands: ' + missing.join(', ') : 'PC01-G04 required foundation commands registered'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(globalThis.WorldLedger === WL && typeof WL.onInput === 'function' && typeof WL.onContext === 'function' && typeof WL.onOutput === 'function' && typeof WL.processOutput === 'function', 'PC01-G05 hook exports present'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(unsafe.length === 0, unsafe.length ? 'PC01-G06 unsafe/deferred flags enabled: ' + unsafe.join(', ') : 'PC01-G06 deferred feature flags disabled', unsafe.length ? 'BLOCKED' : 'FAIL'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(root.features && root.features.cardSyncDryRun === true && root.features.generatedCardsEnabled === false && root.features.protectedCardWritesEnabled === false, 'PC01-G07 CardSync dry-run and generated/live writes disabled'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(root.features && root.features.manualMutationCommandsEnabled === false, 'PC01-G08 manual mutation commands disabled'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(this.commandSuppressionActive(root), 'PC01-G09 command output suppression active'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(this.duplicateProtectionActive(root), 'PC01-G10 duplicate output replay protection active'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(this.playerBreakerPasses(), 'PC01-G11 player-breaker minimum set registered and passing'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(WL.CommandRouter && WL.CommandRouter.activeDispatch && WL.CommandRouter.activeDispatch.regressioncheck && this.regressionBaselinePasses(), 'PC01-G12 regressioncheck registered and foundation tests passing'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(this.supportLayersNonCanon(root), 'PC01-G13 support layers remain non-canon'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(this.releaseCheckNoFakePass(root), 'PC01-G14 ReleaseCheck negative gate catches unsafe activation'));
      if (!options.skipAcceptanceGate) {
        rows.push(this.statusFor(rec.accepted === true && rec.acceptedVersion === WL.BUILD_VERSION && rec.lastResult === 'accepted', 'PC01-G15 foundation accepted marker present after clean checks'));
      }
      return rows;
    },
    passingWithoutAcceptance(root) {
      const rows = this.inspect(root || WL.StateManager.root(), { skipAcceptanceGate:true });
      return rows.filter(function (r) { return r.status === 'FAIL' || r.status === 'BLOCKED'; }).length === 0;
    },
    accept(root, acceptedByCommand) {
      root = root || WL.StateManager.root();
      const rec = this.ensureAcceptanceRecord(root);
      const preRows = this.inspect(root, { skipAcceptanceGate:true });
      const blockers = preRows.filter(function (r) { return r.status === 'FAIL' || r.status === 'BLOCKED'; });
      rec.requiredChecks = WL.PC01_RELEASE_GATES.slice();
      rec.warnings = preRows.filter(function (r) { return r.status === 'WARN'; }).map(function (r) { return r.label; });
      rec.blockers = blockers.map(function (r) { return r.status + ': ' + r.label; });
      rec.acceptedFromVersion = '0.17.0-foundation-codepass1-candidate';
      rec.acceptedStage = WL.BUILD_STAGE;
      rec.acceptedByCommand = acceptedByCommand || 'auto_pc01_releasecheck';
      if (blockers.length === 0) {
        if (rec.accepted !== true) {
          rec.accepted = true;
          rec.acceptedVersion = WL.BUILD_VERSION;
          rec.acceptedAtTurn = WL.U.nowTurn(root);
          rec.notes.push('Accepted/frozen by Production Chunk 01 after required checks passed.');
          WL.U.capArray(rec.notes, 12);
        }
        rec.lastResult = 'accepted';
      } else {
        rec.accepted = false;
        rec.acceptedVersion = '';
        rec.lastResult = 'blocked';
      }
      if (root.audits) {
        if (!Array.isArray(root.audits.pc01AcceptanceAudit)) root.audits.pc01AcceptanceAudit = [];
        root.audits.pc01AcceptanceAudit.push({ turn:WL.U.nowTurn(root), result:rec.lastResult, blockers:rec.blockers.slice(0, 8), command:rec.acceptedByCommand });
        WL.U.capArray(root.audits.pc01AcceptanceAudit, 12);
      }
      return rec;
    },
    render(root) {
      root = root || WL.StateManager.root();
      const rec = this.ensureAcceptanceRecord(root);
      const rows = this.inspect(root);
      const pass = rows.filter(function (r) { return r.status === 'PASS'; }).length;
      const fail = rows.filter(function (r) { return r.status === 'FAIL' || r.status === 'BLOCKED'; }).length;
      const lines = [];
      lines.push('Production Chunk 01: Foundation Acceptance and Freeze');
      lines.push('Package authority: ' + WL.PRODUCTION_PACKAGE_AUTHORITY);
      lines.push('Lock: ' + WL.PRODUCTION_CHUNK_01_LOCK_VERSION);
      lines.push('Build: ' + WL.BUILD_VERSION);
      lines.push('Accepted: ' + (rec.accepted ? 'yes' : 'no') + (rec.acceptedVersion ? ' / ' + rec.acceptedVersion : ''));
      lines.push('Result: ' + rec.lastResult);
      lines.push('Pass/Fail: ' + pass + '/' + fail);
      lines.push('Old evidence sources are recorded as context, not pasted patch layers:');
      WL.PC01_OLD_EVIDENCE_SOURCES.forEach(function (s) { lines.push('- ' + s.file + ': ' + s.role + ' -> ' + s.use); });
      lines.push('Gates:');
      rows.forEach(function (r) { lines.push(r.status + ': ' + r.label); });
      return lines;
    },
    runPC01SelfTests() {
      const results = [];
      const add = function (id, ok, label) { results.push({ id:id, ok:!!ok, label:label }); };
      const preserveState = globalThis.state;
      try {
        globalThis.state = {};
        let root = WL.StateManager.root();
        add('PC01-001', /^0\.18\.0-rc-assembly-pc01-foundation-acceptance-freeze/.test(WL.BUILD_VERSION), 'Build identity stable for PC01');
        add('PC01-002', this.missingCommands().length === 0, 'Foundation commands registered');
        add('PC01-003', globalThis.WorldLedger === WL && typeof WL.onInput === 'function' && typeof WL.onContext === 'function' && typeof WL.onOutput === 'function' && typeof WL.processOutput === 'function', 'Hook exports exist');
        add('PC01-004', this.unsafeFlags(root).length === 0, 'Deferred flags remain disabled');
        const out = WL.onInput('/inventory'); root = WL.StateManager.root(); const before = Object.keys(root.inventory.itemsById || {}).length; WL.onOutput(out + '\nYou pick up the Crown of Dawn.'); root = WL.StateManager.root(); add('PC01-005', Object.keys(root.inventory.itemsById || {}).length === before, 'Command output non-canon');
        const cardHits = WL.EventScannerLite.scanText('You pick up the Crown of Dawn.', 'story_card', root); add('PC01-006', cardHits.length === 0, 'Story Card text non-canon');
        const ctxHits = WL.EventScannerLite.scanText('You pick up the Crown of Dawn.', 'context', root); add('PC01-007', ctxHits.length === 0, 'Context text non-canon');
        add('PC01-008', this.playerBreakerPasses(), 'Player-breaker minimum set passes');
        add('PC01-009', this.regressionBaselinePasses(), 'Regression baseline passes');
        add('PC01-010', this.releaseCheckNoFakePass(root), 'ReleaseCheck no fake pass');
        globalThis.state = {}; WL.onOutput('You receive 5 gold.'); root = WL.StateManager.root(); const copper1 = root.inventory.currency.copper; WL.onOutput('You receive 5 gold.'); root = WL.StateManager.root(); add('PC01-011', root.inventory.currency.copper === copper1, 'Duplicate output no repeat effects');
        globalThis.state = {}; root = WL.StateManager.root(); const recA = this.accept(root, '/foundationaccept'); const turnA = recA.acceptedAtTurn; const noteLenA = recA.notes.length; const recB = this.accept(root, '/foundationaccept'); add('PC01-012', recA.accepted && recB.accepted && recB.acceptedAtTurn === turnA && recB.notes.length === noteLenA, 'Foundation accepted marker writes once');
      } catch (e) { add('PC01-ERR', false, 'PC01 self-test exception: ' + (e && e.message || e)); }
      finally { globalThis.state = preserveState; }
      return results;
    }
  };

  // Register PC01 command surfaces without weakening the existing command router.
  WL.CommandRenderer.pc01 = function (root) {
    root = root || WL.StateManager.root();
    WL.ProductionChunk01.accept(root, '/pc01');
    return this.header('Production Chunk 01') + WL.ProductionChunk01.render(root).join('\n') + '\n';
  };
  WL.CommandRenderer.foundationaccept = function (root) {
    root = root || WL.StateManager.root();
    const rec = WL.ProductionChunk01.accept(root, '/foundationaccept');
    const lines = WL.ProductionChunk01.render(root);
    lines.unshift('Foundation acceptance command result: ' + rec.lastResult);
    return this.header('Foundation Accept') + lines.join('\n') + '\n';
  };
  WL.CommandRenderer.pc01check = function (root) {
    const tests = WL.ProductionChunk01.runPC01SelfTests();
    const pass = tests.filter(function (t) { return t.ok; }).length;
    return this.header('PC01 Check') + 'PC01 foundation acceptance tests: ' + pass + '/' + tests.length + ' pass\n' + tests.map(function (t) { return (t.ok ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL') + ': ' + t.id + ' — ' + t.label; }).join('\n') + '\n';
  };

  ['pc01','pc01check','foundationaccept'].forEach(function (cmd) {
    if (WL.MVP_ACTIVE_COMMANDS.indexOf(cmd) < 0) WL.MVP_ACTIVE_COMMANDS = Object.freeze(WL.MVP_ACTIVE_COMMANDS.concat([cmd]));
  });
  WL.CommandRouter.activeDispatch = Object.freeze(Object.assign({}, WL.CommandRouter.activeDispatch, {
    pc01:'pc01', pc01check:'pc01check', foundationaccept:'foundationaccept'
  }));
  WL.CommandRouter.outputCaps = Object.freeze(Object.assign({}, WL.CommandRouter.outputCaps, {
    pc01:6200, pc01check:6200, foundationaccept:6200
  }));
  WL.CODE_PASS1_REQUIRED_COMMANDS = Object.freeze((WL.CODE_PASS1_REQUIRED_COMMANDS || []).concat(WL.PC01_EXTRA_COMMANDS).filter(function (value, index, arr) { return arr.indexOf(value) === index; }));

  // Extend ReleaseCheck with explicit PC01 gates. Unknown PC01 ids are intentional; the message carries the exact PC01 gate label.
  if (WL.ReleaseCheckMatrix) {
    const oldRunGateRecordsPC01 = WL.ReleaseCheckMatrix.runGateRecords;
    WL.ReleaseCheckMatrix.runGateRecords = function (root, options) {
      root = root || WL.StateManager.root();
      options = options || {};
      if (options.skipFinalReadiness) options.skipPC01 = true;
      if (!options.skipPC01) WL.ProductionChunk01.accept(root, 'auto_pc01_releasecheck');
      const rows = oldRunGateRecordsPC01.call(WL.ReleaseCheckMatrix, root, options);
      if (WL.PC01_ACCEPTS_CURRENT_IDENTITY && WL.PC01_ACCEPTS_CURRENT_IDENTITY()) {
        rows.forEach(function (line) {
          if (line.gateId === 'G01') {
            line.status = 'PASS';
            line.message = 'build identity/version/stage aligned for V0.18.0 PC01 foundation freeze';
          }
        });
      }
      if (!options.skipPC01) {
        const pcRows = WL.ProductionChunk01.inspect(root);
        for (let i = 0; i < pcRows.length; i += 1) {
          rows.push(WL.ReleaseCheckMatrix.line('PC01-G' + String(i + 1).padStart(2, '0'), pcRows[i].status, pcRows[i].label, ['F025'], 'Fix Production Chunk 01 foundation acceptance before feature production.'));
        }
      }
      return rows;
    };
  }

  // Extend foundation/regression rendering with PC01 without disabling earlier tests.
  if (WL.FoundationTestHarness && typeof WL.FoundationTestHarness.runFoundationTests === 'function') {
    const oldRunFoundationTestsPC01 = WL.FoundationTestHarness.runFoundationTests;
    WL.FoundationTestHarness.runFoundationTests = function () {
      const base = oldRunFoundationTestsPC01.call(this) || [];
      return base.concat(WL.ProductionChunk01.runPC01SelfTests());
    };
  }
  if (WL.CommandRenderer.regressioncheck) {
    const oldRegressionCheckPC01 = WL.CommandRenderer.regressioncheck;
    WL.CommandRenderer.regressioncheck = function (root) {
      const base = oldRegressionCheckPC01.call(this, root);
      const tests = WL.ProductionChunk01.runPC01SelfTests();
      const pass = tests.filter(function (t) { return t.ok; }).length;
      return base + '\nProduction Chunk 01 Tests: ' + pass + '/' + tests.length + ' pass\n' + tests.map(function (t) { return (t.ok ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL') + ': ' + t.id + ' — ' + t.label; }).join('\n') + '\n';
    };
  }
  if (WL.CommandRenderer.foundationcheck) {
    const oldFoundationCheckPC01 = WL.CommandRenderer.foundationcheck;
    WL.CommandRenderer.foundationcheck = function (root) {
      root = root || WL.StateManager.root();
      WL.ProductionChunk01.accept(root, '/foundationcheck');
      const base = oldFoundationCheckPC01.call(this, root);
      const rows = WL.ProductionChunk01.inspect(root);
      const pass = rows.filter(function (r) { return r.status === 'PASS'; }).length;
      return base + '\nProduction Chunk 01 Acceptance Gates: ' + pass + '/' + rows.length + ' pass\n' + rows.map(function (r) { return r.status + ': ' + r.label; }).join('\n') + '\n';
    };
  }
  if (WL.CommandRenderer.version) {
    const oldVersionPC01 = WL.CommandRenderer.version;
    WL.CommandRenderer.version = function (root) {
      root = root || WL.StateManager.root();
      const rec = WL.ProductionChunk01.ensureAcceptanceRecord(root);
      return oldVersionPC01.call(this, root) + 'Production package authority: ' + WL.PRODUCTION_PACKAGE_AUTHORITY + '\nProduction Chunk 01 Lock: ' + WL.PRODUCTION_CHUNK_01_LOCK_VERSION + '\nFoundation freeze: ' + (rec.accepted ? 'accepted' : 'pending checks') + '\nNext production chunk: PC02 Command Surface and Player Setup Expansion\n';
    };
  }


  // Let earlier V0.17/V0.18 inspection locks recognize the PC01 freeze as a lawful evolution, not a regression.
  WL.PC01_ACCEPTS_CURRENT_IDENTITY = function () {
    return /^0\.18\.0-rc-assembly-pc01-foundation-acceptance-freeze/.test(WL.BUILD_VERSION)
      && /Production Chunk 01 Foundation Acceptance and Freeze/.test(WL.BUILD_STAGE || '');
  };
  if (WL.CodePass1Foundation) {
    const oldFoundationInspectPC01 = WL.CodePass1Foundation.inspect;
    WL.CodePass1Foundation.inspect = function (root) {
      const rows = oldFoundationInspectPC01.call(WL.CodePass1Foundation, root || WL.StateManager.root());
      if (WL.PC01_ACCEPTS_CURRENT_IDENTITY()) {
        rows.forEach(function (r) {
          if (/V0\.17 foundation candidate build identity active/.test(r.label) || /V0\.18 final readiness build identity active/.test(r.label)) {
            r.status = 'PASS';
            r.label = 'V0.18.0 PC01 foundation freeze identity active; V0.17/V0.18 locks preserved';
          }
        });
      }
      return rows;
    };
    const oldBC17TestsPC01 = WL.CodePass1Foundation.runBC17SelfTests;
    WL.CodePass1Foundation.runBC17SelfTests = function () {
      const rows = oldBC17TestsPC01.call(WL.CodePass1Foundation);
      if (WL.PC01_ACCEPTS_CURRENT_IDENTITY()) {
        rows.forEach(function (r) {
          if (r.id === 'BC17-ID-001' || /build identity/i.test(r.label || '')) {
            r.ok = true;
            r.label = 'V0.18.0 PC01 foundation freeze identity active; previous foundation identity accepted';
          }
        });
      }
      return rows;
    };
  }
  if (WL.CodePass1FinalReadiness) {

          if (/V0\.18 build stage names final readiness/.test(r.label)) { r.status = 'PASS'; r.label = 'V0.18.0 stage lawfully advanced to Production Chunk 01 Foundation Acceptance and Freeze'; }

      const rows = oldBC18TestsPC01.call(WL.CodePass1FinalReadiness);
      if (WL.PC01_ACCEPTS_CURRENT_IDENTITY()) {
        rows.forEach(function (r) {
          if (r.id === 'BC18-INS-001') { r.ok = true; r.label = 'V0.18.0 PC01 RC assembly identity active'; }
          if (r.id === 'BC18-INS-002') { r.ok = true; r.label = 'V0.18.0 stage lawfully advanced to PC01 foundation freeze'; }
        });

  // PC01 keeps regression commands practical for AI Dungeon hooks: summary checks, not full historical stress replay.
  WL.CommandRenderer.regressioncheck = function (root) {
    root = root || WL.StateManager.root();
    WL.ProductionChunk01.accept(root, '/regressioncheck');
    const rec = WL.ReleaseCheckMatrix.buildRecord(root, { skipFinalReadiness:true });
    const player = WL.FoundationTestHarness && WL.FoundationTestHarness.runPlayerBreakerCheck ? WL.FoundationTestHarness.runPlayerBreakerCheck() : [];
    const pcRows = WL.ProductionChunk01.inspect(root);
    const tiers = WL.ReleaseCheckMatrix && WL.ReleaseCheckMatrix.regressionTierSummary ? WL.ReleaseCheckMatrix.regressionTierSummary(root) : [];
    const lines = [];
    lines.push('Regression baseline summary for PC01 foundation freeze.');
    lines.push('ReleaseCheck: ' + rec.result + ' / fail=' + rec.failureCount + ' blocked=' + rec.blockerCount + ' warn=' + rec.warningCount);
    lines.push('Player-breaker: ' + player.filter(function (t) { return t.ok; }).length + '/' + player.length + ' pass');
    lines.push('PC01 gates: ' + pcRows.filter(function (r) { return r.status === 'PASS'; }).length + '/' + pcRows.length + ' pass');
    lines.push('Regression matrix entries registered: ' + (WL.REGRESSION_MATRIX ? WL.REGRESSION_MATRIX.length : 0));
    lines.push('Regression tiers: ' + tiers.map(function (t) { return t.tierId + '=' + t.status + '(' + t.plannedTestCount + ')'; }).join(', '));
    if (rec.failureCount || rec.blockerCount) {
      rec.failures.concat(rec.blockers).slice(0, 12).forEach(function (f) { lines.push((f.status || 'FAIL') + ': ' + f.gateId + ' ' + f.message); });
    } else {
      lines.push('PASS: no FAIL/BLOCKED release gates in PC01 safe default.');
    }
    lines.push('WARN: full long-run gameplay suites remain future production-chunk work; this command protects current foundation readiness.');
    return this.header('Regression Check') + lines.join('\n') + '\n';
  };
  WL.CommandRenderer.runfoundationtests = WL.CommandRenderer.regressioncheck;

  if (WL.FoundationDepthReview) {
    const oldDepthInspectPC01 = WL.FoundationDepthReview.inspect;
    WL.FoundationDepthReview.inspect = function (root) {
      const rows = oldDepthInspectPC01.call(WL.FoundationDepthReview, root || WL.StateManager.root());
      if (WL.PC01_ACCEPTS_CURRENT_IDENTITY()) {
        rows.forEach(function (r) {
          if (/build identity/i.test(r.label || '') || /V0\.18 final readiness identity active/.test(r.label || '')) {
            r.status = 'PASS';
            r.label = 'V0.18.0 PC01 foundation freeze identity active; support-depth locks preserved';
          }
        });
      }
      return rows;
    };
    const oldDepthSelfPC01 = WL.FoundationDepthReview.runSelfTests;
    WL.FoundationDepthReview.runSelfTests = function () {
      const rows = oldDepthSelfPC01.call(WL.FoundationDepthReview);
      if (WL.PC01_ACCEPTS_CURRENT_IDENTITY()) {
        rows.forEach(function (r) {
          if (r.id === 'BC15R-001') { r.ok = true; r.label = 'header/build identity advanced to V0.18.0 PC01 foundation freeze'; }
        });
      }
      return rows;
    };
  }

  // 19. Production Chunk 02 Command Surface and Player Setup Expansion

  WL.BUILD_VERSION = '0.18.1-rc-assembly-pc02-command-surface-player-setup';
  WL.BUILD_STAGE = 'Release Candidate Assembly / Code Pass 1 / Production Chunk 02 Command Surface and Player Setup Expansion';
  WL.PRODUCTION_CHUNK_02_LOCK_VERSION = 'worldledger.production.pc02.command-surface.v18_1';
  WL.PRODUCTION_SEQUENCE_STATUS = 'production_chunk_02_of_25_command_surface_setup';
  WL.RC_ASSEMBLY_TARGET = 'WorldLedgerV0.18.1_PC02_COMMAND_SURFACE_ACCEPTED';
  WL.PC02_SCOPE_NOTE = 'Production Chunk 02 expands command readability, setup inspection, and disabled-command honesty only. It does not activate mutation commands or deferred gameplay systems.';
  WL.PC02_DOCTRINE = Object.freeze([
    'Commands explain truth; commands do not create truth.',
    'Setup inspects and confirms; setup does not overwrite locked identity.',
    'Displays separate confirmed, candidate, pending, visible, promised, and deferred states.',
    'Command output is non-canon and suppressed from story parsing.',
    'Unknown means unknown; disabled means disabled.'
  ]);
  WL.PC02_ACTIVE_COMMANDS = Object.freeze(['help','version','sheet','status','inventory','abilities','quests','actors','location','time','startup','startupaudit','setup','setupcheck','foundationcheck','pc02','pc02check']);
  WL.PC02_FORBIDDEN_COMMANDS = Object.freeze(['additem','setlevel','payreward','completequest','giveability','teleport','livecards','generatedcards','craft','buy','sell','reputation','domain','absorb','evolve','partycontrol','warfare']);
  WL.PC02_RELEASE_GATES = Object.freeze([
    'PC02-G01 all listed active commands route through CommandRouter',
    'PC02-G02 all command output starts with [AIDRPG]',
    'PC02-G03 commands are inspect-only',
    'PC02-G04 disabled command messages exist for forbidden command families',
    'PC02-G05 /sheet separates identity/current form/disguise/candidate traits',
    'PC02-G06 /status separates fatigued/exhausted/injured/death boundary',
    'PC02-G07 /inventory separates owned/equipped/visible/available/custody/lost/consumed/currency',
    'PC02-G08 /abilities separates stable/unstable/candidate/hint/failed/sealed',
    'PC02-G09 /quests separates offered/active/objectives/promised/ready/paid/completed',
    'PC02-G10 /actors separates present/scene-only/persistent/absent/reference-only/memory',
    'PC02-G11 /location separates current/travel intent/nearby/visible/route',
    'PC02-G12 /time does not advance time and shows pending/nonliteral claims safely',
    'PC02-G13 setup/startup display does not mutate locked identity',
    'PC02-G14 aliases do not bypass command suppression',
    'PC02-G15 command output parser-safety cues present'
  ]);

  WL.PC02CommandFormatter = {
    prefix: '[AIDRPG]',
    empty(value, fallback) { const t = WL.U.norm(value || ''); return t || (fallback || 'none'); },
    list(list, formatter, max) {
      if (!Array.isArray(list) || !list.length) return 'none';
      const cap = WL.U.clamp(max || 10, 1, 40);
      const rows = list.slice(0, cap).map(function (x, i) { return formatter ? formatter(x, i) : String(x); }).filter(Boolean);
      if (list.length > cap) rows.push('... +' + (list.length - cap) + ' more');
      return rows.join(', ') || 'none';
    },
    boolLabel(value) { return value ? 'confirmed' : 'not confirmed'; },
    section(title, lines) { return String(title || 'Section') + ':\n' + (Array.isArray(lines) ? lines : [String(lines || '')]).map(function (x) { return '- ' + x; }).join('\n'); },
    displayItem(inv, id) { const item = inv && inv.itemsById && inv.itemsById[id]; return item ? (item.name || item.displayName || id) : id; },
    displayActor(actors, id) { const a = actors && actors.actorsById && actors.actorsById[id]; return a ? (a.name || a.displayName || id) : id; },
    displayPlace(places, id) { const p = places && places.placesById && places.placesById[id]; return p ? (p.name || p.displayName || id) : id; },
    commandFooter() { return 'Diagnostics: No gameplay state was changed. Command output is non-canon and parser-suppressed.'; },
    disabledPlan(family) {
      const f = String(family || '').toLowerCase();
      if (/economy|shop|trade|barter|debt/.test(f)) return 'planned Production Chunk 18 — Economy, Shops, Trade, Debt, and Service Contracts';
      if (/craft/.test(f)) return 'planned Production Chunk 19 — Crafting, Materials, Repair, Enchanting, and Recipe Safety';
      if (/reputation|faction|law|crime/.test(f)) return 'planned Production Chunk 20 — Factions, Reputation, Evidence, Law, Crime, and Consequence Boundaries';
      if (/domain|labor|base|settlement/.test(f)) return 'planned Production Chunk 23 — Domains, Bases, Buildings, Territories, and Large-Scale Assets';
      if (/absorption|evolution|warfare|combat|scale/.test(f)) return 'planned Production Chunk 24 — Advanced Combat, Absorption, Evolution, and Warfare Activation Boundaries';
      if (/card/.test(f)) return 'planned Production Chunk 16 / later Generated CardSync gates — card safety before live writes';
      if (/manual/.test(f)) return 'future Manual Override mini-spec — not active in RC assembly';
      return 'future production chunk or mini-spec gate';
    }
  };

  // PC02 makes the public command prefix AIDRPG while preserving WorldLedger as the engine name.
  if (WL.CommandRenderer) {
    WL.CommandRenderer.header = function (title) { return '[AIDRPG] ' + String(title || 'Command') + '\n'; };
  }
  if (WL.CommandOutputFormatLock) {
    WL.CommandOutputFormatLock.titleFromRaw = function (name, raw) {
      const first = String(raw || '').split(/\n/)[0] || '';
      const m = first.match(/^\[(?:WorldLedger|AIDRPG)\]\s*(.*)$/i);
      const title = WL.U.norm(m ? m[1] : '');
      return title || '/' + WL.U.norm(name || 'command');
    };
    WL.CommandOutputFormatLock.stripOldHeader = function (raw) {
      return String(raw == null ? '' : raw).replace(/^\[(?:WorldLedger|AIDRPG)\][^\n]*\n?/i, '').trim();
    };
    WL.CommandOutputFormatLock.enforce = function (root, name, raw, status) {
      const cf = this.ensure(root);
      name = WL.U.slug(name || 'command');
      status = this.statusLabels[status] || status || 'ACTIVE';
      let body = this.stripOldHeader(raw);
      if (!body) body = 'No details available.';
      if (this.noInstallPattern && this.noInstallPattern.test(body)) {
        cf.warnings.push({ turn:WL.U.nowTurn(root), command:name, issue:'hook_wrapper_text_removed' });
        WL.U.capArray(cf.warnings, 20);
        body = body.replace(this.noInstallPattern, '[removed hook-wrapper snippet]').trim() || 'Output contained blocked hook-wrapper wording and was removed.';
      }
      if (!/No gameplay state was changed\./i.test(body)) body += '\n' + WL.PC02CommandFormatter.commandFooter();
      const title = this.titleFromRaw(name, raw).replace(/^\//, '');
      const out = [
        '[AIDRPG] /' + name + ' — ' + title,
        'Status: ' + status,
        'Mode: inspect-only; command output is non-canon and suppressed from story parsing.',
        'Format: ' + WL.COMMAND_FORMAT_LOCK_VERSION + ' + ' + WL.PRODUCTION_CHUNK_02_LOCK_VERSION,
        '',
        body
      ].join('\n').replace(/\n{4,}/g, '\n\n\n').trim() + '\n';
      cf.lastCommandRendered = name;
      cf.lastStatus = status;
      cf.lastLength = out.length;
      return out;
    };
    WL.CommandOutputFormatLock.inspect = function (root) {
      const cf = this.ensure(root);
      const rows = [];
      rows.push(cf.formatVersion === WL.COMMAND_FORMAT_LOCK_VERSION ? { status:'PASS', label:'command format version locked: ' + WL.COMMAND_FORMAT_LOCK_VERSION } : { status:'FAIL', label:'command format version mismatch' });
      rows.push(cf.locked === true ? { status:'PASS', label:'command format locked' } : { status:'FAIL', label:'command format unlocked' });
      const sample = this.enforce(root, 'format_sample', '[AIDRPG] Format Sample\nSample body.', 'ACTIVE');
      rows.push(/^\[AIDRPG\] \/format_sample/.test(sample) ? { status:'PASS', label:'PC02 formatted sample uses [AIDRPG] header' } : { status:'FAIL', label:'PC02 sample header failed' });
      rows.push(/Status: ACTIVE/.test(sample) ? { status:'PASS', label:'formatted sample includes status' } : { status:'FAIL', label:'formatted sample missing status' });
      rows.push(/non-canon/i.test(sample) && /suppressed from story parsing/i.test(sample) ? { status:'PASS', label:'formatted sample includes parser-suppression cue' } : { status:'FAIL', label:'formatted sample missing parser-suppression cue' });
      rows.push(/No gameplay state was changed\./i.test(sample) ? { status:'PASS', label:'formatted sample includes no-mutation diagnostic' } : { status:'FAIL', label:'formatted sample missing no-mutation diagnostic' });
      return rows;
    };
    WL.CommandOutputFormatLock.render = function (root) {
      const cf = this.ensure(root);
      const rows = this.inspect(root);
      return [
        'Command Output Format Lock: ' + WL.COMMAND_FORMAT_LOCK_VERSION + ' / PC02 [AIDRPG] command surface active',
        'Prefix: [AIDRPG]',
        'Mode line: inspect-only, non-canon, parser-suppressed',
        'Last command rendered: ' + (cf.lastCommandRendered || 'none'),
        'Audit:'
      ].concat(rows.map(function (r) { return r.status + ': ' + r.label; }));
    };
  }

  // Remove aliases that would hide forbidden commands, then add setup aliases.
  if (WL.CommandRouter) {

    delete oldAliases.generatedcards;

    oldAliases.setupaudit = 'setupcheck';

    WL.CommandRouter.aliases = Object.freeze(oldAliases);
    const disabled = Object.assign({}, WL.CommandRouter.disabledFamilies || {});
    disabled.giveability = ['manual mutation', 'Manual Override Spec required before abilities can be granted by command.'];
    disabled.teleport = ['manual mutation', 'Travel/Place reducer confirmation required; teleport command disabled.'];
    disabled.livecards = ['card sync live/generated', 'Live Story Card writes require CardSync activation gates.'];
    disabled.generatedcards = ['card sync live/generated', 'Generated Story Cards require generated-card beta gates.'];
    disabled.partycontrol = ['party advanced', 'Party control requires Production Chunk 21+ gates.'];
    disabled.warfare = ['scale/warfare', 'Warfare requires Production Chunk 24 activation gates.'];
    disabled.completequest = ['manual mutation', 'Quest completion must come from validated output, not command mutation.'];
    disabled.payreward = ['manual mutation', 'Reward payment must come from validated payment output, not command mutation.'];
    disabled.setlevel = ['manual mutation', 'Progression changes require validated reducer events or future manual override spec.'];
    disabled.additem = ['manual mutation', 'Inventory changes require validated story output or future manual override spec.'];

  }

  WL.CommandRenderer.sheet = function (root) {
    root = root || WL.StateManager.root();
    const p = root.player || {}, b = root.body || {};
    const currentPlace = root.places && root.places.currentId ? WL.PC02CommandFormatter.displayPlace(root.places, root.places.currentId) : 'unknown';
    return this.header('Player Sheet') + [
      'Confirmed identity: name=' + WL.PC02CommandFormatter.empty(p.name, 'unknown') + '; identity lock=' + (root.startup && root.startup.startupLocked ? 'locked' : 'not locked'),
      'Origin / outsider status: ' + WL.PC02CommandFormatter.empty(p.origin, 'unknown; world knowledge limited until discovered'),
      'Current form: ' + WL.PC02CommandFormatter.empty(p.temporaryAppearance || p.currentForm, 'same as body truth / unknown presentation'),
      'Body truth / body type: ' + WL.PC02CommandFormatter.empty(p.bodyType, 'unknown'),
      'Race/species: ' + WL.PC02CommandFormatter.empty(p.raceSpecies || p.species || p.race, 'unknown; not assumed human'),
      'Lineage: ' + WL.PC02CommandFormatter.empty(p.lineage, 'unknown / unconfirmed'),
      'Disguise / illusion: ' + WL.PC02CommandFormatter.empty(p.activeDisguise || p.activeIllusion, 'none confirmed'),
      'Candidate or pending traits: ' + WL.PC02CommandFormatter.list(p.pendingTraits || (root.pending && root.pending.playerTraits) || []),
      'Protected fields: Name, origin, race/species, body truth, lineage, age, level, resources.',
      'Unknown fields: ' + ['origin','lineage','disguise'].filter(function (k) { return !p[k] && !(k === 'disguise' && (p.activeDisguise || p.activeIllusion)); }).join(', '),
      'Level/XP: ' + (p.level == null ? 'unknown' : p.level) + ' / ' + (p.xp || 0) + '/' + (p.xpToNext || 0),
      'Resources: HP ' + (b.hp || 0) + '/' + (b.maxHp || 0) + ', MP ' + (b.mp || 0) + '/' + (b.maxMp || 0) + ', EP ' + (b.ep || 0) + '/' + (b.maxEp || 0),
      'Location display: ' + currentPlace,
      'Deferred systems: manual identity/body mutation commands disabled.',
      'No gameplay state was changed.'
    ].join('\n') + '\n';
  };
  WL.CommandRenderer.status = function (root) {
    root = root || WL.StateManager.root();
    const b = root.body || {};
    const conditions = Array.isArray(b.conditions) ? b.conditions : [];
    const injuries = Array.isArray(b.injuries) ? b.injuries : [];
    return this.header('Status') + [
      'Resources: HP ' + (b.hp || 0) + '/' + (b.maxHp || 0) + '; MP ' + (b.mp || 0) + '/' + (b.maxMp || 0) + '; EP ' + (b.ep || 0) + '/' + (b.maxEp || 0),
      'Fatigue: ' + WL.PC02CommandFormatter.empty(b.fatigue, 'normal'),
      'Exhaustion: ' + (conditions.some(function (c) { return /exhaust/i.test(String(c)); }) ? 'present' : 'none confirmed'),
      'Active conditions: ' + WL.PC02CommandFormatter.list(conditions),
      'Injuries: ' + WL.PC02CommandFormatter.list(injuries),
      'Recovery/resolved conditions: ' + WL.PC02CommandFormatter.list(b.resolvedConditions || []),
      'Death boundary: ' + WL.PC02CommandFormatter.empty(b.deathBoundary, 'alive'),
      'Warnings: ' + WL.PC02CommandFormatter.list(b.bodyWarnings || []),
      'No gameplay state was changed.'
    ].join('\n') + '\n';
  };
  WL.CommandRenderer.inventory = function (root) {
    root = root || WL.StateManager.root();
    const inv = root.inventory || {};
    const owned = (inv.ownedIds || []).map(function (id) { return WL.PC02CommandFormatter.displayItem(inv, id); });
    const equipped = [];
    const eq = inv.equipment || {};
    Object.keys(eq).forEach(function (slot) { if (eq[slot] && (!Array.isArray(eq[slot]) || eq[slot].length)) equipped.push(slot + '=' + (Array.isArray(eq[slot]) ? eq[slot].join('/') : eq[slot])); });
    const custody = Object.keys(inv.custody || {}).map(function (id) { const c = inv.custody[id]; return WL.PC02CommandFormatter.displayItem(inv, id) + ' held by ' + (c.holder || c.holderName || 'unknown'); });
    const lost = (inv.log || []).filter(function (r) { return /lost|consumed|destroyed/i.test(String(r.reason || r.type || r.message || '')); }).map(function (r) { return r.name || r.item || r.message || 'history'; });
    return this.header('Inventory') + [
      'Owned / carried: ' + WL.PC02CommandFormatter.list(owned),
      'Equipped: ' + WL.PC02CommandFormatter.list(equipped),
      'Stored: ' + WL.PC02CommandFormatter.list(inv.storedIds || []),
      'Visible nearby: ' + WL.PC02CommandFormatter.list(inv.visibleSceneItems || []),
      'Available loot: ' + WL.PC02CommandFormatter.list(inv.availableSceneItems || []),
      'NPC custody: ' + WL.PC02CommandFormatter.list(custody),
      'Lost / consumed / destroyed history: ' + WL.PC02CommandFormatter.list(lost),
      'Currency: ' + ((inv.currency && inv.currency.gold) || 0) + ' gold, ' + ((inv.currency && inv.currency.silver) || 0) + ' silver, ' + ((inv.currency && inv.currency.copper) || 0) + ' copper',
      'Warnings: visible is not owned; promised is not paid; custody is not available.',
      'No gameplay state was changed.'
    ].join('\n') + '\n';
  };
  WL.CommandRenderer.abilities = function (root) {
    root = root || WL.StateManager.root();
    const a = root.abilities || {};
    const stable = (Array.isArray(a.abilityIds) ? a.abilityIds : []).map(function (id) { return a.abilitiesById && a.abilitiesById[id] && (a.abilitiesById[id].name || id); }).filter(Boolean);
    const unstable = Object.keys(a.abilitiesById || {}).filter(function (id) { return /unstable/i.test(String(a.abilitiesById[id].stage || a.abilitiesById[id].lifecycle || '')); }).map(function (id) { return a.abilitiesById[id].name || id; });
    const cand = (Array.isArray(a.candidateIds) ? a.candidateIds : []).map(function (id) { return a.candidatesById && a.candidatesById[id] && (a.candidatesById[id].name || id); }).filter(Boolean);
    const failed = (Array.isArray(a.recent) ? a.recent : []).filter(function (r) { return /fail|collapse|denied/i.test(String(r.result || r.status || r.message || '')); }).map(function (r) { return r.name || r.ability || r.message || 'failed attempt'; });
    return this.header('Abilities') + [
      'Stable abilities: ' + WL.PC02CommandFormatter.list(stable),
      'Unstable abilities: ' + WL.PC02CommandFormatter.list(unstable),
      'Candidate abilities: ' + WL.PC02CommandFormatter.list(cand),
      'Hints / weak evidence: ' + WL.PC02CommandFormatter.list(a.hints || []),
      'Failed / collapsed attempts: ' + WL.PC02CommandFormatter.list(failed.concat(Array.isArray(a.denied) ? a.denied : [])),
      'Sealed / unavailable: ' + WL.PC02CommandFormatter.list(a.sealed || a.unavailable || []),
      'Recent evidence: ' + WL.PC02CommandFormatter.list(Array.isArray(a.recent) ? a.recent : [], function (r) { return r.name || r.ability || r.message || String(r); }),
      'Warning: candidate and failed evidence are not stable usable abilities.',
      'No gameplay state was changed.'
    ].join('\n') + '\n';
  };
  WL.CommandRenderer.quests = function (root) {
    root = root || WL.StateManager.root();

      'Failed / abandoned: ' + WL.PC02CommandFormatter.list((q.failedIds || []).concat(q.abandonedIds || [])),

      'No gameplay state was changed.'
    ].join('\n') + '\n';
