  WL.ProductionChunk02 = {
    lockVersion: WL.PRODUCTION_CHUNK_02_LOCK_VERSION,
    statusFor(ok, label, failStatus) { return { status: ok ? 'PASS' : (failStatus || 'FAIL'), label: label }; },
    snapshot(root) { return WL.ReleaseCheckMatrix && WL.ReleaseCheckMatrix.gameplaySnapshot ? WL.ReleaseCheckMatrix.gameplaySnapshot(root) : WL.U.safeJson({ player:root.player, body:root.body, inventory:root.inventory, abilities:root.abilities, quests:root.quests, actors:root.actors, places:root.places, time:root.time }); },
    activeCommands() { return WL.PC02_ACTIVE_COMMANDS.slice(); },
    missingActiveCommands() {
      const dispatch = WL.CommandRouter && WL.CommandRouter.activeDispatch || {};
      const aliases = WL.CommandRouter && WL.CommandRouter.aliases || {};
      return this.activeCommands().filter(function (cmd) { return !dispatch[cmd] && !aliases[cmd]; });
    },
    outputFor(cmd, root) { return WL.CommandRouter.route(root || WL.StateManager.root(), '/' + cmd); },
    allActiveOutputsStartAidRpg(root) {
      root = root || WL.StateManager.root();
      const cmds = ['help','version','sheet','status','inventory','abilities','quests','actors','location','time','setupcheck','pc02check'];
      return cmds.every(function (cmd) { return /^\[AIDRPG\]/.test(WL.CommandRouter.route(root, '/' + cmd)); });
    },
    commandOutputNoMutation(root, command) {
      root = root || WL.StateManager.root();
      const before = this.snapshot(root);
      WL.CommandRouter.route(root, '/' + command);
      const after = this.snapshot(root);
      return before === after;
    },
    disabledMessagesWork(root) {
      root = root || WL.StateManager.root();
      return WL.PC02_FORBIDDEN_COMMANDS.every(function (cmd) {
        const out = WL.CommandRouter.route(root, '/' + cmd + ' test');
        return /^\[AIDRPG\]/.test(out) && /Status:\s*DEFERRED/i.test(out) && /No gameplay state was changed/i.test(out);
      });
    },
    labelsPresent(output, labels) { return labels.every(function (label) { return new RegExp(label, 'i').test(output); }); },
    inspect(root) {
      root = root || WL.StateManager.root();
      const rows = [];
      rows.push(this.statusFor(/^0\.18\.1-rc-assembly-pc02-command-surface-player-setup/.test(WL.BUILD_VERSION), 'PC02-G00 build identity active: ' + WL.BUILD_VERSION));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(this.missingActiveCommands().length === 0, this.missingActiveCommands().length ? 'PC02-G01 missing active commands: ' + this.missingActiveCommands().join(', ') : 'PC02-G01 all listed active commands route through CommandRouter'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(this.allActiveOutputsStartAidRpg(root), 'PC02-G02 all sampled command outputs start with [AIDRPG]'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(['sheet','status','inventory','abilities','quests','actors','location','time','setupcheck'].every(function (c) { return WL.ProductionChunk02.commandOutputNoMutation(root, c); }), 'PC02-G03 commands are inspect-only'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(this.disabledMessagesWork(root), 'PC02-G04 disabled command messages exist for forbidden families'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(this.labelsPresent(WL.CommandRouter.route(root, '/sheet'), ['Confirmed identity','Current form','Body truth','Race/species','Disguise','Candidate']), 'PC02-G05 /sheet separates identity/form/disguise/candidate traits'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(this.labelsPresent(WL.CommandRouter.route(root, '/status'), ['Fatigue','Exhaustion','Injuries','Death boundary']), 'PC02-G06 /status separates fatigue/exhaustion/injury/death boundary'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(this.labelsPresent(WL.CommandRouter.route(root, '/inventory'), ['Owned / carried','Equipped','Visible nearby','Available loot','NPC custody','Lost / consumed / destroyed','Currency']), 'PC02-G07 /inventory separation labels present'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(this.labelsPresent(WL.CommandRouter.route(root, '/abilities'), ['Stable abilities','Unstable abilities','Candidate abilities','Hints','Failed / collapsed','Sealed / unavailable']), 'PC02-G08 /abilities separation labels present'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(this.labelsPresent(WL.CommandRouter.route(root, '/quests'), ['Offered / rumored','Active','Objectives','Ready-to-turn-in','Promised rewards','Paid rewards','Completed']), 'PC02-G09 /quests separation labels present'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(this.labelsPresent(WL.CommandRouter.route(root, '/actors'), ['Present important','Scene-only','Persistent actors','Absent / reference-only','Witness memories','Relationship notes']), 'PC02-G10 /actors separation labels present'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(this.labelsPresent(WL.CommandRouter.route(root, '/location'), ['Current location','Travel intent','Nearby / visible','Route / interstitial']), 'PC02-G11 /location separation labels present'));
      const timeBefore = WL.U.safeJson(root.time); const timeOut = WL.CommandRouter.route(root, '/time'); const timeAfter = WL.U.safeJson(root.time);
      rows.push(this.statusFor(timeBefore === timeAfter && /Pending \/ nonliteral claims/i.test(timeOut), 'PC02-G12 /time does not advance and shows pending/nonliteral claims'));
      const setupBefore = this.snapshot(root); WL.CommandRouter.route(root, '/setupcheck'); const setupAfter = this.snapshot(root);
      rows.push(this.statusFor(setupBefore === setupAfter, 'PC02-G13 setup/startup display does not mutate locked identity'));
      const aliasOut = WL.CommandRouter.route(root, '/startup');
      rows.push(this.statusFor(/^\[AIDRPG\]/.test(aliasOut) && /Alias: \/startup -> \/startupaudit/i.test(aliasOut), 'PC02-G14 aliases route safely and do not bypass suppression'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(/non-canon/i.test(WL.CommandRouter.route(root, '/help')) && /suppressed from story parsing/i.test(WL.CommandRouter.route(root, '/help')), 'PC02-G15 command output parser-safety cues present'));
      return rows;
    },
    runSelfTests() {
      const results = [];
      const add = function (id, ok, label) { results.push({ id:id, ok:!!ok, label:label }); };
      const preserveState = globalThis.state;
      try {
        globalThis.state = {};
        let root = WL.StateManager.root(), before, after, out;
        out = WL.onInput('/help'); add('PC02-001', /^\[AIDRPG\]/.test(out) && /Commands explain truth|inspect-only/i.test(out), 'Help is honest');
        out = WL.onInput('/version'); add('PC02-002', /AIDRPG.*WorldLedger/i.test(out) && /0\.18\.1/.test(out), 'Version bridge clear');
        out = WL.onInput('/sheet'); add('PC02-003', /Confirmed identity/i.test(out) && /Current form/i.test(out) && /Disguise/i.test(out), 'Sheet separates identity and form');
        add('PC02-004', /not assumed human|unknown/i.test(out), 'Unknown race is not assumed human');
        out = WL.onInput('/status'); add('PC02-005', /Fatigue/i.test(out) && /Death boundary/i.test(out), 'Status separates fatigue and death boundary');
        root = WL.StateManager.root(); root.inventory.visibleSceneItems.push('silver key on table'); out = WL.onInput('/inventory'); add('PC02-006', /Owned \/ carried:\s*none/i.test(out) && /Visible nearby:.*silver key/i.test(out), 'Inventory separates visible and owned');
        root = WL.StateManager.root(); root.abilities.candidatesById.ability_ember_ward = { id:'ability_ember_ward', name:'Ember Ward', stage:'candidate' }; root.abilities.candidateIds.push('ability_ember_ward'); out = WL.onInput('/abilities'); add('PC02-007', /Candidate abilities:.*Ember Ward/i.test(out) && /Stable abilities:\s*none/i.test(out), 'Abilities separate candidate and stable');
        root = WL.StateManager.root(); root.quests.rewardPromises.push({ text:'15 gold promised', paid:false }); out = WL.onInput('/quests'); add('PC02-008', /Promised rewards:.*15 gold/i.test(out) && /Paid rewards:\s*none/i.test(out), 'Quests separate promise and payment');
        root = WL.StateManager.root(); root.actors.actorsById.actor_mara = { id:'actor_mara', name:'Mara', present:false }; root.actors.referencedIds.push('actor_mara'); out = WL.onInput('/actors'); add('PC02-009', /Absent \/ reference-only actors:.*Mara/i.test(out), 'Actors separate reference-only');
        root = WL.StateManager.root(); root.places.travelIntent = 'chapel'; out = WL.onInput('/location'); add('PC02-010', /Travel intent: chapel/i.test(out), 'Location separates travel intent');
        root = WL.StateManager.root(); before = WL.U.safeJson(root.time); out = WL.onInput('/time'); after = WL.U.safeJson(WL.StateManager.root().time); add('PC02-011', before === after && /does not age or advance time|nonliteral/i.test(out), 'Time command does not advance time');
        out = WL.onInput('/additem Crown of Dawn'); root = WL.StateManager.root(); add('PC02-012', /Status:\s*DEFERRED/i.test(out) && !root.inventory.itemsById.item_crown_of_dawn, 'Disabled mutation command safe');
        out = WL.onInput('/startup'); add('PC02-013', /^\[AIDRPG\]/.test(out) && /Alias: \/startup -> \/startupaudit/i.test(out), 'Alias safety');
        before = WL.ProductionChunk02.snapshot(WL.StateManager.root()); WL.onOutput(out + '\nOwned / carried: Crown of Dawn'); after = WL.ProductionChunk02.snapshot(WL.StateManager.root()); add('PC02-014', before === after, 'Command output cannot become canon');
        root = WL.StateManager.root(); root.player.name = 'Locked Name'; root.startup.startupLocked = true; before = WL.ProductionChunk02.snapshot(root); WL.onInput('/setupcheck'); after = WL.ProductionChunk02.snapshot(WL.StateManager.root()); add('PC02-015', before === after, 'Setup display does not unlock identity');
      } catch (e) { add('PC02-ERR', false, 'PC02 self-test exception: ' + (e && e.message || e)); }
      finally { globalThis.state = preserveState; }
      return results;
    },
    render(root) {
      root = root || WL.StateManager.root();
      const rows = this.inspect(root);
      const pass = rows.filter(function (r) { return r.status === 'PASS'; }).length;
      return [
        'Production Chunk 02: Command Surface and Player Setup Expansion',
        'Lock: ' + this.lockVersion,
        'Scope: command honesty/setup display only; no gameplay expansion.',
        'Gates: ' + pass + '/' + rows.length + ' pass',
        'Doctrine:'
      ].concat(WL.PC02_DOCTRINE.map(function (d) { return '- ' + d; })).concat(['Gate audit:']).concat(rows.map(function (r) { return r.status + ': ' + r.label; }));
    }
  };

  WL.PC03_REQUIRED_BUCKETS = Object.freeze(['meta','features','runtime','startup','player','body','progression','inventory','abilities','quests','actors','places','time','cards','operationLedger','audits','migration','quarantine','dirty','cleanup','schema','integrity']);
  WL.PC03_BUCKET_VERSION_KEYS = WL.PC03_REQUIRED_BUCKETS.slice();
  WL.PC03_LEDGER_BUCKETS = Object.freeze(['permanentKeys','recentKeys','rewardKeys','cardKeys','sourceUseKeys','startupOperationKeys','migrationOperationKeys','itemKeys','abilityKeys','timeKeys','questKeys','actorKeys','placeKeys','progressionKeys','combatKeys','craftingKeys','economyKeys','reputationKeys']);
  WL.PC03_QUARANTINE_CATEGORIES = Object.freeze(['legacy_root','legacy_card_prose','malformed_bucket','invalid_resource','invalid_item','invalid_ability','invalid_quest','invalid_actor','invalid_place','invalid_time','invalid_progression','unsafe_command_text','unsafe_context_text','unsafe_card_text','future_schema','manual_edit_conflict','migration_failure']);
  WL.PC03_DEFERRED_FLAGS = Object.freeze(['economyEnabled','craftingEnabled','investigationEnabled','reputationEnabled','domainEnabled','absorptionEnabled','advancedCombatEnabled','warfareEnabled','multiProtagonistEnabled','partyAdvancedEnabled','generatedCardsEnabled','protectedCardWritesEnabled','manualMutationCommandsEnabled']);
  WL.PC03_DEFERRED_META = Object.freeze({
    economyEnabled:{ plannedChunk:'PC18', reason:'economy/trade/debt requires accepted inventory/currency/contract boundaries first' },
    craftingEnabled:{ plannedChunk:'PC19', reason:'crafting requires materials/recipe/repair spec and custody safety first' },
    investigationEnabled:{ plannedChunk:'PC20', reason:'investigation requires evidence/witness/reputation law boundaries first' },
    reputationEnabled:{ plannedChunk:'PC20', reason:'reputation/faction automation remains deferred until evidence and public/private knowledge gates are ready' },
    domainEnabled:{ plannedChunk:'PC23', reason:'domain/labor/building logic requires asset and territory boundaries first' },
    absorptionEnabled:{ plannedChunk:'PC24', reason:'absorption/evolution requires transformation and advanced combat gates first' },
    advancedCombatEnabled:{ plannedChunk:'PC12/PC24', reason:'combat automation requires formula matrix and damage/healing dispute resolver first' },
    warfareEnabled:{ plannedChunk:'PC24', reason:'warfare requires party/scale/entity coordination gates first' },
    multiProtagonistEnabled:{ plannedChunk:'PC24', reason:'multi-protagonist state requires separate ownership and context gates' },
    partyAdvancedEnabled:{ plannedChunk:'PC21/PC24', reason:'party advanced logic requires companion/consent/control boundaries first' },
    generatedCardsEnabled:{ plannedChunk:'PC16+', reason:'generated cards require protected registry, duplicate gates, and write budgets first' },
    protectedCardWritesEnabled:{ plannedChunk:'PC16+', reason:'live protected writes require safe adapter and duplicate singleton tests first' },
    manualMutationCommandsEnabled:{ plannedChunk:'future manual override spec', reason:'manual mutation needs explicit command authority and audit gates' }
  });

  WL.PC03SchemaDeepener = {
    lockVersion: WL.PRODUCTION_CHUNK_03_LOCK_VERSION,
    object(value) { return value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value); },
    ensureObject(parent, key) { if (!this.object(parent[key])) parent[key] = {}; return parent[key]; },
    ensureArray(parent, key) { if (!Array.isArray(parent[key])) parent[key] = []; return parent[key]; },
    safePreview(value, max) {
      max = max || 260;
      try { return JSON.stringify(value).slice(0, max); } catch (e) { return String(value == null ? '' : value).slice(0, max); }
    },
    init(root) { return this.deepen(root || WL.StateManager.root()); },
    deepen(root) {
      if (!this.object(root)) return root;
      this.ensureTopLevelBuckets(root);
      this.ensureSchema(root);
      this.ensureFeatures(root);
      this.ensureStartup(root);
      this.ensurePlayer(root);
      this.ensureBody(root);
      this.ensureProgression(root);
      this.ensureInventory(root);
      this.ensureAbilities(root);
      this.ensureQuests(root);
      this.ensureActors(root);
      this.ensurePlaces(root);
      this.ensureTime(root);
      this.ensureCards(root);
      this.ensureOperationLedger(root);
      this.ensureMigration(root);
      this.ensureQuarantine(root);
      this.ensureDirty(root);
      this.ensureCleanup(root);
      this.ensureIntegrity(root);
      this.detectLegacyRoots(root);
      this.structuralRepair(root);
      this.updateSchemaTurn(root);
      return root;
    },
    ensureTopLevelBuckets(root) {
      for (let i = 0; i < WL.PC03_REQUIRED_BUCKETS.length; i++) this.ensureObject(root, WL.PC03_REQUIRED_BUCKETS[i]);
      if (root.layout && !this.object(root.layout)) root.layout = {};
      if (root.commandFormat && !this.object(root.commandFormat)) root.commandFormat = {};
      if (root.pending && !this.object(root.pending)) root.pending = {};
    },
    ensureSchema(root) {
      const s = this.ensureObject(root, 'schema');
      s.schemaId = WL.SCHEMA_ID;
      s.schemaVersion = s.schemaVersion || '1.0.0';
      s.stateVersion = WL.BUILD_VERSION;
      s.createdBy = 'WorldLedger';
      if (typeof s.lastCheckedTurn !== 'number') s.lastCheckedTurn = 0;
      if (typeof s.lastMigrationTurn !== 'number') s.lastMigrationTurn = 0;
      const bv = this.ensureObject(s, 'bucketVersions');
      WL.PC03_BUCKET_VERSION_KEYS.forEach(function (k) { if (bv[k] == null) bv[k] = 1; });
      s.requiredBuckets = WL.PC03_REQUIRED_BUCKETS.slice();
      s.optionalDisabledBuckets = WL.PC03_DEFERRED_FLAGS.slice();
      this.ensureArray(s, 'knownLegacyRoots');
      this.ensureArray(s, 'warnings');
      this.ensureArray(s, 'notes');
      root.schemaVersion = WL.SCHEMA_VERSION;
      if (root.meta) {
        root.meta.schemaId = WL.SCHEMA_ID;
        root.meta.buildStage = WL.BUILD_STAGE;
        root.meta.schemaReadinessLock = this.lockVersion;
      }
      if (root.build) { root.build.buildVersion = WL.BUILD_VERSION; root.build.buildStage = WL.BUILD_STAGE; }
      return s;
    },
    ensureFeatures(root) {
      const f = this.ensureObject(root, 'features');
      if (!this.object(f.deferredMetadata)) f.deferredMetadata = {};
      WL.PC03_DEFERRED_FLAGS.forEach(function (flag) { f[flag] = false; f.deferredMetadata[flag] = Object.assign({}, WL.PC03_DEFERRED_META[flag] || { plannedChunk:'future', reason:'deferred by PC03 schema readiness' }); });
      if (!this.object(f.activeFoundation)) f.activeFoundation = {};
      ['stateManager','runtime','commandRouter','auditLogger','operationLedger','eventScannerLite','proposalBuilder','canonValidator','reducerRegistry','dirtyQueue','contextBuilderLite','cardSyncLiteDryRun','releaseCheck'].forEach(function (k) { f.activeFoundation[k] = true; });
      this.ensureArray(f, 'warnings');
      this.ensureArray(f, 'notes');
    },
    ensureStartup(root) {
      const s = this.ensureObject(root, 'startup');
      if (typeof s.locked !== 'boolean') s.locked = !!s.startupLocked;
      if (typeof s.firstGameplayInputSeen !== 'boolean') s.firstGameplayInputSeen = !!s.gameplayStarted;
      s.setupSourceStatus = s.setupSourceStatus || s.setupStatus || 'unknown';
      s.setupSourceKey = s.setupSourceKey || s.setupSourceHash || '';
      if (typeof s.identityLockedAtTurn !== 'number') s.identityLockedAtTurn = s.setupLockedTurn || 0;
      this.ensureArray(s, 'startupOperationKeys');
      this.ensureArray(s, 'importedFields');
      this.ensureArray(s, 'unknownFields');
      this.ensureArray(s, 'warnings');
      this.ensureArray(s, 'notes');
      if (s.startupLocked) s.locked = true;
    },
    ensurePlayer(root) {
      const p = this.ensureObject(root, 'player');
      p.id = p.id || 'player';
      if (p.displayName == null) p.displayName = p.name || 'Unknown';
      this.ensureArray(p, 'aliases');
      p.identityStatus = p.identityStatus || (p.name && p.name !== 'Unknown' ? 'confirmed' : 'unknown');
      if (p.origin == null) p.origin = '';
      if (p.worldKnowledgeStatus == null) p.worldKnowledgeStatus = 'limited';
      if (p.trueRaceSpecies == null) p.trueRaceSpecies = p.raceSpecies || p.species || p.race || 'unknown';
      if (p.lineage == null) p.lineage = '';
      if (p.currentForm == null) p.currentForm = p.temporaryAppearance || '';
      if (p.bodyType == null) p.bodyType = 'unknown';
      if (p.disguise == null) p.disguise = p.activeDisguise || '';
      if (p.illusion == null) p.illusion = p.activeIllusion || '';
      if (p.presentation == null) p.presentation = '';
      this.ensureArray(p, 'protectedFields');
      this.ensureArray(p, 'candidateTraits');
      this.ensureArray(p, 'pendingTraits');
      this.ensureArray(p, 'warnings');
      this.ensureArray(p, 'notes');
    },
    ensureTrack(obj, key, currentFallback, maxFallback) {
      if (!this.object(obj[key])) obj[key] = {};
      const t = obj[key];
      if (typeof t.max !== 'number') t.max = Number(maxFallback || 0);
      if (typeof t.current !== 'number') t.current = Number(currentFallback == null ? t.max : currentFallback);
      if (t.max < 0) t.max = 0;
      if (t.current < 0) t.current = 0;
      if (t.current > t.max) t.current = t.max;
      return t;
    },
    ensureBody(root) {
      const b = this.ensureObject(root, 'body');
      if (!this.object(b.resources)) b.resources = {};
      const hp = this.ensureTrack(b.resources, 'hp', b.hp == null ? 100 : b.hp, b.maxHp == null ? 100 : b.maxHp);
      const mp = this.ensureTrack(b.resources, 'mp', b.mp == null ? 50 : b.mp, b.maxMp == null ? 50 : b.maxMp);
      const ep = this.ensureTrack(b.resources, 'ep', b.ep == null ? 100 : b.ep, b.maxEp == null ? 100 : b.maxEp);
      b.hp = hp.current; b.maxHp = hp.max; b.mp = mp.current; b.maxMp = mp.max; b.ep = ep.current; b.maxEp = ep.max;
      if (b.fatigue == null) b.fatigue = 'normal';
      this.ensureArray(b, 'conditions');
      this.ensureArray(b, 'injuries');
      if (!/^(alive|unconscious|dying|dead|unknown)$/i.test(String(b.deathBoundary || ''))) b.deathBoundary = 'unknown';
      if (!b.deathBoundary) b.deathBoundary = 'alive';
      this.ensureArray(b, 'bodyTraits');
      this.ensureArray(b, 'formConstraints');
      this.ensureArray(b, 'warnings');
      this.ensureArray(b, 'notes');
    },
    ensureProgression(root) {
      const p = this.ensureObject(root, 'progression');
      if (typeof p.level !== 'number') p.level = root.player && typeof root.player.level === 'number' ? root.player.level : 1;
      if (typeof p.currentXP !== 'number') p.currentXP = root.player && typeof root.player.xp === 'number' ? root.player.xp : 0;
      if (typeof p.totalXP !== 'number') p.totalXP = p.currentXP || 0;
      if (typeof p.xpToNext !== 'number') p.xpToNext = root.player && typeof root.player.xpToNext === 'number' ? root.player.xpToNext : 100;
      if (!this.object(p.stats)) p.stats = { ATK:10, DEF:10, SPD:10, INT:10, LCK:10 };
      if (!this.object(p.baseStats)) p.baseStats = Object.assign({}, p.stats);
      if (!this.object(p.modifiers)) p.modifiers = {};
      if (!this.object(p.derivedSnapshot)) p.derivedSnapshot = {};
      if (!this.object(p.statXP)) p.statXP = p.statXp || { atk:0, def:0, spd:0, int:0, lck:0 };
      this.ensureArray(p, 'histories');
      p.formulaProfile = p.formulaProfile || 'foundation_limited';
      p.formulasEnabled = false;
      this.ensureArray(p, 'warnings');
      this.ensureArray(p, 'notes');
    },
    ensureInventory(root) {
      const inv = this.ensureObject(root, 'inventory');
      if (!this.object(inv.items)) inv.items = inv.itemsById || {};
      if (!this.object(inv.itemsById)) inv.itemsById = inv.items || {};
      if (!this.object(inv.equipped)) inv.equipped = inv.equipment || {};
      if (!this.object(inv.stored)) inv.stored = {};
      this.ensureArray(inv, 'sceneItems');
      if (!Array.isArray(inv.visibleSceneItems)) inv.visibleSceneItems = inv.sceneItems;
      if (!this.object(inv.custody)) inv.custody = {};
      if (!this.object(inv.currency)) inv.currency = { copper:0, silver:0, gold:0 };
      this.ensureArray(inv, 'itemHistory');
      this.ensureArray(inv, 'warnings');
      this.ensureArray(inv, 'notes');
      Object.keys(inv.itemsById || {}).forEach((id) => {
        const item = inv.itemsById[id];
        if (!this.object(item)) return;
        item.id = item.id || id;
        item.key = item.key || WL.U.slug(item.displayName || item.name || id);
        item.displayName = item.displayName || item.name || id.replace(/^item_/, '').replace(/_/g, ' ');
        if (typeof item.quantity !== 'number') item.quantity = 1;
        item.category = item.category || 'unknown';
        if (!Array.isArray(item.tags)) item.tags = [];
        if (typeof item.stackable !== 'boolean') item.stackable = item.quantity > 1;
        if (item.durability == null) item.durability = '';
        item.accessState = item.accessState || 'available';
        if (!this.object(item.source)) item.source = { kind:'unknown', opKey:'' };
        if (item.quantity < 0) { this.quarantine(root, 'invalid_item', 'inventory.itemsById', id, item, 'negative item quantity', 'medium', 'Keep inactive until manually reviewed.'); item.accessState = 'quarantined'; item.quantity = 0; }
      });
    },
    ensureAbilities(root) {
      const a = this.ensureObject(root, 'abilities');
      if (!this.object(a.records)) a.records = a.abilitiesById || {};
      this.ensureArray(a, 'stable');
      this.ensureArray(a, 'unstable');
      if (!this.object(a.candidates)) a.candidates = a.candidatesById || {};
      this.ensureArray(a, 'hints');
      this.ensureArray(a, 'failed');
      this.ensureArray(a, 'sealed');
      this.ensureArray(a, 'unavailable');
      this.ensureArray(a, 'evidenceLog');
      this.ensureArray(a, 'warnings');
      this.ensureArray(a, 'notes');
    },
    ensureQuests(root) {
      const q = this.ensureObject(root, 'quests');
      if (!this.object(q.records)) q.records = q.questsById || {};
      this.ensureArray(q, 'active');
      this.ensureArray(q, 'offered');
      this.ensureArray(q, 'rumored');
      this.ensureArray(q, 'readyToTurnIn');
      this.ensureArray(q, 'completed');
      this.ensureArray(q, 'failed');
      this.ensureArray(q, 'abandoned');
      if (!this.object(q.rewardLedger)) q.rewardLedger = { promises:[], payments:[], denied:[] };
      if (!Array.isArray(q.rewardLedger.promises)) q.rewardLedger.promises = q.rewardPromises || [];
      if (!Array.isArray(q.rewardLedger.payments)) q.rewardLedger.payments = q.rewardPayments || [];
      this.ensureArray(q, 'warnings');
      this.ensureArray(q, 'notes');
    },
    ensureActors(root) {
      const a = this.ensureObject(root, 'actors');
      if (!this.object(a.records)) a.records = a.actorsById || {};
      this.ensureArray(a, 'sceneActors');
      this.ensureArray(a, 'present');
      this.ensureArray(a, 'absent');
      this.ensureArray(a, 'referenceOnly');
      this.ensureObject(a, 'memories');
      this.ensureArray(a, 'relationshipNotes');
      this.ensureArray(a, 'warnings');
      this.ensureArray(a, 'notes');
    },
    ensurePlaces(root) {
      const p = this.ensureObject(root, 'places');
      p.currentLocation = p.currentLocation || p.currentId || '';
      p.currentScene = p.currentScene || p.sceneId || '';
      if (!this.object(p.records)) p.records = p.placesById || {};
      if (p.travelIntent == null) p.travelIntent = '';
      this.ensureArray(p, 'visibleReferences');
      this.ensureArray(p, 'nearbyReferences');
      this.ensureArray(p, 'routeReferences');
      this.ensureArray(p, 'sceneHistory');
      this.ensureArray(p, 'warnings');
      this.ensureArray(p, 'notes');
    },
    ensureTime(root) {
      const t = this.ensureObject(root, 'time');
      t.text = t.text || ('Day ' + (t.day || 1) + ' ' + String(t.hour == null ? 8 : t.hour).padStart(2,'0') + ':' + String(t.minute == null ? 0 : t.minute).padStart(2,'0'));
      if (typeof t.turn !== 'number') t.turn = WL.U.nowTurn(root);
      if (typeof t.sequence !== 'number') t.sequence = 0;
      if (!this.object(t.lastAdvance)) t.lastAdvance = {};
      this.ensureArray(t, 'acceptedAdvances');
      this.ensureArray(t, 'pendingClaims');
      this.ensureArray(t, 'deadlines');
      if (!this.object(t.agePolicy)) t.agePolicy = { mode:'cautious', mutateAgeOnlyOnLiteralAcceptedSkip:true, quoteDreamRumorBlocked:true };
      this.ensureArray(t, 'warnings');
      this.ensureArray(t, 'notes');
    },
    ensureCards(root) {
      const c = this.ensureObject(root, 'cards');
      if (!this.object(c.protectedCards)) c.protectedCards = {};
      if (!this.object(c.registry)) c.registry = {};
      this.ensureArray(c, 'dirtyCards');
      this.ensureArray(c, 'tombstones');
      this.ensureArray(c, 'duplicateWarnings');
      c.apiStatus = c.apiStatus || 'unavailable_or_untested';
      c.syncMode = 'dry_run';
      if (!this.object(c.lastDryRun)) c.lastDryRun = {};
      c.generatedCardsEnabled = false;
      c.protectedCardWritesEnabled = false;
      this.ensureArray(c, 'warnings');
      this.ensureArray(c, 'notes');
    },
    ensureOperationLedger(root) {
      const l = this.ensureObject(root, 'operationLedger');
      WL.PC03_LEDGER_BUCKETS.forEach(function (name) {
        if (name === 'recentKeys') { if (!Array.isArray(l.recentKeys)) l.recentKeys = []; }
        else if (!l[name] || typeof l[name] !== 'object' || Array.isArray(l[name])) l[name] = {};
      });
      if (typeof l.maxRecentKeys !== 'number') l.maxRecentKeys = 180;
      this.ensureArray(l, 'duplicateSkips');
      this.ensureArray(l, 'ledgerWarnings');
      l.durableKeysAreProtected = true;
    },
    ensureMigration(root) {
      const m = this.ensureObject(root, 'migration');
      m.currentSchema = WL.SCHEMA_ID;
      m.detectedSchema = m.detectedSchema || WL.SCHEMA_ID;
      m.lastMigrationStatus = m.lastMigrationStatus || 'none_needed';
      this.ensureArray(m, 'migrationsApplied');
      this.ensureArray(m, 'repairLog');
      this.ensureArray(m, 'legacyRootsDetected');
      this.ensureArray(m, 'legacyPayloadsQuarantined');
      this.ensureArray(m, 'futureSchemaWarnings');
      this.ensureArray(m, 'failedMigrations');
      this.ensureArray(m, 'warnings');
      this.ensureArray(m, 'notes');
    },
    ensureQuarantine(root) {
      const q = this.ensureObject(root, 'quarantine');
      q.categories = WL.PC03_QUARANTINE_CATEGORIES.slice();
      this.ensureArray(q, 'records');
      this.ensureArray(q, 'notes');
      q.inactiveClaimsOnly = true;
    },
    ensureDirty(root) {
      const d = this.ensureObject(root, 'dirty');
      this.ensureArray(d, 'targets');
      d.schema = d.schema || 'DirtyTarget{id,family,stateId,reason,priority,createdTurn,lastAttemptTurn,attempts,status}';
      d.allowedFamilies = ['player_sheet','body_status','abilities','inventory_equipment','quest_log','social_memory','current_location','context','card_registry'];
      this.ensureArray(d, 'warnings');
      this.ensureArray(d, 'notes');
    },
    ensureCleanup(root) {
      const c = this.ensureObject(root, 'cleanup');
      if (!this.object(c.protectedPaths)) c.protectedPaths = {};
      ['player','inventory.itemsById','quests.records','actors.records','cards.protectedCards','operationLedger.permanentKeys','operationLedger.rewardKeys','operationLedger.cardKeys','quests.completed','migration.legacyPayloadsQuarantined'].forEach(function (p) { c.protectedPaths[p] = true; });
      if (!this.object(c.caps)) c.caps = { auditLogs:80, dirtyTargets:80, recentOperationKeys:180, cleanupRecordsPerHook:5 };
      this.ensureArray(c, 'warnings');
      this.ensureArray(c, 'notes');
    },
    ensureIntegrity(root) {
      const i = this.ensureObject(root, 'integrity');
      i.lockVersion = this.lockVersion;
      i.lastStatus = i.lastStatus || 'not_checked';
      this.ensureArray(i, 'lastReport');
      this.ensureArray(i, 'warnings');
      this.ensureArray(i, 'notes');
    },
    quarantine(root, category, source, sourceKey, original, reason, severity, suggestedAction) {
      this.ensureQuarantine(root);
      category = WL.PC03_QUARANTINE_CATEGORIES.indexOf(category) >= 0 ? category : 'malformed_bucket';
      const q = root.quarantine;
      const key = category + '|' + String(source || '') + '|' + String(sourceKey || '');
      if (q.records.some(function (r) { return r && r._dedupe === key; })) return null;
      const rec = { quarantineId:'quarantine_' + WL.U.hash(key + '|' + this.safePreview(original, 120)), category:category, source:String(source || ''), sourceKey:String(sourceKey || ''), originalPreview:this.safePreview(original, 360), reason:String(reason || 'quarantined by schema readiness'), severity:String(severity || 'medium'), suggestedAction:String(suggestedAction || 'manual review only'), status:'inactive', createdTurn:WL.U.nowTurn(root), notes:[], _dedupe:key };
      q.records.push(rec);
      WL.U.capArray(q.records, 80);
      return rec;
    },
    detectLegacyRoots(root) {
      const st = WL.U.ensureGlobalState();
      ['aidrpg','tasis','tas','innerSelf','autoCards'].forEach((legacyKey) => {
        if (legacyKey === WL.ROOT_KEY || st[legacyKey] == null) return;
        this.quarantine(root, 'legacy_root', 'state.' + legacyKey, legacyKey, st[legacyKey], 'legacy root detected; preserved as evidence only, not imported as canon', 'medium', 'Review manually if needed; do not auto-import prose.');
        if (root.schema && root.schema.knownLegacyRoots.indexOf(legacyKey) < 0) root.schema.knownLegacyRoots.push(legacyKey);
        if (root.migration && root.migration.legacyRootsDetected.indexOf(legacyKey) < 0) root.migration.legacyRootsDetected.push(legacyKey);
        if (root.migration && root.migration.legacyPayloadsQuarantined.indexOf(legacyKey) < 0) root.migration.legacyPayloadsQuarantined.push(legacyKey);
        try { delete st[legacyKey]; } catch (e) { st[legacyKey] = undefined; }
      });
    },
    structuralRepair(root) {
      this.ensureBody(root);
      this.ensureInventory(root);
      const s = root.schema;
      if (s && typeof s.schemaVersion === 'string' && s.schemaVersion > '1.0.0') {
        const msg = 'Future schema marker detected; no automatic gameplay import performed.';
        if (root.migration.futureSchemaWarnings.indexOf(msg) < 0) root.migration.futureSchemaWarnings.push(msg);
        this.quarantine(root, 'future_schema', 'root.schema', s.schemaVersion, s, msg, 'low', 'Keep current safe schema behavior.');
      }
    },
    updateSchemaTurn(root) {
      if (root.schema) root.schema.lastCheckedTurn = WL.U.nowTurn(root);
      if (root.integrity) root.integrity.lastCheckedTurn = WL.U.nowTurn(root);
    }
  };

  WL.IntegrityChecker = {
    lockVersion: WL.PRODUCTION_CHUNK_03_LOCK_VERSION,
    line(status, label, extra) { return Object.assign({ status:status, label:label }, extra || {}); },
    inspect(root) {
      root = WL.PC03SchemaDeepener.init(root || WL.StateManager.root());
      const out = [];
      const has = function (obj, key) { return !!(obj && typeof obj === 'object' && obj[key] && typeof obj[key] === 'object'); };
      WL.PC03_REQUIRED_BUCKETS.forEach((b) => out.push(this.line(has(root, b) ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL', 'required bucket present: ' + b)));
      out.push(this.line(root.schema && root.schema.schemaId === WL.SCHEMA_ID ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL', 'schema metadata exists and uses locked ID'));
      out.push(this.line(root.schema && root.schema.bucketVersions && WL.PC03_BUCKET_VERSION_KEYS.every(function (b) { return root.schema.bucketVersions[b] != null; }) ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL', 'bucket version metadata exists'));
      out.push(this.line(WL.PC03_DEFERRED_FLAGS.every(function (f) { return root.features && root.features[f] === false; }) ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL', 'all deferred feature placeholders are disabled'));
      ['hp','mp','ep'].forEach((k) => { const tr = root.body && root.body.resources && root.body.resources[k]; out.push(this.line(tr && typeof tr.current === 'number' && typeof tr.max === 'number' && tr.current >= 0 && tr.current <= tr.max ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL', 'numeric resource invariant: ' + k)); });
      const inv = root.inventory && root.inventory.itemsById || {};
      Object.keys(inv).forEach((id) => { const q = inv[id] && inv[id].quantity; if (typeof q === 'number' && q < 0) out.push(this.line('QUARANTINE', 'negative item quantity detected: ' + id)); });
      const stable = (root.abilities && root.abilities.stable || []).map(function (x) { return typeof x === 'string' ? x : (x && (x.key || x.id || x.name)) || ''; }).filter(Boolean);
      const seen = {}; stable.forEach(function (k) { k = WL.U.slug(k); seen[k] = (seen[k] || 0) + 1; });
      Object.keys(seen).forEach((k) => { if (seen[k] > 1) out.push(this.line('WARN', 'duplicate stable ability key detected: ' + k)); });
      const activeQ = (root.quests && root.quests.active || []).map(function (x) { return typeof x === 'string' ? x : (x && (x.key || x.id || x.name)) || ''; }).filter(Boolean);
      const qs = {}; activeQ.forEach(function (k) { k = WL.U.slug(k); qs[k] = (qs[k] || 0) + 1; });
      Object.keys(qs).forEach((k) => { if (qs[k] > 1) out.push(this.line('WARN', 'duplicate active quest key detected: ' + k)); });
      out.push(this.line(/^(alive|unconscious|dying|dead|unknown)$/i.test(String(root.body.deathBoundary || '')), 'deathBoundary value recognized'));
      out.push(this.line(root.features.generatedCardsEnabled === false && root.cards.generatedCardsEnabled === false, 'generated cards disabled'));
      out.push(this.line(root.features.manualMutationCommandsEnabled === false, 'manual mutation disabled'));
      out.push(this.line(WL.PC03_LEDGER_BUCKETS.every(function (b) { return root.operationLedger && (b === 'recentKeys' ? Array.isArray(root.operationLedger[b]) : root.operationLedger[b] && typeof root.operationLedger[b] === 'object' && !Array.isArray(root.operationLedger[b])); }), 'durable ledger buckets exist'));
      out.push(this.line(root.quarantine && root.quarantine.inactiveClaimsOnly === true && (root.quarantine.records || []).every(function (r) { return r.status === 'inactive' || r.status === 'review'; }), 'quarantine records are inactive'));
      out.push(this.line(root.cleanup && root.cleanup.protectedPaths && root.cleanup.protectedPaths['operationLedger.permanentKeys'] === true, 'cleanup protected paths include durable ledgers'));
      root.integrity.lastReport = out;
      root.integrity.lastStatus = out.some(function (r) { return r.status === 'FAIL'; }) ? 'FAIL' : (out.some(function (r) { return r.status === 'WARN' || r.status === 'QUARANTINE'; }) ? 'WARN' : 'PASS');
      return out;
    },
    render(root) {
      const rows = this.inspect(root || WL.StateManager.root());
      const counts = { PASS:0, WARN:0, FAIL:0, QUARANTINE:0 };
      rows.forEach(function (r) { counts[r.status] = (counts[r.status] || 0) + 1; });
      return ['IntegrityChecker Shell: ' + this.lockVersion, 'Result: ' + (counts.FAIL ? 'FAIL' : (counts.WARN || counts.QUARANTINE ? 'WARN' : 'PASS')), 'Counts: PASS ' + counts.PASS + ' / WARN ' + counts.WARN + ' / QUARANTINE ' + counts.QUARANTINE + ' / FAIL ' + counts.FAIL].concat(rows.map(function (r) { return r.status + ': ' + r.label; }));
    }
  };

  WL.ProductionChunk03 = {
    lockVersion: WL.PRODUCTION_CHUNK_03_LOCK_VERSION,
    statusFor(ok, label, failStatus) { return { status: ok ? 'PASS' : (failStatus || 'FAIL'), label: label }; },
    inspect(root) {
      root = WL.PC03SchemaDeepener.init(root || WL.StateManager.root());
      const rows = [];
      const obj = function (x) { return !!(x && typeof x === 'object' && !Array.isArray(x)); };
      rows.push(this.statusFor(/^0\.18\.2-rc-assembly-pc03-state-schema-deepening/.test(WL.BUILD_VERSION), 'PC03-G00 build identity active: ' + WL.BUILD_VERSION));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(obj(root) && !!root.schema && !globalThis.state.aidrpg && !globalThis.state.tas && !globalThis.state.innerSelf && !globalThis.state.autoCards, 'PC03-G01 one canonical state root exists'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(WL.PC03_REQUIRED_BUCKETS.every(function (b) { return obj(root[b]); }), 'PC03-G02 required top-level buckets exist'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(root.schema && root.schema.schemaId === WL.SCHEMA_ID, 'PC03-G03 schema metadata bucket exists'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(root.schema && root.schema.bucketVersions && WL.PC03_BUCKET_VERSION_KEYS.every(function (b) { return root.schema.bucketVersions[b] != null; }), 'PC03-G04 bucket version metadata exists'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(WL.PC03_DEFERRED_FLAGS.every(function (f) { return root.features[f] === false; }), 'PC03-G05 deferred system placeholders are disabled'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(root.startup && 'locked' in root.startup && 'setupSourceStatus' in root.startup && Array.isArray(root.startup.startupOperationKeys), 'PC03-G06 startup lock metadata exists'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(root.player && 'trueRaceSpecies' in root.player && 'currentForm' in root.player && 'disguise' in root.player && Array.isArray(root.player.candidateTraits), 'PC03-G07 player identity/form/disguise fields prepared'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(root.body && root.body.resources && Array.isArray(root.body.conditions) && Array.isArray(root.body.injuries) && 'deathBoundary' in root.body, 'PC03-G08 body resource/status/injury fields prepared'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(root.progression && root.progression.formulaProfile && root.progression.formulasEnabled === false && root.progression.derivedSnapshot, 'PC03-G09 progression formula fields prepared but not over-activated'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(root.inventory && root.inventory.itemsById && root.inventory.custody && root.inventory.currency && Array.isArray(root.inventory.itemHistory), 'PC03-G10 inventory item/access/custody fields prepared'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(root.abilities && root.abilities.records && root.abilities.candidates && Array.isArray(root.abilities.evidenceLog), 'PC03-G11 abilities status/evidence fields prepared'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(root.quests && root.quests.records && root.quests.rewardLedger && Array.isArray(root.quests.rewardLedger.promises) && Array.isArray(root.quests.rewardLedger.payments), 'PC03-G12 quest objective/reward fields prepared'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(root.actors && root.actors.records && Array.isArray(root.actors.referenceOnly) && root.actors.memories, 'PC03-G13 actor presence/reference/memory fields prepared'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(root.places && root.places.records && 'currentLocation' in root.places && 'travelIntent' in root.places && Array.isArray(root.places.visibleReferences), 'PC03-G14 place current/travel/reference fields prepared'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(root.time && root.time.agePolicy && Array.isArray(root.time.deadlines) && Array.isArray(root.time.pendingClaims), 'PC03-G15 time/deadline/age policy fields prepared'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(root.cards && root.cards.protectedCards && root.cards.registry && root.cards.generatedCardsEnabled === false && root.features.generatedCardsEnabled === false, 'PC03-G16 card mirror registry fields prepared and generated cards disabled'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(WL.PC03_LEDGER_BUCKETS.every(function (b) { return b === 'recentKeys' ? Array.isArray(root.operationLedger[b]) : obj(root.operationLedger[b]); }), 'PC03-G17 operation ledger durable buckets exist'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(root.migration && Array.isArray(root.migration.migrationsApplied) && Array.isArray(root.migration.legacyRootsDetected), 'PC03-G18 migration metadata exists'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(root.quarantine && Array.isArray(root.quarantine.categories) && WL.PC03_QUARANTINE_CATEGORIES.every(function (c) { return root.quarantine.categories.indexOf(c) >= 0; }) && Array.isArray(root.quarantine.records), 'PC03-G19 quarantine categories and records exist'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(WL.IntegrityChecker && typeof WL.IntegrityChecker.inspect === 'function', 'PC03-G20 integrity checker shell exists'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(root.cleanup && root.cleanup.protectedPaths && root.cleanup.protectedPaths.player && root.cleanup.protectedPaths['operationLedger.permanentKeys'], 'PC03-G21 cleanup protected paths exist'));
      const proseBefore = JSON.stringify({ inv:root.inventory.itemsById, ab:root.abilities.abilitiesById, q:root.quests.records });
      WL.PC03SchemaDeepener.quarantine(root, 'legacy_card_prose', 'storyCard.preview', 'fake_old_card', 'Player owns the Crown of Dawn and learns Moonblade.', 'old card prose must remain inactive', 'medium', 'review only');
      const proseAfter = JSON.stringify({ inv:root.inventory.itemsById, ab:root.abilities.abilitiesById, q:root.quests.records });
      rows.push(this.statusFor(proseBefore === proseAfter, 'PC03-G22 old prose cannot import as truth'));
      return rows;
    },
    runSelfTests() {
      const save = globalThis.state;
      const tests = [];
      const add = function (id, ok, label) { tests.push({ id:id, ok:!!ok, label:label }); };
      try {
        globalThis.state = { aidrpg:{ player:{ name:'Legacy Bob' } } }; let root = WL.StateManager.root(); add('PC03-001', !!globalThis.state.worldledger && !globalThis.state.aidrpg && root.quarantine.records.some(function (r) { return r.category === 'legacy_root'; }), 'single root only with legacy root quarantined');
        globalThis.state = {}; root = WL.StateManager.root(); root.player.displayName = 'Preserve Me'; delete root.inventory; root = WL.StateManager.init(globalThis.state); add('PC03-002', root.player.displayName === 'Preserve Me' && root.inventory && root.inventory.itemsById, 'missing bucket repair preserves existing data');
        add('PC03-003', root.schema && root.schema.schemaId === WL.SCHEMA_ID && root.schema.bucketVersions, 'schema metadata exists');
        add('PC03-004', WL.PC03_DEFERRED_FLAGS.every(function (f) { return root.features[f] === false; }), 'deferred placeholders disabled');
        root.startup.locked = true; root.startup.identityLockedAtTurn = 9; root = WL.StateManager.init(globalThis.state); add('PC03-005', root.startup.locked === true && root.startup.identityLockedAtTurn === 9, 'startup lock metadata preserved');
        root.player.trueRaceSpecies = 'unknown'; root.player.currentForm = 'wolf-shaped illusion'; add('PC03-006', root.player.trueRaceSpecies === 'unknown' && root.player.currentForm === 'wolf-shaped illusion', 'player unknown fields stay unknown and form remains separate');
        root.body.resources.hp = { current:150, max:100 }; root.body.resources.mp = { current:20, max:50 }; root = WL.StateManager.init(globalThis.state); add('PC03-007', root.body.resources.hp.current === 100 && root.body.resources.mp.current === 20, 'resource structural clamp lowers impossible values without healing lower current values');
        root.inventory.itemsById.item_bad = { displayName:'Bad Apple', quantity:-3 }; root = WL.StateManager.init(globalThis.state); add('PC03-008', root.inventory.itemsById.item_bad.quantity === 0 && root.quarantine.records.some(function (r) { return r.category === 'invalid_item'; }), 'negative item quantity quarantined');
        root.abilities.stable = ['Moonblade','moonblade']; const intRows = WL.IntegrityChecker.inspect(root); add('PC03-009', intRows.some(function (r) { return /duplicate stable ability/i.test(r.label || ''); }), 'duplicate stable ability detected');
        root.quests.rewardLedger.promises.push({ text:'15 gold promised' }); add('PC03-010', Array.isArray(root.quests.rewardLedger.promises) && Array.isArray(root.quests.rewardLedger.payments) && root.quests.rewardLedger.payments.length === 0, 'quest reward fields separate promise/payment');
        add('PC03-011', root.actors && Array.isArray(root.actors.referenceOnly), 'actor reference-only structure exists');
        root.places.currentLocation = 'tavern'; root.places.travelIntent = 'chapel'; add('PC03-012', root.places.currentLocation === 'tavern' && root.places.travelIntent === 'chapel', 'place travel intent separate from current location');
        add('PC03-013', root.time.agePolicy && root.time.agePolicy.mutateAgeOnlyOnLiteralAcceptedSkip === true, 'time age policy cautious');
        add('PC03-014', root.cards.generatedCardsEnabled === false && root.cards.protectedCardWritesEnabled === false, 'card mirror flags safe');
        add('PC03-015', root.operationLedger.durableKeysAreProtected === true && !!root.operationLedger.rewardKeys && !!root.operationLedger.migrationOperationKeys, 'durable ledger buckets protected');
        const proseSnapshotBefore = JSON.stringify({ inv:root.inventory.itemsById, ab:root.abilities.records }); WL.PC03SchemaDeepener.quarantine(root, 'legacy_card_prose', 'story_card', 'old', 'You own the Crown of Dawn.', 'old prose quarantine test', 'medium', 'review only'); const proseSnapshotAfter = JSON.stringify({ inv:root.inventory.itemsById, ab:root.abilities.records }); add('PC03-016', proseSnapshotBefore === proseSnapshotAfter && root.quarantine.records.some(function (r) { return r.category === 'legacy_card_prose'; }), 'old card prose quarantined without canon import');
        root.schema.schemaVersion = '9.9.9'; root = WL.StateManager.init(globalThis.state); add('PC03-017', root.migration.futureSchemaWarnings.length >= 1 || root.quarantine.records.some(function (r) { return r.category === 'future_schema'; }), 'future schema warning safe');
        const integritySnapshotBefore = JSON.stringify({ player:root.player, inventory:root.inventory, quests:root.quests }); WL.IntegrityChecker.inspect(root); const integritySnapshotAfter = JSON.stringify({ player:root.player, inventory:root.inventory, quests:root.quests }); add('PC03-018', integritySnapshotBefore === integritySnapshotAfter, 'integrity command non-mutating');
        add('PC03-019', root.quarantine.records.every(function (r) { return r.status === 'inactive' || r.status === 'review'; }), 'quarantine inactive display');
        const gates = WL.ProductionChunk03.inspect(root); add('PC03-020', gates.filter(function (r) { return r.status === 'FAIL' || r.status === 'BLOCKED'; }).length === 0, 'ReleaseCheck PC03 gates');
      } catch (e) { add('PC03-ERR', false, 'PC03 self-test exception: ' + (e && e.message || e)); }
      finally { globalThis.state = save; }
      return tests;
    },
    render(root) {
      root = WL.PC03SchemaDeepener.init(root || WL.StateManager.root());

    }

      if (!b.resources || typeof b.resources !== 'object' || Array.isArray(b.resources)) b.resources = {};

        if (!Array.isArray(r.notes)) r.notes = [];

        if (r.max == null && r.known === true && Number.isFinite(Number(legacyMax))) r.max = Number(legacyMax);
        if (r.known === true) {
          r.max = WL.U.clamp(r.max == null ? legacyMax : r.max, 1, 999999);
          r.current = WL.U.clamp(r.current == null ? r.max : r.current, 0, r.max);
        } else {

          if (r.max !== null && !Number.isFinite(Number(r.max))) r.max = null;

      };

      b.exhaustionState = b.fatigueState === 'exhausted' || b.fatigueState === 'collapsed' ? b.fatigueState : 'not_exhausted';
      b.deathBoundary = this.allowed(WL.PC04_ALLOWED_DEATH_BOUNDARIES, b.deathBoundaryStatus || b.deathBoundary || 'alive', 'alive');

    displayUnknown(v, fallback) { v = this.norm(v); return v && !/^unknown$/i.test(v) ? v : (fallback || 'unknown'); },
    resourceText(root, key) {

      if (r.known !== true) return String(key).toUpperCase() + ': unknown';
      return String(key).toUpperCase() + ': ' + r.current + '/' + r.max;
    },
    resourceKey(value) { const k = this.slug(value || ''); return /^(?:hp|health)$/.test(k) ? 'hp' : (/^(?:mp|mana)$/.test(k) ? 'mp' : (/^(?:ep|stamina|energy)$/.test(k) ? 'ep' : '')); },
    conditionKey(value) { return this.slug(String(value || 'condition').replace(/^body[._-]/i, '')); },
    conditionDisplay(value) { return WL.U.title(String(value || 'condition').replace(/^body[._-]/i, '').replace(/_/g, ' ')); },
    injuryKey(value, part) { return this.slug((value || 'injury') + (part ? '_' + part : '')); },
    extractCondition(v) {
      const text = this.norm((v && (v.data && v.data.status || v.target && (v.target.display || v.target.raw) || v.name || v.sourceText)) || 'status');
      const l = WL.U.lower(text);
      const known = ['bleeding','burned','poisoned','sick','stunned','blinded','deafened','frozen','chilled','cursed','infected','exhausted','fatigued','unconscious','restrained'];
      for (let i = 0; i < known.length; i++) if (new RegExp('\\b' + known[i] + '\\b','i').test(l)) return known[i];
      if (/burn/.test(l)) return 'burned';
      if (/poison/.test(l)) return 'poisoned';
      if (/blood|bleed/.test(l)) return 'bleeding';
      return text;
    },
    extractBodyPart(text) {
      const l = WL.U.lower(text || '');
      const parts = ['left arm','right arm','forearm','shoulder','ribs','rib','thigh','cheek','wrist','thumb','fingers','finger','arm','hand','palm','foot','feet','leg','legs','chest','head','eye','eyes','body'];
      for (let i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) if (new RegExp('\\b' + parts[i].replace(/ /g,'\\s+') + '\\b','i').test(l)) return parts[i].replace(/^rib$/,'ribs').replace(/^finger$/,'fingers').replace(/^legs$/,'leg').replace(/^eyes$/,'eye');
      return 'body';
    },
    severityFromText(text) {
      const l = WL.U.lower(text || '');
      if (/critical|dying|collapsed|bleeding heavily|mortal|fatal/.test(l)) return 'critical';
      if (/major|deep|broken|blistered|exhausted|barely stand/.test(l)) return 'major';
      if (/moderate|poisoned|burned|bleeding|sprained|wound/.test(l)) return 'moderate';
      if (/minor|small|shallow|raw|winded|fatigued/.test(l)) return 'minor';
      return 'unknown';
    },
    statusForText(text) { return /resolved|stops|stabilizes|fades|heals|recovers|improves|rested|treated/i.test(text || '') ? 'resolved' : 'active'; },
    makeConditionRecord(root, statusKey, v, status) {
      statusKey = this.conditionKey(statusKey);
      const id = 'condition_' + statusKey;
      let rec = root.body.conditionRecordsById[id];
      if (!rec) {
        rec = { id:id, key:statusKey, displayName:this.conditionDisplay(statusKey), family:'body_condition', severity:'unknown', status:'active', sourceOperationKey:'', sourceEventId:'', createdTurn:this.now(root), updatedTurn:this.now(root), expiresTurn:0, location:'', cause:'', evidence:[], notes:[] };
        root.body.conditionRecordsById[id] = rec;
        if (root.body.conditionIds.indexOf(id) < 0) root.body.conditionIds.push(id);
      }
      rec.status = this.allowed(WL.PC04_ALLOWED_CONDITION_STATUSES, status || 'active', 'active');
      rec.severity = this.severityFromText(v && v.sourceText || rec.displayName);
      rec.sourceOperationKey = v && (v.opKey || v.operationKey) || rec.sourceOperationKey || '';
      rec.sourceEventId = v && (v.proposalId || v.id) || rec.sourceEventId || '';
      rec.updatedTurn = this.now(root);
      rec.cause = (v && v.sourceText || rec.cause || '').slice(0, 180);
      rec.evidence.push({ turn:this.now(root), text:(v && v.sourceText || '').slice(0, 140), status:rec.status });
      WL.U.capArray(rec.evidence, 8);
      if (root.body.conditions.indexOf(rec.displayName.toLowerCase()) < 0 && rec.status === 'active') WL.U.uniquePush(root.body.conditions, rec.displayName.toLowerCase(), 30);
      return rec;
    },
    makeInjuryRecord(root, display, v, status) {
      const part = this.extractBodyPart((v && v.sourceText || '') + ' ' + display);
      const key = this.injuryKey(display || 'injury', part);
      const id = 'injury_' + key;
      let rec = root.body.injuryRecordsById[id];
      if (!rec) {
        rec = { id:id, key:key, displayName:WL.U.title(display || 'injury'), bodyPart:part, severity:'unknown', status:'active', bleeding:false, infectionRisk:'unknown', sourceOperationKey:'', sourceEventId:'', createdTurn:this.now(root), updatedTurn:this.now(root), healedTurn:0, cause:'', evidence:[], notes:[] };
        root.body.injuryRecordsById[id] = rec;
        if (root.body.injuryIds.indexOf(id) < 0) root.body.injuryIds.push(id);
      }
      rec.status = this.allowed(WL.PC04_ALLOWED_CONDITION_STATUSES, status || 'active', 'active');
      rec.severity = this.severityFromText(v && v.sourceText || rec.displayName);
      rec.bleeding = rec.bleeding || /blood|bleed/i.test((v && v.sourceText) || display || '');
      rec.infectionRisk = /bite|dirty|poison|rot/i.test((v && v.sourceText) || '') ? 'possible' : rec.infectionRisk;
      rec.sourceOperationKey = v && (v.opKey || v.operationKey) || rec.sourceOperationKey || '';
      rec.sourceEventId = v && (v.proposalId || v.id) || rec.sourceEventId || '';
      rec.updatedTurn = this.now(root);
      rec.cause = (v && v.sourceText || rec.cause || '').slice(0, 180);
      if (rec.status === 'resolved' && !rec.healedTurn) rec.healedTurn = this.now(root);
      rec.evidence.push({ turn:this.now(root), text:(v && v.sourceText || '').slice(0, 140), status:rec.status });
      WL.U.capArray(rec.evidence, 8);
      if (root.body.injuries.indexOf(rec.displayName.toLowerCase()) < 0 && rec.status === 'active') WL.U.uniquePush(root.body.injuries, rec.displayName.toLowerCase(), 30);
      return rec;
    },
    unsafeFlags(v) {
      const f = Object.assign({}, v && v.flags || {});
      const risk = Array.isArray(v && v.riskFlags) ? v.riskFlags.join(' ') : '';
      const sourceKind = String(v && (v.sourceKind || v.sourceHook || '') || '');
      const raw = WL.U.lower((v && v.sourceText) || '');
      const bad = [];
      if (f.quotedSpeech || /quote/i.test(risk)) bad.push('quote');
      if (f.dreamOrVision || /dream|vision/i.test(risk) || /\bin a dream\b/.test(raw)) bad.push('dream');
      if (f.rumorOrClaim || /rumor|claim/i.test(risk) || /\b(?:people say|rumor says|word is|supposedly|allegedly)\b/.test(raw)) bad.push('rumor');
      if (f.commandText || f.diagnosticText || /command_output|context|story_card|card/i.test(sourceKind) || /^\[(?:aidrpg|worldledger)\]/i.test((v && v.sourceText) || '')) bad.push('noncanon_source');
      if (f.nonliteral || /dead tired|as if dead|felt dead|like death|metaphor/i.test(raw)) bad.push('nonliteral');
      if (f.pretendOrFalse || f.abstractOrIdea || f.hypothetical) bad.push('unsafe_nonliteral');
      if (f.failedOrRevoked || f.negatedOrRefused) bad.push('denied_or_revoked');
      return bad;
    },
    opKey(kind, key, v) { return WL.OperationLedger.makeKey(['body', kind, key || 'body', WL.U.hash((v && v.sourceText) || '')]); },
    markBodyDirty(root, target, reason, v, priority) {

    },

  (function patchPC04StateManager() {
    const oldInit = WL.StateManager.init;

  (function patchPC04EventScanner() {
    if (!WL.EventScannerLite || typeof WL.EventScannerLite.detectFamilyHints !== 'function') return;
    const oldDetect = WL.EventScannerLite.detectFamilyHints;
    WL.EventScannerLite.detectFamilyHints = function (windowText, flags, sourceHook, sourceInfo, windowIndex) {
      const hits = oldDetect.call(this, windowText, flags, sourceHook, sourceInfo, windowIndex) || [];
      const w = WL.U.norm(windowText || '');
      if (!w || flags.commandText || flags.diagnosticText) return hits;
      const completed = this.completedAllowed ? this.completedAllowed(flags, sourceHook) : (sourceHook === 'output');
      let m;
      if (/\b(?:bleeding|burned|poisoned|sick|stunned|blinded|deafened|frozen|chilled|cursed|infected|restrained)\b/i.test(w)) {
        const st = WL.PC04BodyIdentity.extractCondition({ sourceText:w });
        hits.push(this.baseHit('body', 'body.status_gain_candidate', st, w, flags, sourceHook, sourceInfo, { windowIndex:windowIndex, completedAction:completed, attemptOnly:!completed, statusKey:st }));
      }
      if (/\b(?:poison fades|bleeding stops|bleeding stopped|wound closes|wound heals|recover(?:s|ed)?|rest(?:s|ed)?|is healed|heals)\b/i.test(w)) {
        const st2 = WL.PC04BodyIdentity.extractCondition({ sourceText:w });
        hits.push(this.baseHit('body', 'body.recovery_candidate', st2, w, flags, sourceHook, sourceInfo, { windowIndex:windowIndex, completedAction:completed, attemptOnly:!completed, statusKey:st2 }));
      }
      if ((m = w.match(/\b(?:lose|lost|take|takes|suffer|suffers)\s+(\d{1,4})\s+(HP|MP|EP|health|mana|stamina|energy)\b/i))) {
        hits.push(this.baseHit('body', 'body.resource_change_candidate', m[2], w, flags, sourceHook, sourceInfo, { windowIndex:windowIndex, completedAction:completed, attemptOnly:!completed, resourceKey:WL.PC04BodyIdentity.resourceKey(m[2]), delta:-Math.abs(Number(m[1])) }));
      }
      if ((m = w.match(/\b(HP|MP|EP|health|mana|stamina|energy)\s+(?:is|drops to|falls to|becomes)\s+(\d{1,4})\s*(?:\/\s*(\d{1,4}))?\b/i))) {
        hits.push(this.baseHit('body', 'body.resource_state_candidate', m[1], w, flags, sourceHook, sourceInfo, { windowIndex:windowIndex, completedAction:completed, attemptOnly:!completed, resourceKey:WL.PC04BodyIdentity.resourceKey(m[1]), current:Number(m[2]), max:m[3] ? Number(m[3]) : null }));
      }
      if (/\b(?:collapse unconscious|fall unconscious|you are unconscious|knocked unconscious)\b/i.test(w)) hits.push(this.baseHit('body', 'body.death_boundary_candidate', 'unconscious', w, flags, sourceHook, sourceInfo, { windowIndex:windowIndex, completedAction:completed, attemptOnly:!completed, newStatus:'unconscious' }));
      if (/\b(?:you are dying|left dying|near death|death's door)\b/i.test(w)) hits.push(this.baseHit('body', 'body.death_boundary_candidate', 'dying', w, flags, sourceHook, sourceInfo, { windowIndex:windowIndex, completedAction:completed, attemptOnly:!completed, newStatus:'dying' }));
      if (/\b(?:you are dead|you died|kills you|killed you|slain)\b/i.test(w)) hits.push(this.baseHit('body', 'body.death_boundary_candidate', 'dead', w, flags, sourceHook, sourceInfo, { windowIndex:windowIndex, completedAction:completed, attemptOnly:!completed, newStatus:'dead' }));
      if ((m = w.match(/\b(?:your form becomes|you transform into|you become|your body becomes)\s+(?:a\s+|an\s+)?([a-z][a-z' -]{2,60})\b/i))) hits.push(this.baseHit('body', 'body.form_change_candidate', m[1], w, flags, sourceHook, sourceInfo, { windowIndex:windowIndex, completedAction:completed, attemptOnly:!completed }));
      if ((m = w.match(/\b(?:disguised as|wearing a disguise as|illusion makes you appear as)\s+(?:a\s+|an\s+)?([a-z][a-z' -]{2,60})\b/i))) hits.push(this.baseHit('body', /illusion/i.test(w) ? 'identity.illusion_candidate' : 'identity.disguise_candidate', m[1], w, flags, sourceHook, sourceInfo, { windowIndex:windowIndex, completedAction:completed, attemptOnly:!completed }));
      if ((m = w.match(/\b(?:you have|you grow|you reveal)\s+(claws|wings|a tail|fur|scales|no human hands|quadruped movement)\b/i))) hits.push(this.baseHit('body', 'body.trait_candidate', m[1], w, flags, sourceHook, sourceInfo, { windowIndex:windowIndex, completedAction:completed, attemptOnly:!completed }));
      return hits.slice(0, 24);
    };
  })();

  (function patchPC04CanonValidator() {
    if (!WL.CanonValidator || typeof WL.CanonValidator.validateBody !== 'function') return;
    const oldValidateBody = WL.CanonValidator.validateBody;
    WL.CanonValidator.validateBody = function (p, root, s) {
      root = WL.PC04BodyIdentity.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root());
      s = s || (p && p.flags) || {};
      const t = p.type || p.eventType || '';
      const unsafe = WL.PC04BodyIdentity.unsafeFlags(p);
      if (unsafe.length) return this.reject(p, 'body/status change blocked by PC04 safety flags: ' + unsafe.join(', '), ['PC04 body safety']);
      if (t === 'body.status_gain_candidate') return this.accept(p, 'direct body/status gain candidate accepted for BodyReducer condition record', ['PC04 condition']);
      if (t === 'body.status_loss_candidate' || t === 'body.recovery_candidate') return this.accept(p, 'accepted recovery/resolution event may improve or resolve body state', ['PC04 recovery']);
      if (t === 'body.injury_candidate') return this.accept(p, 'direct physical injury outcome accepted for InjuryRecord', ['PC04 injury']);
      if (t === 'body.resource_change_candidate' || t === 'body.resource_state_candidate') return this.accept(p, 'direct resource state/change accepted; clamp is structural only', ['PC04 resource']);
      if (t === 'body.death_boundary_candidate' || t === 'body.death_claim') {
        const status = (p.newStatus || p.data && p.data.newStatus || p.target && p.target.display || '').toLowerCase();
        if (/dead/.test(status) || /\b(?:you died|you are dead|killed you|slain)\b/i.test(p.sourceText || '')) return this.pending(p, 'direct death requires explicit high-safety death policy; not auto-committed in PC04', ['PC04 death boundary']);
        if (/unconscious/.test(status) || /unconscious/i.test(p.sourceText || '')) return this.accept(p, 'unconscious accepted as distinct from dead', ['PC04 death boundary']);
        if (/dying/.test(status) || /dying|near death/i.test(p.sourceText || '')) return this.accept(p, 'dying accepted as distinct from dead', ['PC04 death boundary']);
        return this.pending(p, 'death boundary candidate pending: ' + (status || 'unknown'), ['PC04 death boundary']);
      }
      if (t === 'body.fatigue') return this.accept(p, /\b(?:exhausted|barely stand|drained completely|collapsed)\b/i.test(p.sourceText || '') ? 'explicit exhaustion/collapse wording accepted distinctly' : 'fatigue accepted without upgrading to exhaustion', ['PC04 fatigue']);
      if (t === 'body.injury') return this.accept(p, 'direct literal injury/status wording accepted for InjuryRecord', ['PC04 injury']);
      if (t === 'body.form_change_candidate') return this.pending(p, 'form change stored as candidate until transformation policy is active', ['PC04 form candidate']);
      if (t === 'body.trait_candidate' || t === 'identity.trait_candidate' || t === 'identity.form_candidate') return this.pending(p, 'trait/form evidence stays candidate/pending, not confirmed body truth', ['PC04 candidate trait']);
      if (t === 'identity.disguise_candidate' || t === 'identity.illusion_candidate') return this.accept(p, 'disguise/illusion presentation accepted without overwriting body truth', ['PC04 presentation']);
      return oldValidateBody.call(this, p, root, s);
    };
  })();

  (function patchPC04BodyReducer() {
    if (!WL.BodyReducer) WL.BodyReducer = {};
    WL.BodyReducer.pc04DefensiveLocked = true;
    WL.BodyReducer.apply = function (root, v) {
      root = WL.PC04BodyIdentity.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root());
      v = v || {};
      const type = v.type || v.eventType || '';
      const unsafe = WL.PC04BodyIdentity.unsafeFlags(v);
      if (unsafe.length) return { type:type, status:'rejected_by_reducer_guard', reason:'unsafe body flags: ' + unsafe.join(', ') };
      if (/^body\.death/.test(type) && /dead/i.test(v.target && v.target.display || v.newStatus || '') && !(v.data && v.data.explicitDeathPolicy === true)) return { type:type, status:'pending_death_policy', reason:'direct death requires explicit high-safety death policy' };
      if (type === 'body.fatigue') {
        const src = v.sourceText || '';
        let state = 'fatigued', sev = 'minor';
        if (/\b(?:winded|out of breath)\b/i.test(src)) { state = 'winded'; sev = 'minor'; }
        if (/\b(?:fatigued|worn out|weary)\b/i.test(src)) { state = /weary/i.test(src) ? 'weary' : 'fatigued'; sev = 'moderate'; }
        if (/\b(?:exhausted|barely stand|drained completely)\b/i.test(src)) { state = 'exhausted'; sev = 'major'; }
        if (/\b(?:collapsed|unable to stand)\b/i.test(src)) { state = 'collapsed'; sev = 'critical'; }
        root.body.fatigueState = state; root.body.fatigueSeverity = sev; root.body.exhaustionState = (state === 'exhausted' || state === 'collapsed') ? state : 'not_exhausted'; root.body.fatigue = state === 'rested' ? 'normal' : state;
        if (state !== 'rested') WL.PC04BodyIdentity.makeConditionRecord(root, state === 'exhausted' || state === 'collapsed' ? 'exhausted' : 'fatigued', v, 'active');
        WL.PC04BodyIdentity.markBodyDirty(root, 'body_status', 'fatigue/exhaustion changed', v, 1);
        return { type:type, status:'committed', target:state, severity:sev };
      }
      if (type === 'body.status_gain_candidate') {
        const st = WL.PC04BodyIdentity.extractCondition(v); const rec = WL.PC04BodyIdentity.makeConditionRecord(root, st, v, 'active');
        WL.PC04BodyIdentity.markBodyDirty(root, 'body_status', 'condition gained: ' + rec.displayName, v, 1);
        return { type:type, status:'committed', target:rec.displayName, recordId:rec.id };
      }
      if (type === 'body.status_loss_candidate' || type === 'body.recovery_candidate') {
        const st = WL.PC04BodyIdentity.extractCondition(v); const rec = WL.PC04BodyIdentity.makeConditionRecord(root, st, v, 'resolved');
        if (root.body.resolvedConditionIds.indexOf(rec.id) < 0) root.body.resolvedConditionIds.push(rec.id);
        root.body.conditions = (root.body.conditions || []).filter(function (c) { return WL.U.slug(c) !== rec.key; });
        WL.PC04BodyIdentity.markBodyDirty(root, 'body_status', 'condition recovery/resolution: ' + rec.displayName, v, 1);
        return { type:type, status:'committed_recovery', target:rec.displayName, recordId:rec.id };
      }
      if (type === 'body.injury' || type === 'body.injury_candidate') {
        let display = 'injury';
        const src = v.sourceText || '';
        if (/wolf bite|bitten|bite/i.test(src)) display = 'wolf bite on ' + WL.PC04BodyIdentity.extractBodyPart(src);
        else if (/burn/i.test(src)) display = 'burned ' + WL.PC04BodyIdentity.extractBodyPart(src);
        else if (/cut|deep cut/i.test(src)) display = 'cut ' + WL.PC04BodyIdentity.extractBodyPart(src);
        else if (v.target && v.target.display) display = v.target.display;
        const rec = WL.PC04BodyIdentity.makeInjuryRecord(root, display, v, 'active');
        WL.PC04BodyIdentity.markBodyDirty(root, 'body_status', 'injury gained: ' + rec.displayName, v, 1);
        return { type:type, status:'committed', target:rec.displayName, recordId:rec.id };
      }
      if (type === 'body.resource_change_candidate' || type === 'body.resource_state_candidate') {
        const key = v.resourceKey || (v.data && v.data.resourceKey) || WL.PC04BodyIdentity.resourceKey(v.target && (v.target.display || v.target.raw) || '');
        const r = root.body.resources[key];
        if (!r) return { type:type, status:'rejected', reason:'unknown resource' };
        r.known = true; r.source = 'validated_body_event'; r.lastChangedTurn = WL.PC04BodyIdentity.now(root);
        if (type === 'body.resource_state_candidate') {
          const max = Number(v.max || (v.data && v.data.max) || r.max || (key === 'mp' ? root.body.maxMp : (key === 'ep' ? root.body.maxEp : root.body.maxHp)) || 1);
          r.max = WL.U.clamp(max, 1, 999999);
          r.current = WL.U.clamp(Number(v.current != null ? v.current : (v.data && v.data.current != null ? v.data.current : r.current || r.max)), 0, r.max);
        } else {
          if (r.max == null) r.max = key === 'mp' ? root.body.maxMp : (key === 'ep' ? root.body.maxEp : root.body.maxHp);
          if (r.current == null) r.current = r.max;
          r.current = WL.U.clamp(Number(r.current) + Number(v.delta || (v.data && v.data.delta) || 0), 0, Number(r.max || 1));
        }
        if (key === 'hp') { root.body.hp = r.current; root.body.maxHp = r.max; root.body.hpTrack.current = r.current; root.body.hpTrack.max = r.max; }
        if (key === 'mp') { root.body.mp = r.current; root.body.maxMp = r.max; root.body.mpTrack.current = r.current; root.body.mpTrack.max = r.max; }
        if (key === 'ep') { root.body.ep = r.current; root.body.maxEp = r.max; root.body.epTrack.current = r.current; root.body.epTrack.max = r.max; }
        WL.PC04BodyIdentity.markBodyDirty(root, 'body_status', 'resource changed: ' + key, v, 2);
        return { type:type, status:'committed', target:key, current:r.current, max:r.max, structuralClampOnly:true };
      }
      if (type === 'body.death_boundary_candidate') {
        const ns = WL.PC04BodyIdentity.allowed(WL.PC04_ALLOWED_DEATH_BOUNDARIES, (v.newStatus || v.target && v.target.display || '').toLowerCase(), 'unknown');
        if (ns === 'dead' && !(v.data && v.data.explicitDeathPolicy === true)) return { type:type, status:'pending_death_policy', reason:'dead requires explicit policy' };
        root.body.deathBoundary = ns; root.body.deathBoundaryStatus = ns;
        if (ns === 'unconscious') WL.PC04BodyIdentity.makeConditionRecord(root, 'unconscious', v, 'active');
        WL.PC04BodyIdentity.markBodyDirty(root, 'body_status', 'death boundary changed: ' + ns, v, 0);
        return { type:type, status:'committed', target:ns };
      }
      if (type === 'identity.disguise_candidate' || type === 'identity.illusion_candidate') {
        const val = WL.PC04BodyIdentity.displayUnknown(v.target && v.target.display || v.name || '', '');
        if (type === 'identity.disguise_candidate') root.player.identity.activeDisguise = root.player.activeDisguise = val;
        else root.player.identity.activeIllusion = root.player.activeIllusion = val;
        WL.PC04BodyIdentity.markBodyDirty(root, 'player_sheet', 'presentation changed: ' + val, v, 2);
        return { type:type, status:'committed_presentation_only', target:val };
      }
      if (type === 'body.form_change_candidate' || type === 'body.trait_candidate' || type === 'identity.trait_candidate' || type === 'identity.form_candidate') {
        const val2 = WL.PC04BodyIdentity.displayUnknown(v.target && v.target.display || v.name || '', 'unknown');
        WL.U.uniquePush(root.player.identity.candidateTraits, val2, 30);
        WL.U.uniquePush(root.body.candidateTraits, val2, 30);
        WL.PC04BodyIdentity.markBodyDirty(root, 'player_sheet', 'candidate body/form trait: ' + val2, v, 2);
        return { type:type, status:'candidate_recorded', target:val2 };
      }
      return { type:type, status:'pending_or_rejected', reason:v.reason || 'No PC04 body reducer handler.' };
    };
  })();

    if (WL.ContextBuilderLite) {

      WL.ContextBuilderLite.buildPackets = function (root) {

Candidate/pending/rumored traits are not confirmed truth.';

        else packets.push({ family:'player_body', priority:1, text:text, safeForModel:true, reason:'PC04 player/body packet' });
        return packets;
      };
    }
  })();

  WL.ProductionChunk04 = {
    lockVersion: WL.PRODUCTION_CHUNK_04_LOCK_VERSION,
    statusFor(ok, label, failStatus) { return { status: ok ? 'PASS' : (failStatus || 'FAIL'), label: label }; },
    snapshot(root) { root = WL.PC04BodyIdentity.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root()); return WL.PC04BodyIdentity.playerSnapshot(root); },
    inspect(root) {
      root = WL.PC04BodyIdentity.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root());
      const rows = [];

      rows.push(this.statusFor(b.recoveryPolicy && b.recoveryPolicy.requiresAcceptedRecoveryEvent === true, 'PC04-G11 recovery requires accepted recovery event'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(b.recoveryPolicy && b.recoveryPolicy.cleanupMayResolve === false, 'PC04-G12 cleanup cannot heal/remove active body state'));
      const dirty = WL.DirtyQueue.addRecord ? WL.DirtyQueue.addRecord(root, 'body_status', 'pc04_probe', 'pc04 dirty probe', { sourceReducer:'PC04Inspect', priority:3 }) : WL.DirtyQueue.add(root, 'body_status', 'pc04 dirty probe'); rows.push(this.statusFor(!!dirty || (root.dirty && Array.isArray(root.dirty.records || root.dirty.targets)), 'PC04-G13 body/player dirty targets created'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(/Confirmed identity/i.test(WL.CommandRenderer.sheet(root)) && /Candidate traits/i.test(WL.CommandRenderer.sheet(root)) && /unknown is not assumed human/i.test(WL.CommandRenderer.sheet(root)), 'PC04-G14 /sheet displays confirmed/candidate/unknown fields honestly'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(/Fatigue/i.test(WL.CommandRenderer.status(root)) && /Exhaustion/i.test(WL.CommandRenderer.status(root)) && /Death boundary/i.test(WL.CommandRenderer.status(root)), 'PC04-G15 /status displays body states honestly'));
      const packetText = (WL.ContextBuilderLite.buildPackets(root) || []).map(function (p) { return p.text || ''; }).join('\n'); rows.push(this.statusFor(/Candidate\/pending\/rumored traits are not confirmed truth/i.test(packetText), 'PC04-G16 body context packet labels candidate/pending truth correctly'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(typeof WL.PC04BodyIdentity.opKey === 'function' && /body\.status\.add/.test(WL.PC04BodyIdentity.opKey('status.add','fatigued',{sourceText:'test'})), 'PC04-G17 operation keys exist for repeat-sensitive body effects'));
      rows.push(this.statusFor(WL.ProductionChunk04.runSelfTests().length >= 24, 'PC04-G18 player-breaker body/death tests registered'));
      return rows;
    },
    runSelfTests() {
      const results = []; const add = function (id, ok, label) { results.push({ id:id, ok:!!ok, label:label }); };
      const save = globalThis.state;
      try {
        globalThis.state = {}; let root = WL.StateManager.root(), before, after, out, hits, props, vals, res, v, p;
        add('PC04-001', root.player.identity.trueRaceSpecies === 'unknown' && !/human/i.test(root.player.identity.trueRaceSpecies), 'Unknown race not assumed human');

        p = WL.CanonValidator.makeTestProposal(root,'body.fatigue','body','Your legs shake and you are exhausted, barely able to stand.',{targetDisplay:'fatigue'}); v = WL.CanonValidator.validate(p, root); res = WL.BodyReducer.apply(root, v); add('PC04-006', root.body.fatigueState === 'exhausted' && root.body.exhaustionState === 'exhausted', 'Exhausted explicit');
        p = WL.CanonValidator.makeTestProposal(root,'body.injury_candidate','body','The wolf bites your left arm and blood runs down your sleeve.',{targetDisplay:'wolf bite'}); v = WL.CanonValidator.validate(p, root); res = WL.BodyReducer.apply(root, v); add('PC04-007', root.body.injuryIds.length >= 1 && /wolf bite/i.test(root.body.injuryRecordsById[root.body.injuryIds[0]].displayName), 'Injury created from direct physical outcome');
        before = root.body.injuryIds.length; p = WL.CanonValidator.makeTestProposal(root,'body.injury_candidate','body','The wolf threatens to bite your arm.',{targetDisplay:'wolf bite', riskFlags:['future']}); v = WL.CanonValidator.validate(p, root); if(v.status === 'accepted') WL.BodyReducer.apply(root, v); add('PC04-008', root.body.injuryIds.length === before, 'Threat does not injure');
        p = WL.CanonValidator.makeTestProposal(root,'body.status_gain_candidate','body','Your arm is poisoned.',{targetDisplay:'poisoned'}); v = WL.CanonValidator.validate(p, root); WL.BodyReducer.apply(root, v); p = WL.CanonValidator.makeTestProposal(root,'body.recovery_candidate','body','The poison fades from your veins.',{targetDisplay:'poisoned'}); v = WL.CanonValidator.validate(p, root); WL.BodyReducer.apply(root, v); const poison = root.body.conditionRecordsById.condition_poisoned; add('PC04-009', poison && poison.status === 'resolved', 'Recovery resolves condition');
        root.body.conditionRecordsById.condition_bleeding = { id:'condition_bleeding', key:'bleeding', displayName:'Bleeding', status:'active', severity:'moderate' }; root.body.conditionIds.push('condition_bleeding'); WL.CleanupManagerLite.run(root); add('PC04-010', root.body.conditionRecordsById.condition_bleeding.status === 'active', 'Cleanup does not heal');

    categoryFor(name) {

        if (!WL.PC05_ACCESS_STATES.includes(rec.accessState)) rec.accessState = 'unknown';
        if (!rec.owner) rec.owner = this.playerAccess[rec.accessState] ? 'player' : 'unknown';
        if (!rec.holder) rec.holder = this.playerAccess[rec.accessState] ? 'player' : 'unknown';
        if (!Array.isArray(rec.historyKeys)) rec.historyKeys = [];
        if (!Array.isArray(rec.warnings)) rec.warnings = [];
        if (!Array.isArray(rec.notes)) rec.notes = [];
        if (typeof rec.createdTurn !== 'number') rec.createdTurn = this.now(root);
        rec.updatedTurn = this.now(root);
        by[id] = rec;
        if (id !== key && !by[key]) { by[key] = rec; delete by[id]; }
      });

      return inv;
    },
    cleanTargetName(value) { return WL.ItemNameSanitizer.clean(value).displayName; },
    unsafeReasons(v) {

      const text = WL.U.lower((v && (v.sourceText || v.localClausePreview || '')) || '');
