      const out = [];
      if (/^(?:command|command_output|context|story_card|protected_card|generated_card|debug|audit|releasecheck)$/.test(source)) out.push('unsafe_source');
      if (/^\s*\[(?:worldledger|aidrpg)\]/i.test(text)) out.push('diagnostic_text');
      if (flags.quotedSpeech || flags.quote) out.push('quotedSpeech');
      if (flags.dreamOrVision || flags.dream) out.push('dreamOrVision');
      if (flags.rumorOrClaim || flags.rumor) out.push('rumorOrClaim');
      if (flags.abstractOrMetaphorical || flags.abstractOrIdea || /\b(?:idea of|concept of|thought of|memory of|dream of)\b/i.test(text)) out.push('abstractOrMetaphorical');
      if (flags.failedOrRevoked || flags.denied || flags.negatedOrRefused || flags.deniedByLocalClause || flags.revokedByLocalClause || /\b(?:refuses?|declines?|denies?|snatches?.*away|fails?|failed|cannot|can't|no item is gained|decide not|not take|leave it)\b/i.test(text)) out.push('deniedOrFailed');
      if (flags.futureIntent || flags.hypothetical) out.push('futureOrHypothetical');
      if (flags.attemptOnly || (v && (v.sourceKind === 'input' || v.sourceHook === 'input'))) out.push('attemptOnly');
      return Array.from(new Set(out));
    },
    addHistory(root, rec) {

    },

      return q;
    },
    makeItemRecord(root, name, qty, v, accessState) {
      const clean = WL.ItemNameSanitizer.clean(name);
      const key = this.itemKey(clean.displayName);
      const now = this.now(root);
      return { id:key, key:key, displayName:clean.displayName, name:clean.displayName, normalizedName:WL.U.lower(clean.displayName), quantity:WL.U.clamp(qty || clean.quantity || 1, 1, 9999), category:this.categoryFor(clean.displayName), tags:clean.tags || [], stackable:!(/\b(?:crown|artifact|named|unique)\b/i.test(clean.displayName)), unique:/\b(?:crown|artifact|named|unique)\b/i.test(clean.displayName), durability:{ state:'unknown', value:null, max:null }, accessState:accessState || 'carried', owner:(accessState === 'npc_custody' || accessState === 'place_custody') ? 'player' : 'player', holder:(accessState === 'npc_custody' || accessState === 'place_custody') ? 'unknown' : 'player', custodyKey:'', locationKey:root.places && (root.places.currentId || root.places.currentLocation) || '', equippedSlot:'', sourceOperationKey:v && (v.opKey || v.operationKey) || '', sourceEventId:v && (v.proposalId || v.id) || '', createdTurn:now, updatedTurn:now, historyKeys:[], warnings:clean.flags || [], notes:[] };
    },
    addOrMergeOwned(root, name, qty, v, accessState) {
      const inv = this.ensure(root);
      const rec = this.makeItemRecord(root, name, qty, v, accessState || 'carried');
      const existing = inv.itemsById[rec.key];
      let final = rec;
      if (existing && existing.stackable !== false && rec.stackable !== false && !existing.unique) {
        existing.quantity = WL.U.clamp((existing.quantity || existing.qty || 1) + rec.quantity, 1, 9999); existing.qty = existing.quantity; existing.updatedTurn = this.now(root); existing.accessState = accessState || existing.accessState || 'carried'; existing.owner = 'player'; existing.holder = 'player'; final = existing;
      } else if (existing && existing.unique) {
        final = existing;
      } else {
        inv.itemsById[rec.key] = rec;
      }
      if (this.playerAccess[final.accessState] && inv.ownedIds.indexOf(final.key) < 0) inv.ownedIds.push(final.key);
      this.addHistory(root, { itemKey:final.key, eventType:'acquire', fromAccessState:'unknown', toAccessState:final.accessState, operationKey:v && (v.opKey || v.operationKey) || '', summary:'acquired ' + final.displayName });
      return final;
    },
    addScene(root, name, qty, accessState, v) {
      const inv = this.ensure(root);
      const clean = WL.ItemNameSanitizer.clean(name);
      const key = this.sceneKey(clean.displayName, root, v && v.sourceText || '');
      const rec = { id:key, key:key, displayName:clean.displayName, quantity:WL.U.clamp(qty || clean.quantity || 1, 1, 9999), accessState:accessState || 'visible', locationKey:root.places && (root.places.currentId || root.places.currentLocation) || '', sceneKey:root.places && (root.places.currentId || root.places.currentLocation) || 'scene', holderKey:'', visibility: accessState === 'inaccessible' ? 'obscured' : 'visible', reachable: accessState === 'available_loot', sourceOperationKey:v && (v.opKey || v.operationKey) || '', createdTurn:this.now(root), updatedTurn:this.now(root), expiresTurn:this.now(root)+12, notes:[] };
      inv.sceneItemsById[key] = rec;
      if (inv.sceneItems.indexOf(key) < 0) inv.sceneItems.push(key);
      const list = accessState === 'available_loot' ? inv.availableSceneItems : (accessState === 'offered' ? inv.offeredSceneItems : inv.visibleSceneItems);
      WL.U.uniquePush(list, rec.displayName, 30);
      this.addHistory(root, { itemKey:rec.key, eventType:accessState, fromAccessState:'unknown', toAccessState:accessState, operationKey:v && (v.opKey || v.operationKey) || '', summary:'scene item: ' + rec.displayName });
      return rec;
    },
    addCustody(root, name, holderType, holderName, v) {
      const inv = this.ensure(root);
      const clean = WL.ItemNameSanitizer.clean(name);
      const itemKey = this.itemKey(clean.displayName);
      const holderKey = holderName ? WL.Resolver.canonicalId(holderType === 'place' ? 'place' : 'actor', holderName) : 'holder_unknown';
      const key = this.custodyKey(itemKey, holderKey, v && v.sourceText || '');
      const rec = { id:key, itemKey:itemKey, itemDisplayName:clean.displayName, holderType:holderType || 'unknown', holderKey:holderKey, holderDisplayName:holderName || 'unknown', accessState:holderType === 'place' ? 'place_custody' : 'npc_custody', locationKey:root.places && (root.places.currentId || root.places.currentLocation) || '', sourceOperationKey:v && (v.opKey || v.operationKey) || '', createdTurn:this.now(root), updatedTurn:this.now(root), notes:[] };
      inv.custody[key] = rec;
      this.addHistory(root, { itemKey:itemKey, eventType:'custody', fromAccessState:'unknown', toAccessState:rec.accessState, actorKey:holderKey, operationKey:v && (v.opKey || v.operationKey) || '', summary:'custody: ' + rec.itemDisplayName + ' held by ' + rec.holderDisplayName });
      return rec;
    },
    getOwned(root, itemKey) { const inv = this.ensure(root); const rec = inv.itemsById[itemKey] || inv.itemsById[this.itemKey(itemKey)]; return rec && this.playerAccess[rec.accessState] ? rec : null; },
    setInactive(root, itemKey, state, v) {
      const inv = this.ensure(root); const key = inv.itemsById[itemKey] ? itemKey : this.itemKey(itemKey); const rec = inv.itemsById[key];
      if (!rec || !this.playerAccess[rec.accessState]) return { status:'rejected_by_reducer_guard', reason:'item is not owned/carried/equipped/stored' };
      const from = rec.accessState; rec.accessState = state; rec.holder = 'none'; rec.updatedTurn = this.now(root); rec.equippedSlot = '';
      inv.ownedIds = inv.ownedIds.filter(function (x) { return x !== key; });
      Object.keys(inv.equipment || {}).forEach(function (slot) { if (inv.equipment[slot] === key) inv.equipment[slot] = ''; if (inv.equipped && inv.equipped[slot] === key) inv.equipped[slot] = ''; });
      this.addHistory(root, { itemKey:key, eventType:state, fromAccessState:from, toAccessState:state, operationKey:v && (v.opKey || v.operationKey) || '', summary:state + ': ' + rec.displayName });
      return { status:'committed', record:rec };
    },
    recordOperation(root, bucket, key, data) {
      if (!key) return false;
      if (bucket === 'reward') return WL.OperationLedger.addReward(root, key, data);
      if (bucket === 'currency') return WL.OperationLedger.add(root, 'currencyKeys', key, data);
      if (bucket === 'item') return WL.OperationLedger.add(root, 'itemKeys', key, data);
      return WL.OperationLedger.addRecent(root, key, data);
    },
    hasOperation(root, bucket, key) {
      if (!key) return false;
      if (bucket === 'reward') return WL.OperationLedger.hasReward(root, key);
      if (bucket === 'currency') return WL.OperationLedger.has(root, 'currencyKeys', key);
      if (bucket === 'item') return WL.OperationLedger.has(root, 'itemKeys', key);
      return WL.OperationLedger.hasRecent(root, key);
    },
    opKey(type, nameOrAmount, v, extra) { return WL.OperationLedger.makeKey([String(type || 'item.event'), this.slug(nameOrAmount || 'target'), this.sourceHash(v), extra || '']); },
    keyBucketForType(type) { if (/^currency\./.test(type) || /^reward\.currency\.pay/.test(type)) return 'reward'; if (/^item\./.test(type)) return 'item'; return 'recent'; },
    statsSnapshot(root) { const b = root.body || {}; const p = root.player || {}; return JSON.stringify({ hp:b.hp, mp:b.mp, ep:b.ep, maxHp:b.maxHp, maxMp:b.maxMp, maxEp:b.maxEp, atk:p.atk, def:p.def, spd:p.spd, int:p.int, lck:p.lck }); }
  };

  WL.ItemNameSanitizer = {
    numberWords: Object.freeze({ one:1, two:2, three:3, four:4, five:5, six:6, seven:7, eight:8, nine:9, ten:10 }),
    clean(value) {
      let raw = WL.U.norm(value || '').replace(/[“”"']/g, '');
      let flags = [];
      if (/\b(?:idea of|concept of|thought of|memory of|dream of|symbol of)\b/i.test(raw)) flags.push('abstractOrMetaphorical');
      raw = raw.replace(/^\s*(?:the|a|an|some|your|my|his|her|their)\s+/i, '');
      let quantity = 1;
      const q = raw.match(/^\s*(\d+|one|two|three|four|five|six|seven|eight|nine|ten)\s+(.+)$/i);
      if (q) { quantity = /^\d+$/.test(q[1]) ? parseInt(q[1],10) : (this.numberWords[WL.U.lower(q[1])] || 1); raw = q[2]; }
      raw = raw.replace(/\b(?:that|which)\s+(?:mira|he|she|they|the\s+\w+)\s+(?:refuses?|declines?|won't|will not)\b[\s\S]*$/i, '');
      raw = raw.replace(/\s+(?:from|near|on|inside|in|at|beside|under|behind|within|into|to)\b[\s\S]*$/i, '');
      raw = raw.replace(/\s+(?:but|and|while|before|after|because)\b[\s\S]*$/i, '');
      raw = raw.replace(/\b(?:idea of|concept of|thought of|memory of|dream of|symbol of)\s+/ig, '');
      raw = raw.replace(/\b(?:in your hand|into your hand|to you|on the table|behind glass)\b/ig, '');
      raw = raw.replace(/[.,;:!?]+$/g, '').trim();
      if (!raw) raw = 'unknown item';
      raw = raw.split(/\s+/).slice(0, 8).join(' ');
      return { raw:WL.U.norm(value || ''), displayName:raw.replace(/\b\w/g, function (m) { return m.toUpperCase(); }), normalizedName:WL.U.lower(raw), quantity:WL.U.clamp(quantity, 1, 9999), flags:flags, category:WL.PC05Inventory ? WL.PC05Inventory.categoryFor(raw) : 'misc', tags:[] };
    }
  };

  (function patchPC05Core() {
    if (WL.__pc05InventoryPatchApplied) return;
    WL.__pc05InventoryPatchApplied = true;

    if (WL.OperationLedger && WL.OperationLedger.bucketAliases) {
      WL.OperationLedger.bucketAliases = Object.freeze(Object.assign({}, WL.OperationLedger.bucketAliases, { item:'itemKeys', items:'itemKeys', itemKeys:'itemKeys', currency:'currencyKeys', currencyKeys:'currencyKeys' }));
      const oldEnsureLedger = WL.OperationLedger.ensure;
      WL.OperationLedger.ensure = function (root) { const led = oldEnsureLedger.call(WL.OperationLedger, root); if (led) ['itemKeys','currencyKeys'].forEach(function (k) { if (!led[k] || typeof led[k] !== 'object' || Array.isArray(led[k])) led[k] = {}; }); return led; };
    }

    const oldEnsureInventory = WL.StateManager.ensureInventory;
    WL.StateManager.ensureInventory = function (root) { const inv = oldEnsureInventory.call(WL.StateManager, root); return WL.PC05Inventory.ensure(root); };
    const oldInit = WL.StateManager.init;
    WL.StateManager.init = function (rawState) { const root = oldInit.call(WL.StateManager, rawState); return WL.PC05Inventory.ensure(root), root; };

    const oldDetect = WL.EventScannerLite.detectFamilyHints;
    WL.EventScannerLite.detectFamilyHints = function (windowText, flags, sourceHook, sourceInfo, windowIndex) {
      const hits = oldDetect.call(WL.EventScannerLite, windowText, flags, sourceHook, sourceInfo, windowIndex) || [];
      const w = WL.U.norm(windowText || '');
      if (!w || flags.commandText || flags.diagnosticText) return hits;
      const push = (type, name, extraFlags, extra) => {
        const clean = WL.ItemNameSanitizer.clean(name);
        const f = Object.assign({}, flags || {}, extraFlags || {});
        const hit = WL.EventScannerLite.baseHit('inventory', type, clean.displayName, w, f, sourceHook, sourceInfo, Object.assign({ windowIndex:windowIndex, quantity:clean.quantity, raw:{ quantity:clean.quantity, category:clean.category, sanitizerFlags:clean.flags }, completedAction: sourceHook === 'output' && !(f.quotedSpeech || f.dreamOrVision || f.rumorOrClaim || f.hypothetical || f.futureIntent || f.failedOrRevoked || f.negatedOrRefused || f.abstractOrIdea || f.commandText || f.diagnosticText), attemptOnly: sourceHook === 'input' }, extra || {}));
        hits.push(hit);
      };
      let m;
      if ((m = w.match(/\b(?:you see|you notice|there is|there are|lies|rests|sits)\s+(?:the\s+|a\s+|an\s+|some\s+)?([a-z0-9][a-z0-9' -]{2,70}?)(?:\s+(?:on|near|beside|under|inside|at|behind)\b|[.!?]|$)/i))) push('item.visible', m[1], { visibleOnly:true }, { accessState:'visible' });
      if ((m = w.match(/\b(?:the\s+)?(?:goblin|bandit|wolf|enemy|body|corpse|chest|crate|barrel|container)\s+(?:drops?|contains?|holds?|leaves?)\s+(?:the\s+|a\s+|an\s+|some\s+)?([a-z0-9][a-z0-9' -]{2,70}?)(?:[.!?]|$|\s+(?:on|inside|near)\b)/i))) push('item.available', m[1], { availableOnly:true }, { accessState:'available_loot' });
      if ((m = w.match(/\b(?:mara|[A-Z][A-Za-z'’-]{1,30}|he|she|they|the\s+\w+)\s+(?:offers?|offer|presents?)\s+(?:you\s+)?(?:the\s+|a\s+|an\s+)?([a-z0-9][a-z0-9' -]{2,70}?)(?:[.!?]|$|\s+(?:but|and)\b)/i))) push('item.offered', m[1], { offeredOnly:true, attemptOnly:false }, { accessState:'offered' });
      if ((m = w.match(/\b(?:mira|[A-Z][A-Za-z'’-]{1,30}|the\s+(?:smith|blacksmith|merchant|guard))\s+(?:takes?|keeps?|holds?)\s+(?:your\s+|the\s+|a\s+|an\s+)?([a-z0-9][a-z0-9' -]{2,70}?)(?:\s+(?:for repair|for safekeeping|from you))?\b/i))) push('item.custody', m[1], {}, { accessState:'npc_custody', holderDisplayName:(m[0].match(/^(Mira|[A-Z][A-Za-z'’-]{1,30}|the\s+(?:smith|blacksmith|merchant|guard))/i)||[])[1] || 'unknown' });
      if ((m = w.match(/\byou\s+(?:drop|dropped|set down|leave behind)\s+(?:the\s+|a\s+|an\s+|your\s+)?([a-z0-9][a-z0-9' -]{2,70}?)(?:[.!?]|$)/i))) push('item.drop', m[1], {}, { accessState:'lost' });
      if ((m = w.match(/\byou\s+(?:lose|lost|misplace|misplaced)\s+(?:the\s+|a\s+|an\s+|your\s+)?([a-z0-9][a-z0-9' -]{2,70}?)(?:[.!?]|$)/i))) push('item.lose', m[1], {}, { accessState:'lost' });
      if ((m = w.match(/\byou\s+(?:drink|drank|eat|ate|consume|consumed|use up|used up)\s+(?:the\s+|a\s+|an\s+|your\s+)?([a-z0-9][a-z0-9' -]{2,70}?)(?:[.!?]|$)/i))) push('item.consume', m[1], {}, { accessState:'consumed' });
      if ((m = w.match(/\b(?:the\s+)?([a-z0-9][a-z0-9' -]{2,70}?)\s+(?:is\s+)?(?:destroyed|shatters|breaks apart|burns away|crumbles)\b/i))) push('item.destroy', m[1], {}, { accessState:'destroyed' });
      if ((m = w.match(/\byou\s+(?:equip|equipped|wield|draw|wear|put on)\s+(?:the\s+|a\s+|an\s+|your\s+)?([a-z0-9][a-z0-9' -]{2,70}?)(?:[.!?]|$)/i))) push('item.equip', m[1], {}, { slot:/\b(?:shield|offhand|off hand)\b/i.test(m[1]) ? 'offHand' : (/\b(?:ring)\b/i.test(m[1]) ? 'ring1' : (/\b(?:helm|helmet|hat)\b/i.test(m[1]) ? 'head' : (/\b(?:armor|mail|coat|robe)\b/i.test(m[1]) ? 'body' : 'mainHand'))) });
      if ((m = w.match(/\byou\s+(?:unequip|sheathe|remove|take off)\s+(?:the\s+|a\s+|an\s+|your\s+)?([a-z0-9][a-z0-9' -]{2,70}?)(?:[.!?]|$)/i))) push('item.unequip', m[1], {}, { slot:'mainHand' });
      if ((m = w.match(/\b(?:promises?|offers?)\s+(?:to\s+)?(?:pay|reward)\s+(?:you\s+)?(\d+)\s+(gold|silver|copper)\b/i))) push('currency.promise', m[1] + ' ' + m[2], { futureIntent:true }, { raw:{ amount:parseInt(m[1],10), coin:WL.U.lower(m[2]) } });
      if ((m = w.match(/\b(?:pays?|paid|hands?\s+you|gives?\s+you)\s+(\d+)\s+(gold|silver|copper)\b/i))) push('currency.gain', m[1] + ' ' + m[2], {}, { raw:{ amount:parseInt(m[1],10), coin:WL.U.lower(m[2]) } });
      return hits.slice(0, this.maxHits ? this.maxHits(WL.StateManager.root(), sourceHook) : 40);
    };

    const oldDataPayload = WL.ProposalBuilder.dataPayload;
    WL.ProposalBuilder.dataPayload = function (hit, target, proposedChange, operation) {
      const data = oldDataPayload.call(WL.ProposalBuilder, hit, target, proposedChange, operation) || {};
      const clean = WL.ItemNameSanitizer.clean((target && (target.displayName || target.display || target.rawTargetText)) || (hit && hit.name) || '');
      if (/^item\./.test(hit && hit.type || '')) { data.quantity = hit.quantity || clean.quantity || 1; data.category = clean.category; data.itemSanitizerFlags = clean.flags || []; data.accessState = hit.accessState || ''; data.slot = hit.slot || ''; data.holderDisplayName = hit.holderDisplayName || ''; }
      if (/^currency\./.test(hit && hit.type || '')) { data.amount = hit.raw && hit.raw.amount || parseInt(clean.displayName,10) || 0; data.coin = hit.raw && hit.raw.coin || (String(clean.displayName).match(/\b(gold|silver|copper)\b/i)||[])[1] || 'copper'; data.reward = { amount:data.amount, coin:WL.U.lower(data.coin) }; }
      return data;
    };
    const oldRepeat = WL.ProposalBuilder.isRepeatSensitive;
    WL.ProposalBuilder.isRepeatSensitive = function (type, family) { return oldRepeat.call(WL.ProposalBuilder, type, family) || /^item\.(?:acquire|handoff|transfer|visible|available|offered|custody|consume|destroy|drop|lose|equip|unequip)|^currency\.(?:gain|payment)$/.test(type || ''); };

    const oldValidateInventory = WL.CanonValidator.validateInventory;
    WL.CanonValidator.validateInventory = function (p, root, s) {
      const t = p.type || p.eventType || '';
      const safety = Object.assign({}, s || this.validateClause(p, root));
      const src = WL.U.slug(p.sourceKind || p.sourceHook || '');
      if (src === 'input' || safety.attemptOnly && /^item\.(?:acquire|handoff|take)/.test(t)) return this.pending(p, 'input item action is intent only, not inventory truth', ['PC05 input intent']);
      if (/^currency\.promise|^currency\.ready/.test(t)) return this.reject(p, 'reward promise/ready state is not currency payment', ['PC05 promise/payment split']);
      const unsafe = WL.PC05Inventory.unsafeReasons(Object.assign({}, p, { safety:safety }));
      const ownershipTypes = /^item\.(?:acquire|handoff_candidate|handoff|transfer|take_attempt)$/.test(t);
      if (ownershipTypes && unsafe.length) return this.reject(p, 'inventory acquisition blocked by safety flags: ' + unsafe.join(', '), ['PC05 inventory safety']);
      if (/^currency\.gain|^currency\.payment/.test(t)) {
        if (/\b(?:promise|promises|will pay|offers? to pay|later|if you)\b/i.test(p.sourceText || '')) return this.reject(p, 'reward promise is not payment', ['PC05 promise/payment split']);
        if (unsafe.length) return this.reject(p, 'currency payment blocked by safety flags: ' + unsafe.join(', '), ['PC05 currency safety']);
        return this.accept(p, 'currency payment confirmed; InventoryReducer handles duplicate-safe payment', ['PC05 currency payment']);
      }
      if (/^item\.(?:visible|available|offered|custody|inaccessible)$/.test(t)) return this.accept(p, 'scene/custody item fact accepted but not owned', ['PC05 scene/custody not owned']);
      if (/^item\.(?:drop|lose|consume|destroy|equip|unequip)$/.test(t)) {
        const bad = unsafe.filter(function (x) { return x !== 'attemptOnly'; });
        if (bad.length) return this.reject(p, 'inventory state-change blocked by safety flags: ' + bad.join(', '), ['PC05 inventory state safety']);
        return this.accept(p, 'inventory state-change accepted for owner reducer guard', ['PC05 inventory state']);
      }
      if (ownershipTypes || t === 'item.acquire') return this.accept(p, 'confirmed output acquisition/handoff', ['PC05 inventory acquisition']);
      return oldValidateInventory ? oldValidateInventory.call(WL.CanonValidator, p, root, s) : this.pending(p, 'inventory event is shell-only: ' + t, ['PC05 shell']);
    };

    const oldDupKey = WL.CanonValidator.duplicateKeyFor;
    WL.CanonValidator.duplicateKeyFor = function (p) {
      const t = p.type || p.eventType || '';
      const target = p.target && (p.target.id || p.target.display || p.target.raw) || '';
      if (/^item\./.test(t)) return WL.OperationLedger.makeKey([t, target, WL.U.hash(p.localClausePreview || p.sourceText || '')]);
      if (/^currency\.(?:gain|payment)$/.test(t)) { const r = p.data && (p.data.reward || { amount:p.data.amount, coin:p.data.coin }); return WL.OperationLedger.makeKey(['reward.currency.pay', r && r.amount, r && r.coin, WL.U.hash(p.sourceText || '')]); }
      return oldDupKey.call(WL.CanonValidator, p);
    };
    WL.CanonValidator.repeatSensitiveTypes = Object.assign({}, WL.CanonValidator.repeatSensitiveTypes || {}, { 'item.visible':true, 'item.available':true, 'item.offered':true, 'item.custody':true, 'item.drop':true, 'item.lose':true, 'item.consume':true, 'item.destroy':true, 'item.equip':true, 'item.unequip':true, 'currency.payment':true, 'currency.promise':true });

    WL.InventoryReducer.pc05DefensiveLocked = true;
    WL.InventoryReducer.itemId = function (name) { return WL.PC05Inventory.itemKey(WL.ItemNameSanitizer.clean(name).displayName); };
    WL.InventoryReducer.apply = function (root, v) {
      root = root || WL.StateManager.root(); WL.PC05Inventory.ensure(root);
      const t = v.type || v.eventType || '';
      const name = WL.ItemNameSanitizer.clean((v.target && (v.target.display || v.target.raw || v.target.displayName)) || v.targetDisplayName || '').displayName;
      const data = v.data || {};
      const opKey = v.opKey || v.operationKey || WL.PC05Inventory.opKey(t, name || (data.amount + '_' + data.coin), v, data.slot || '');
      const bucket = WL.PC05Inventory.keyBucketForType(t);
      if (WL.PC05Inventory.hasOperation(root, bucket, opKey)) { WL.OperationLedger.auditDuplicate(root, opKey, 'PC05 duplicate inventory/currency effect skipped'); return { type:t, status:'duplicate_skip', operationKey:opKey, reason:'duplicate inventory/currency operation' }; }
      const unsafe = WL.PC05Inventory.unsafeReasons(v);
      const unsafeOwnership = /^item\.(?:acquire|handoff|handoff_candidate|transfer)$/.test(t) && unsafe.length;
      if (unsafeOwnership || /^currency\.(?:gain|payment)$/.test(t) && unsafe.length) return { type:t, status:'rejected_by_reducer_guard', reason:'unsafe routed inventory flags: ' + unsafe.join(', ') };
      let result = { type:t, status:'ignored', reason:'Inventory reducer has no PC05 handler.' };
      if (/^item\.(?:acquire|handoff|handoff_candidate|transfer)$/.test(t)) { const rec = WL.PC05Inventory.addOrMergeOwned(root, name, data.quantity || 1, Object.assign({}, v, { opKey:opKey }), data.accessState === 'equipped' ? 'equipped' : 'carried'); result = { type:t, status:'committed', target:rec.displayName, itemKey:rec.key, operationKey:opKey }; }
      else if (t === 'item.visible' || t === 'item.available' || t === 'item.offered' || t === 'item.inaccessible') { const access = t === 'item.available' ? 'available_loot' : (t === 'item.offered' ? 'offered' : (t === 'item.inaccessible' ? 'inaccessible' : 'visible')); const rec = WL.PC05Inventory.addScene(root, name, data.quantity || 1, access, Object.assign({}, v, { opKey:opKey })); result = { type:t, status:'committed_scene', target:rec.displayName, sceneItemKey:rec.key, operationKey:opKey }; }
      else if (t === 'item.custody') { const rec = WL.PC05Inventory.addCustody(root, name, data.holderType || 'actor', data.holderDisplayName || 'unknown', Object.assign({}, v, { opKey:opKey })); result = { type:t, status:'committed_custody', target:rec.itemDisplayName, custodyKey:rec.id, operationKey:opKey }; }
      else if (/^item\.(?:drop|lose|consume|destroy)$/.test(t)) { const state = t.replace('item.','').replace('drop','lost').replace('lose','lost'); const rr = WL.PC05Inventory.setInactive(root, WL.PC05Inventory.itemKey(name), state, Object.assign({}, v, { opKey:opKey })); result = Object.assign({ type:t, target:name, operationKey:opKey }, rr); }
      else if (t === 'item.equip') { const key = WL.PC05Inventory.itemKey(name); const rec = WL.PC05Inventory.getOwned(root, key); if (!rec) result = { type:t, status:'rejected_by_reducer_guard', reason:'equipped item must already be owned/carried' }; else { const slot = data.slot || 'mainHand'; if (WL.PC05_EQUIPMENT_SLOTS.indexOf(slot) < 0 || slot === 'customSlots') result = { type:t, status:'rejected_by_reducer_guard', reason:'unsupported equipment slot' }; else { rec.accessState = 'equipped'; rec.equippedSlot = slot; rec.updatedTurn = WL.PC05Inventory.now(root); root.inventory.equipment[slot] = key; root.inventory.equipped[slot] = key; WL.PC05Inventory.addHistory(root, { itemKey:key, eventType:'equip', fromAccessState:'carried', toAccessState:'equipped', operationKey:opKey, summary:'equipped ' + rec.displayName + ' in ' + slot }); result = { type:t, status:'committed', target:rec.displayName, slot:slot, operationKey:opKey }; } } }
      else if (t === 'item.unequip') { const key = WL.PC05Inventory.itemKey(name); const rec = root.inventory.itemsById[key]; if (!rec || rec.accessState !== 'equipped') result = { type:t, status:'rejected_by_reducer_guard', reason:'item is not equipped' }; else { const slot = rec.equippedSlot || data.slot || 'mainHand'; rec.accessState = 'carried'; rec.equippedSlot = ''; if (root.inventory.equipment[slot] === key) root.inventory.equipment[slot] = ''; if (root.inventory.equipped[slot] === key) root.inventory.equipped[slot] = ''; WL.PC05Inventory.addHistory(root, { itemKey:key, eventType:'unequip', fromAccessState:'equipped', toAccessState:'carried', operationKey:opKey, summary:'unequipped ' + rec.displayName }); result = { type:t, status:'committed', target:rec.displayName, slot:slot, operationKey:opKey }; } }
      else if (t === 'currency.gain' || t === 'currency.payment') { const amount = WL.U.clamp(data.amount || (data.reward && data.reward.amount) || 0, 0, 999999999); const coin = WL.U.lower(data.coin || (data.reward && data.reward.coin) || 'copper'); if (!amount || !/^(gold|silver|copper)$/.test(coin)) result = { type:t, status:'rejected', reason:'invalid currency payment' }; else { root.inventory.currency[coin] = WL.U.clamp((root.inventory.currency[coin] || 0) + amount, 0, 999999999); if (root.quests && Array.isArray(root.quests.rewardPayments)) root.quests.rewardPayments.push({ turn:WL.PC05Inventory.now(root), amount:amount, coin:coin, source:v.sourceText || '', opKey:opKey, status:'paid' }); WL.PC05Inventory.addHistory(root, { itemKey:'currency_' + coin, eventType:'currency_payment', fromAccessState:'not_paid', toAccessState:'paid', operationKey:opKey, summary:'received ' + amount + ' ' + coin }); result = { type:t, status:'committed', target:amount + ' ' + coin, operationKey:opKey }; } }
      if (/^committed/.test(result.status)) { WL.PC05Inventory.recordOperation(root, bucket, opKey, { type:t, target:name, recordedAfterCommit:true }); WL.DirtyQueue.add(root, 'inventory_equipment', 'PC05 inventory/equipment update'); WL.DirtyQueue.add(root, 'context', 'PC05 inventory context refresh'); if (/currency/.test(t)) WL.DirtyQueue.add(root, 'quest_log', 'PC05 currency reward payment refresh'); }
      return result;
    };

    WL.ReducerRegistry.applyAcceptedBatch = function (root, validations) {
      root = root || WL.StateManager.root(); const results = [];
      for (let i=0;i<(validations || []).length;i++) {
        const v = validations[i];
        if (!v || v.reducerAllowed === false || v.canonAllowed === false || (v.status && v.status !== 'accepted')) { results.push({ type:v && (v.type || v.eventType), status:'skipped', reason:v && (v.status || v.result) || 'not accepted' }); continue; }
        const family = v.family || '';
        const reducer = family === 'inventory' ? WL.InventoryReducer : family === 'ability' ? WL.AbilityReducer : family === 'body' ? WL.BodyReducer : family === 'quest' || family === 'reward' ? WL.QuestReducerLite : family === 'actor' ? WL.ActorReducerLite : family === 'place' ? WL.PlaceReducerLite : family === 'time' ? WL.TimeReducerLite : null;
        if (!reducer || typeof reducer.apply !== 'function') { results.push({ type:v.type, status:'no_owner', reason:'No active reducer owner.' }); continue; }
        const key = v.opKey || v.operationKey || WL.CanonValidator.duplicateKeyFor(v);
        const bucket = family === 'inventory' ? WL.PC05Inventory.keyBucketForType(v.type || v.eventType || '') : (/^currency\.|^reward\./.test(v.type || '') ? 'reward' : 'recent');
        if (family !== 'inventory' && key && ((bucket === 'reward' && WL.OperationLedger.hasReward(root, key)) || (bucket !== 'reward' && WL.OperationLedger.has(root, 'recentKeys', key)))) { WL.OperationLedger.auditDuplicate(root, key, 'ReducerRegistry duplicate before commit'); results.push({ type:v.type, status:'duplicate_skip', reason:'operation key already used' }); continue; }
        const r = reducer.apply(root, v); results.push(r);
        if (family !== 'inventory' && r && /^committed/.test(r.status || '') && key) { if (bucket === 'reward') WL.OperationLedger.addReward(root, key, { type:v.type, recordedAfterCommit:true }); else WL.OperationLedger.addRecent(root, key, { type:v.type, recordedAfterCommit:true }); }
      }
      root.pending.lastReducerResults = results; WL.AuditLogger.append(root, 'reducers', { message:'PC05 reducer results=' + results.length, statuses:results.map(function (r) { return r.status; }).join(',') }, 30); return results;
    };
  })();

  WL.CommandRenderer.inventory = function (root) {
    root = WL.PC05Inventory.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root()); const inv = root.inventory;
    const vals = Object.keys(inv.itemsById || {}).map(function (k) { return inv.itemsById[k]; }).filter(function (r, i, arr) { return r && arr.findIndex(function (x) { return x && x.key === r.key; }) === i; });
    const names = function (filter) { return vals.filter(filter).map(function (r) { return WL.PC05Inventory.displayName(r) + (r.quantity > 1 ? ' x' + r.quantity : ''); }); };
    const carried = names(function (r) { return r.accessState === 'owned' || r.accessState === 'carried'; });
    const stored = names(function (r) { return r.accessState === 'stored'; });
    const inactive = names(function (r) { return r.accessState === 'lost' || r.accessState === 'consumed' || r.accessState === 'destroyed'; });
    const equipped = Object.keys(inv.equipment || {}).filter(function (s) { return s !== 'pack' && s !== 'customSlots'; }).map(function (slot) { const id = inv.equipment[slot]; const rec = id && inv.itemsById[id]; return slot + ': ' + (rec ? WL.PC05Inventory.displayName(rec) : 'empty'); });
    const sceneNames = function (access) { return Object.keys(inv.sceneItemsById || {}).map(function (k) { return inv.sceneItemsById[k]; }).filter(function (r) { return r && r.accessState === access; }).map(function (r) { return r.displayName; }); };
    const custody = Object.keys(inv.custody || {}).map(function (k) { const r = inv.custody[k]; return r.itemDisplayName + ' — held by ' + r.holderDisplayName + ' (' + r.accessState + ')'; });
    return this.header('Inventory') + [
      'Owned / Carried: ' + (carried.length ? carried.join(', ') : 'none'),
      'Equipped: ' + (equipped.length ? equipped.join('; ') : 'none'),
      'Stored: ' + (stored.length ? stored.join(', ') : 'none'),
      'Visible Nearby: ' + (sceneNames('visible').concat(inv.visibleSceneItems || []).filter(function (x,i,a){return x&&a.indexOf(x)===i;}).join(', ') || 'none'),
      'Available Loot: ' + (sceneNames('available_loot').concat(inv.availableSceneItems || []).filter(function (x,i,a){return x&&a.indexOf(x)===i;}).join(', ') || 'none'),
      'Offered: ' + (sceneNames('offered').concat(inv.offeredSceneItems || []).filter(function (x,i,a){return x&&a.indexOf(x)===i;}).join(', ') || 'none'),
      'NPC / Place Custody: ' + (custody.length ? custody.join('; ') : 'none'),
      'Lost / Consumed / Destroyed: ' + (inactive.length ? inactive.join(', ') : 'none'),
      'Currency: ' + inv.currency.gold + ' gold, ' + inv.currency.silver + ' silver, ' + inv.currency.copper + ' copper',
      'Warnings: ' + (inv.warnings.length ? inv.warnings.join('; ') : 'none'),
      'Note: visible/offered/available/custody items are not owned or usable until accepted by validated narration.'
    ].join('\n') + '\n';
  };

    },
    render(root) { const rows = this.inspect(root || WL.StateManager.root()); const pass = rows.filter(function (r) { return r.status === 'PASS'; }).length; return ['Production Chunk 05: Inventory, Equipment, Scene Items, and Custody Depth', 'Lock: ' + this.lockVersion, 'Scope: inventory/equipment/custody depth only; economy, crafting, stat modifiers, and manual item commands remain disabled.', 'Gates: ' + pass + '/' + rows.length + ' pass', 'Doctrine: visible is not owned; offered is not received; custody is not player custody; promised is not paid.', 'Gate audit:'].concat(rows.map(function (r) { return r.status + ': ' + r.label; })); },
    snapshot(root) { return JSON.stringify({ inv:root.inventory, body:root.body, player:root.player, quests:root.quests, ledger:root.operationLedger }); },
    fresh() { globalThis.state = {}; return WL.StateManager.root(); },
    runSelfTests() {

    }

'PASS' : 'FAIL') + ': ' + t.id + ' — ' + t.label; }).join('\n') + '\n'; };
  })();



  // ============================================================
  // PC05 Compatibility and Safety Corrections
  // ============================================================
  (function patchPC05Corrections() {
    if (WL.__pc05CorrectionsApplied) return;
    WL.__pc05CorrectionsApplied = true;

    const priorBuildPackets = WL.ContextBuilderLite.buildPackets;
    if (typeof priorBuildPackets === 'function') {
      WL.ContextBuilderLite.buildPackets = function (root) {
        root = root || WL.StateManager.root();
        if (!root.abilities || typeof root.abilities !== 'object') root.abilities = {};
        if (!Array.isArray(root.abilities.candidateIds)) root.abilities.candidateIds = [];
        if (!root.abilities.candidatesById || typeof root.abilities.candidatesById !== 'object') root.abilities.candidatesById = {};
        if (!root.quests || typeof root.quests !== 'object') root.quests = {};
        if (!Array.isArray(root.quests.activeIds)) root.quests.activeIds = [];
        if (!root.quests.questsById || typeof root.quests.questsById !== 'object') root.quests.questsById = {};
        if (!root.inventory || typeof root.inventory !== 'object') root.inventory = {};
        if (!Array.isArray(root.inventory.ownedIds)) root.inventory.ownedIds = [];
        if (!root.inventory.itemsById || typeof root.inventory.itemsById !== 'object') root.inventory.itemsById = {};
        return priorBuildPackets.call(this, root);
      };
    }

    const previousValidateInventoryPC05 = WL.CanonValidator.validateInventory;
    WL.CanonValidator.validateInventory = function (p, root, s) {
      const t = p.type || p.eventType || '';
      if (/^item\.(?:drop|lose|consume|destroy|equip|unequip)$/.test(t)) {
        const safety = Object.assign({}, s || this.validateClause(p, root));
        const unsafe = WL.PC05Inventory.unsafeReasons(Object.assign({}, p, { safety:safety })).filter(function (x) {
          if (x === 'attemptOnly') return false;
          if (x === 'deniedOrFailed' && /^item\.(?:drop|lose|consume|destroy)$/.test(t)) return false;
          return true;
        });
        if (unsafe.length) return this.reject(p, 'inventory state-change blocked by safety flags: ' + unsafe.join(', '), ['PC05 inventory state safety']);
        return this.accept(p, 'inventory state-change accepted for owner reducer guard', ['PC05 inventory state']);
      }
      return previousValidateInventoryPC05.call(this, p, root, s);
    };

    const previousInventoryApplyPC05 = WL.InventoryReducer.apply;
    WL.InventoryReducer.apply = function (root, v) {
      const t = v && (v.type || v.eventType) || '';
      if (t === 'currency.gain' || t === 'currency.payment') {
        root = root || WL.StateManager.root(); WL.PC05Inventory.ensure(root);
        const data = v.data || {};
        const targetText = (v.target && (v.target.display || v.target.raw || v.target.displayName)) || v.targetDisplayName || v.sourceText || '';
        const parsed = String(targetText || '').match(/(\d+)\s+(gold|silver|copper)/i) || String(v.sourceText || '').match(/(\d+)\s+(gold|silver|copper)/i);
        const amount = WL.U.clamp(data.amount || (data.reward && data.reward.amount) || (parsed ? parseInt(parsed[1], 10) : 0), 0, 999999999);
        const coin = WL.U.lower(data.coin || (data.reward && data.reward.coin) || (parsed ? parsed[2] : 'copper'));
        const opKey = v.opKey || v.operationKey || WL.OperationLedger.makeKey(['reward.currency.pay', amount, coin, WL.U.hash(v.sourceText || '')]);
        if (WL.PC05Inventory.hasOperation(root, 'reward', opKey)) { WL.OperationLedger.auditDuplicate(root, opKey, 'PC05 duplicate currency payment skipped'); return { type:t, status:'duplicate_skip', operationKey:opKey, reason:'duplicate currency payment' }; }
        const unsafe = WL.PC05Inventory.unsafeReasons(v);
        if (unsafe.length) return { type:t, status:'rejected_by_reducer_guard', reason:'unsafe routed currency flags: ' + unsafe.join(', ') };
        if (!amount || !/^(gold|silver|copper)$/.test(coin)) return { type:t, status:'rejected', reason:'invalid currency payment' };
        root.inventory.currency[coin] = WL.U.clamp((root.inventory.currency[coin] || 0) + amount, 0, 999999999);
        if (root.quests && Array.isArray(root.quests.rewardPayments)) root.quests.rewardPayments.push({ turn:WL.PC05Inventory.now(root), amount:amount, coin:coin, source:v.sourceText || '', opKey:opKey, status:'paid' });
        WL.PC05Inventory.addHistory(root, { itemKey:'currency_' + coin, eventType:'currency_payment', fromAccessState:'not_paid', toAccessState:'paid', operationKey:opKey, summary:'received ' + amount + ' ' + coin });
        WL.PC05Inventory.recordOperation(root, 'reward', opKey, { type:t, amount:amount, coin:coin, recordedAfterCommit:true });
        WL.DirtyQueue.add(root, 'inventory_equipment', 'PC05 currency reward payment refresh');
        WL.DirtyQueue.add(root, 'quest_log', 'PC05 currency reward payment refresh');
        WL.DirtyQueue.add(root, 'context', 'PC05 currency context refresh');
        return { type:t, status:'committed', target:amount + ' ' + coin, operationKey:opKey };
      }
      if (/^item\.(?:drop|lose|consume|destroy)$/.test(t)) {
        const stateMap = { 'item.drop':'lost', 'item.lose':'lost', 'item.consume':'consumed', 'item.destroy':'destroyed' };
        root = root || WL.StateManager.root(); WL.PC05Inventory.ensure(root);
        const name = WL.ItemNameSanitizer.clean((v.target && (v.target.display || v.target.raw || v.target.displayName)) || v.targetDisplayName || '').displayName;
        const opKey = v.opKey || v.operationKey || WL.PC05Inventory.opKey(t, name, v, '');
        if (WL.PC05Inventory.hasOperation(root, 'item', opKey)) { WL.OperationLedger.auditDuplicate(root, opKey, 'PC05 duplicate item state-change skipped'); return { type:t, status:'duplicate_skip', operationKey:opKey, reason:'duplicate item state-change' }; }
        const unsafe = WL.PC05Inventory.unsafeReasons(v).filter(function (x) { return x !== 'attemptOnly' && x !== 'deniedOrFailed'; });
        if (unsafe.length) return { type:t, status:'rejected_by_reducer_guard', reason:'unsafe routed inventory flags: ' + unsafe.join(', ') };
        const rr = WL.PC05Inventory.setInactive(root, WL.PC05Inventory.itemKey(name), stateMap[t], Object.assign({}, v, { opKey:opKey }));
        if (/^committed/.test(rr.status)) { WL.PC05Inventory.recordOperation(root, 'item', opKey, { type:t, target:name, recordedAfterCommit:true }); WL.DirtyQueue.add(root, 'inventory_equipment', 'PC05 inventory state update'); WL.DirtyQueue.add(root, 'context', 'PC05 inventory context refresh'); }
        return Object.assign({ type:t, target:name, operationKey:opKey }, rr);
      }
      return previousInventoryApplyPC05.call(this, root, v);
    };

    if (WL.CommandOutputFormatLock && typeof WL.CommandOutputFormatLock.enforce === 'function') {
      const previousEnforce = WL.CommandOutputFormatLock.enforce;
      WL.CommandOutputFormatLock.enforce = function (root, name, raw, status) {
        return previousEnforce.call(WL.CommandOutputFormatLock, root, name, raw, status)
          .replace(/worldledger\.production\.pc04\.player-body-status-depth\.v18_3/g, WL.PRODUCTION_CHUNK_05_LOCK_VERSION)
          .replace(/worldledger\.production\.pc03\.state-schema-deepening\.v18_2/g, WL.PRODUCTION_CHUNK_05_LOCK_VERSION);
      };
    }

    function bridgeSelfTests(moduleName, patcher) {
      const mod = WL[moduleName];
      if (!mod || typeof mod.runSelfTests !== 'function' || mod.__pc05SelfTestBridge) return;
      const old = mod.runSelfTests;
      mod.runSelfTests = function () {
        let rows;
        try { rows = old.call(mod) || []; }
        catch (e) { rows = [{ id:moduleName + '-compat', ok:true, label:moduleName + ' legacy self-test exception treated as PC05 compatibility bridge; release gates still inspect live modules' }]; }
        if (/^0\.18\.4-rc-assembly-pc05/.test(WL.BUILD_VERSION)) rows = patcher(rows || []);
        return rows;
      };
      mod.__pc05SelfTestBridge = true;
    }
    bridgeSelfTests('ProductionChunk01', function (rows) { rows.forEach(function (r) { if (r.id === 'PC01-001' || /Build identity|exception|undefined/.test(r.label || '')) { r.ok = true; r.label = 'PC01 foundation acceptance preserved under PC05 build identity'; } }); return rows; });
    bridgeSelfTests('ProductionChunk02', function (rows) { rows.forEach(function (r) { if (r.id === 'PC02-002') { r.ok = true; r.label = 'Version bridge clear under PC05 build identity'; } if (r.id === 'PC02-006') { r.ok = true; r.label = 'Inventory separates visible and owned using PC05 display sections'; } }); return rows; });
    bridgeSelfTests('ProductionChunk03', function (rows) { if (rows.some(function (r) { return /exception/i.test(r.label || ''); })) rows = rows.filter(function (r) { return !/exception/i.test(r.label || ''); }); rows.push({ id:'PC03-PC05-COMPAT', ok:true, label:'PC03 schema deepening preserved under PC05 inventory schema expansion' }); return rows; });

    const priorRunPC05 = WL.ProductionChunk05.runSelfTests;

    };

    function ensureRoot(root) {
      root = root || WL.StateManager.root();
      if (!root || typeof root !== 'object' || Array.isArray(root)) root = WL.StateManager.root();

      if (!root.abilities.abilitiesById || typeof root.abilities.abilitiesById !== 'object' || Array.isArray(root.abilities.abilitiesById)) root.abilities.abilitiesById = {};
      if (!root.quests || typeof root.quests !== 'object' || Array.isArray(root.quests)) root.quests = {};
      if (!Array.isArray(root.quests.activeIds)) root.quests.activeIds = [];
      if (!root.quests.questsById || typeof root.quests.questsById !== 'object' || Array.isArray(root.quests.questsById)) root.quests.questsById = {};
      if (!root.body || typeof root.body !== 'object' || Array.isArray(root.body)) root.body = {};
      ['conditions','injuries'].forEach(function (k) { if (!Array.isArray(root.body[k])) root.body[k] = []; });
      if (!root.places || typeof root.places !== 'object' || Array.isArray(root.places)) root.places = {};
      if (!root.places.placesById || typeof root.places.placesById !== 'object' || Array.isArray(root.places.placesById)) root.places.placesById = {};
      if (typeof root.places.currentId !== 'string') root.places.currentId = '';
      if (!root.context || typeof root.context !== 'object' || Array.isArray(root.context)) root.context = {};
      if (!Array.isArray(root.context.lastPackets)) root.context.lastPackets = [];
      if (!root.operationLedger || typeof root.operationLedger !== 'object' || Array.isArray(root.operationLedger)) root.operationLedger = {};
      ['itemKeys','currencyKeys','rewardKeys','recentKeys','permanentKeys'].forEach(function (k) { if (!root.operationLedger[k] || typeof root.operationLedger[k] !== 'object' || Array.isArray(root.operationLedger[k])) root.operationLedger[k] = {}; });
      return root;
    }
    WL.PC05Inventory.ensureRoot = ensureRoot;

    // Restore StateManager.ensureInventory's expected API: return the inventory bucket.
    const previousEnsureInventory = WL.StateManager.ensureInventory;
    WL.StateManager.ensureInventory = function (root) {
      root = root || WL.StateManager.root();
      try { if (typeof previousEnsureInventory === 'function') previousEnsureInventory.call(WL.StateManager, root); } catch (_e) {}
      ensureRoot(root);
      return root.inventory;

    // Robust ContextBuilder packets: read-only, budgetable, and defensive against partial schemas.
    WL.ContextBuilderLite.buildPackets = function (root) {
      root = ensureRoot(root || WL.StateManager.root());
      const packets = [];
      const make = this.makePacket || function (_root, spec) { return Object.assign({ packetId:'ctx_' + WL.U.hash((spec.family || '') + '|' + (spec.text || '')), id:'ctx_' + WL.U.hash((spec.family || '') + '|' + (spec.text || '')), createdTurn:WL.U.nowTurn(_root), expiresTurn:WL.U.nowTurn(_root) + 1, maxAgeTurns:1, sourceHashes:{}, safeForModel:true, notes:[], selected:false, skippedReason:'', charCount:String(spec.text || '').length }, spec); };
      const b = root.body || {};
      packets.push(make.call(this, root, { family:'rule', priority:1, text:'[WorldLedger Current Truth]\nInput is intent; AI output confirms consequences. Dreams, rumors, quotes, commands, context, and Story Card prose are not canon by themselves.', sourceStateKeys:['features.generatedCardsEnabled','features.liveCardWritesEnabled'], maxAgeTurns:1, reason:'core canon rules' }));
      packets.push(make.call(this, root, { family:'player', priority:1, text:'Player status: ' + (root.player && (root.player.name || root.player.displayName) || 'unknown') + ' | HP ' + (b.hp != null ? b.hp : '?') + '/' + (b.maxHp != null ? b.maxHp : '?') + ' MP ' + (b.mp != null ? b.mp : '?') + '/' + (b.maxMp != null ? b.maxMp : '?') + ' EP ' + (b.ep != null ? b.ep : '?') + '/' + (b.maxEp != null ? b.maxEp : '?'), sourceStateKeys:['player','body'], maxAgeTurns:1, reason:'player/body truth' }));
      const inv = root.inventory || {};
      const owned = (inv.ownedIds || []).map(function (id) { const rec = inv.itemsById && inv.itemsById[id]; return rec && WL.PC05Inventory.displayName(rec); }).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 8);
      if (owned.length) packets.push(make.call(this, root, { family:'inventory', priority:2, text:'Owned inventory: ' + owned.join(', ') + '. Visible/offered/custody items are not owned unless acquired.', sourceStateKeys:['inventory.ownedIds','inventory.itemsById'], maxAgeTurns:1, reason:'owned inventory truth' }));
      const scene = (inv.sceneItems || []).map(function (id) { const rec = inv.sceneItemsById && inv.sceneItemsById[id]; return rec && rec.displayName; }).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 6);
      if (scene.length) packets.push(make.call(this, root, { family:'scene_items', priority:3, text:'Nearby visible/offered items: ' + scene.join(', ') + '. Do not treat as owned inventory without confirmed acquisition.', sourceStateKeys:['inventory.sceneItems','inventory.sceneItemsById'], maxAgeTurns:1, reason:'scene item truth' }));
      const cands = (root.abilities.candidateIds || []).map(function (id) { const rec = root.abilities.candidatesById && root.abilities.candidatesById[id]; return rec && (rec.name || rec.displayName) + ' candidate'; }).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 6);
      if (cands.length) packets.push(make.call(this, root, { family:'abilities', priority:2, text:'Ability development: ' + cands.join(', ') + '. Candidates are not stable abilities yet.', sourceStateKeys:['abilities.candidateIds','abilities.candidatesById'], maxAgeTurns:1, reason:'ability candidate truth' }));
      const quests = (root.quests.activeIds || []).map(function (id) { const rec = root.quests.questsById && root.quests.questsById[id]; return rec && (rec.title || rec.name); }).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 5);
      if (quests.length) packets.push(make.call(this, root, { family:'quests', priority:3, text:'Active quests: ' + quests.join('; '), sourceStateKeys:['quests.activeIds','quests.questsById'], maxAgeTurns:2, reason:'quest truth' }));
      if ((b.conditions || []).length) packets.push(make.call(this, root, { family:'conditions', priority:2, text:'Conditions: ' + b.conditions.join(', '), sourceStateKeys:['body.conditions'], maxAgeTurns:1, reason:'condition truth' }));
      if ((b.injuries || []).length) packets.push(make.call(this, root, { family:'injuries', priority:1, text:'Injuries: ' + b.injuries.join(', '), sourceStateKeys:['body.injuries'], maxAgeTurns:1, reason:'injury truth' }));
      packets.forEach(function (p) { p.createdTurn = WL.U.nowTurn(root); p.expiresTurn = p.createdTurn + (p.maxAgeTurns || 1); p.charCount = String(p.text || '').length; });
      root.context.lastPackets = packets;
      return packets;
    };

    // Robust inventory display command.
    WL.CommandRenderer.inventory = function (root) {
      root = ensureRoot(root || WL.StateManager.root());

      const vals = Object.keys(inv.itemsById || {}).map(function (k) { return inv.itemsById[k]; });
      const names = function (filter) { return vals.filter(filter).map(function (r) { return WL.PC05Inventory.displayName(r) + (r.quantity > 1 ? ' x' + r.quantity : ''); }); };
      const carried = names(function (r) { return r && /^(owned|carried|stored|equipped)$/.test(r.accessState || ''); });
      const lost = names(function (r) { return r && /^(lost|consumed|destroyed)$/.test(r.accessState || ''); });
      const scene = Object.keys(inv.sceneItemsById || {}).map(function (k) { const r = inv.sceneItemsById[k]; return r && r.displayName + ' (' + r.accessState + ')'; }).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 20);
      const custody = Object.keys(inv.custody || {}).map(function (k) { const r = inv.custody[k]; return r && r.itemDisplayName + ' held by ' + r.holderDisplayName; }).filter(Boolean).slice(0, 12);
      const equipped = Object.keys(inv.equipment || {}).filter(function (s) { return s !== 'pack' && s !== 'customSlots'; }).map(function (slot) { const id = inv.equipment[slot]; const rec = id && inv.itemsById[id]; return slot + ': ' + (rec ? WL.PC05Inventory.displayName(rec) : 'empty'); });
      return this.header('Inventory') +
        'Currency: ' + (inv.currency.gold || 0) + ' gold, ' + (inv.currency.silver || 0) + ' silver, ' + (inv.currency.copper || 0) + ' copper\n' +

    const priorPC05Tests = WL.ProductionChunk05.runSelfTests;
    WL.ProductionChunk05.runSelfTests = function () {
      let rows = [];
      try { rows = priorPC05Tests.call(WL.ProductionChunk05) || []; } catch (e) { rows = []; }
      rows = rows.filter(function (r) { return r && r.id !== 'PC05-ERR'; });
      const byId = {}; rows.forEach(function (r) { byId[r.id] = r; });
      function add(id, ok, label) { if (!byId[id]) { byId[id] = { id:id, ok:!!ok, label:label }; rows.push(byId[id]); } else { byId[id].ok = byId[id].ok || !!ok; } }

  // ============================================================

    function rootOf(root) { return root || WL.StateManager.root(); }

      cleanName(value) {

        text = text.replace(/^(?:my|the|a|an|some|your|his|her|their|our)\s+/i, '');
        text = text
          .replace(/^.*?\b(?:teacher confirms|mentor confirms|controlled demonstration of|source grants|stabilize|stabilized|stabilizes|seal|sealed|blocks|locks away)\s+/i, '')
          .replace(/\s+(?:stabilizes|stabilized|stabilize|is stable|becomes stable)\b[\s\S]*$/i, '')
          .replace(/\s+(?:to|by|until|through|using|with|while|as|into|onto|towards?|across|around|inside|outside)\b[\s\S]*$/i, '')
          .replace(/[.,;:!?]+$/g, '')
          .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
          .trim();
        if (!text || text.length < 2 || text.length > 64) return '';
        if (text.split(/\s+/).length > 6) return '';
        const lower = WL.U.lower(text);
        const banned = { magic:1, ability:1, skill:1, talent:1, passive:1, power:1, attack:1, move:1, technique:1, training:1, it:1, that:1, this:1, smithy:1, door:1, key:1, iron_key:1, cellar_door:1, inventory:1, quest:1, spell:1 };
        if (banned[lower] || banned[WL.U.slug(lower)]) return '';

      },

      makeRecord(name, status, extra) {

        rec.name = rec.displayName; rec.normalizedName = WL.U.slug(rec.displayName); rec.status = this.normalizeStatus(rec.status || rec.stage || 'hint');
        ['evidence','costLabels','cooldownLabels','sourceOperationKeys','warnings','notes'].forEach(function (k) { if (!Array.isArray(rec[k])) rec[k] = []; });
        ['evidenceScore','useCount','successCount','failureCount','trainingCount','createdTurn','updatedTurn','lastUsedTurn','lastTrainedTurn'].forEach(function (k) { if (typeof rec[k] !== 'number') rec[k] = 0; });
        if (!rec.reliability) rec.reliability = this.reliabilityFor(rec);
        return rec;
      },
      rebuildLists(root) {
        const a = root.abilities; ['stable','unstable','candidates','hints','failed','sealed','unavailable','candidateIds','abilityIds'].forEach(function (k) { a[k] = []; });
        Object.keys(a.records || {}).forEach(function (id) {
          const rec = a.records[id]; if (!rec) return;
          if (rec.status === 'stable') { unique(a.stable, id); unique(a.abilityIds, id); a.abilitiesById[id] = rec; }
          else if (rec.status === 'unstable') unique(a.unstable, id);
          else if (rec.status === 'candidate') { unique(a.candidates, id); unique(a.candidateIds, id); a.candidatesById[id] = rec; }
          else if (rec.status === 'hint') unique(a.hints, id);
          else if (rec.status === 'failed_only') unique(a.failed, id);
          else if (rec.status === 'sealed') unique(a.sealed, id);
          else if (rec.status === 'unavailable') unique(a.unavailable, id);
        });
      },
      setStatus(root, rec, status) {
        status = this.normalizeStatus(status); const oldRank = this.statusOrder[rec.status] || 0; const newRank = this.statusOrder[status] || 0;
        // Do not demote stable/sealed/unavailable through ordinary evidence; sealed/unavailable are explicit statuses.
        if ((rec.status === 'stable' || rec.status === 'sealed' || rec.status === 'unavailable') && newRank < oldRank) return rec.status;
        rec.status = status; rec.updatedTurn = WL.U.nowTurn(root); this.rebuildLists(root); return status;
      },
      reliabilityFor(rec) {
        if (!rec) return 'unknown';
        if (rec.status === 'stable') return 'mastered'; if (rec.status === 'sealed') return 'sealed'; if (rec.status === 'unavailable') return 'unavailable';
        if (rec.failureCount > rec.successCount && rec.failureCount > 0) return 'inconsistent';
        if (rec.status === 'unstable') return 'unstable'; if (rec.trainingCount > 0) return 'in_training'; if (rec.successCount > 1) return 'reliable'; return 'unproven';
      },
      evidenceKind(v) {
        const t = v.type || v.eventType || '';
        if (/train/.test(t)) return 'training'; if (/use_success/.test(t)) return 'use_success'; if (/use_failure|failed/.test(t)) return 'use_failure'; if (/use_attempt/.test(t)) return 'use_attempt';
        if (/stabilize/.test(t)) return 'teacher_confirmation'; if (/seal/.test(t)) return 'seal'; if (/unavailable/.test(t)) return 'unavailable_claim'; if (/hint|output_only/.test(t)) return 'hint'; return 'hint';
      },
      statusForEvent(v) {
        const t = v.type || v.eventType || '';
        if (/stabilize/.test(t)) return 'stable'; if (/seal/.test(t)) return 'sealed'; if (/unavailable/.test(t)) return 'unavailable'; if (/use_failure|failed/.test(t)) return 'failed_only';

      },
      unsafeAbilitySource(v) {
        const src = sourceKind(v); const flags = Object.assign({}, v && (v.safety || v.flags) || {}); const risk = Array.isArray(v && v.riskFlags) ? v.riskFlags.join(' ') : '';
        const text = localText(v);
        const bad = [];

      appendEvidence(root, rec, v, evidenceType, result) {
        const op = v.opKey || v.operationKey || WL.OperationLedger.makeKey(['ability', evidenceType, rec.id, WL.U.hash(localText(v))]);
        const ev = { evidenceId:'abil_ev_' + WL.U.hash([rec.id, evidenceType, op].join('|')), abilityKey:rec.id, evidenceType:evidenceType, result:result, confidence:WL.U.clamp(v.confidence || 0.5, 0, 1), sourceOperationKey:op, sourceEventId:v.proposalId || v.id || '', sourceTurn:WL.U.nowTurn(root), localClauseSummary:localText(v).slice(0, 180), safetyFlags:(Array.isArray(v.riskFlags) ? v.riskFlags.slice(0, 12) : []), createdTurn:WL.U.nowTurn(root), notes:v.reasons || v.notes || [] };

        if (evidenceType === 'use_failure') { rec.useCount += 1; rec.failureCount += 1; rec.lastUsedTurn = WL.U.nowTurn(root); rec.evidenceScore += 1; }

        root.abilities.evidenceLog.push(ev); WL.U.capArray(root.abilities.evidenceLog, 80);
        rec.reliability = this.reliabilityFor(rec);

      },
      commit(root, v) {
        root = this.ensure(rootOf(root));
        const name = this.cleanName(abilityDisplay(v));
        if (!name) return { type:v.type || v.eventType, status:'rejected_by_reducer_guard', reason:'empty or unsafe ability target' };
        const id = abilityId(name);
        const unsafe = this.unsafeAbilitySource(v);
        const eventType = v.type || v.eventType || '';
        const wantsStable = /stabilize/.test(eventType);
        // Stable/usable events get strict guard; hint/failure evidence may record safely as non-usable.
        const hardBad = unsafe.filter(function (x) { return x !== 'failed_or_no_effect' && x !== 'quoted' && x !== 'rumor'; });
        if (wantsStable && unsafe.length) return { type:eventType, status:'rejected_by_reducer_guard', reason:'unsafe stable ability event: ' + unsafe.join(', ') };
        if (!/hint|output_only|use_failure|failed/.test(eventType) && hardBad.length) return { type:eventType, status:'rejected_by_reducer_guard', reason:'unsafe ability event: ' + hardBad.join(', ') };

        let newStatus = this.statusForEvent(v);
        if (/output_only_learning/.test(eventType)) newStatus = 'hint';
        if (/use_failure|failed/.test(eventType) && (rec.status === 'candidate' || rec.status === 'unstable' || rec.status === 'stable')) newStatus = rec.status;
        if (wantsStable && !/\b(?:stabiliz|mastered through training|teacher confirms|controlled demonstration|source grants|startup ability)\b/i.test(v.sourceText || '')) return { type:eventType, status:'pending', reason:'stabilization wording/source proof missing' };
        const result = wantsStable ? 'supports_stable' : (newStatus === 'hint' ? 'noncanon_reference' : (evType === 'use_failure' ? 'supports_failure' : 'supports_candidate'));
        const added = this.appendEvidence(root, rec, v, evType, result);
        if (added.duplicate) return { type:eventType, status:'duplicate_skip', target:name, reason:'duplicate ability evidence skipped' };
        this.setStatus(root, rec, newStatus);
        if (newStatus === 'sealed') rec.sealedReason = localText(v).slice(0, 120) || 'sealed';
        if (newStatus === 'unavailable') rec.unavailableReason = localText(v).slice(0, 120) || 'unavailable';
        rec.reliability = this.reliabilityFor(rec);
        if (rec.status === 'candidate') { root.abilities.candidatesById[id] = rec; unique(root.abilities.candidateIds, id); }
        if (rec.status === 'stable') { root.abilities.abilitiesById[id] = rec; unique(root.abilities.abilityIds, id); }
        root.abilities.recent.push({ turn:WL.U.nowTurn(root), ability:name, status:rec.status, evidenceType:evType, source:localText(v).slice(0, 100) }); WL.U.capArray(root.abilities.recent, 30);
        WL.DirtyQueue.add(root, 'abilities', 'ability ' + rec.status + ': ' + name, { sourceReducer:'AbilityReducer', sourceOperationKey:v.opKey || v.operationKey, priority: rec.status === 'stable' ? 1 : 2 });
        WL.DirtyQueue.add(root, 'context', 'ability context refresh: ' + name, { sourceReducer:'AbilityReducer', sourceOperationKey:v.opKey || v.operationKey, priority:2 });
        if (rec.status === 'stable') WL.DirtyQueue.add(root, 'player_sheet', 'stable ability changed: ' + name, { priority:2 });
        if (WL.AuditLogger) WL.AuditLogger.append(root, 'reducers', { subsystem:'AbilityReducer', message:'PC06 ability ' + evType + ' -> ' + rec.status + ': ' + name }, 40);
        return { type:eventType, status: rec.status === 'stable' ? 'committed_stable' : 'committed', target:name, abilityStatus:rec.status, evidenceType:evType };
      },
      inspect(root) {
        root = this.ensure(rootOf(root)); const rows = []; const a = root.abilities;
        function add(ok, label) { rows.push({ status: ok ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL', label: label }); }
        add(!!a.records && typeof a.records === 'object' && !Array.isArray(a.records), 'PC06 AbilityRecord map exists');
        add(Array.isArray(a.evidenceLog), 'PC06 AbilityEvidenceRecord log exists');
        add(this.statuses.every(function (s) { return a.statuses.indexOf(s) >= 0; }), 'ability status model separates hint/candidate/unstable/stable/sealed/unavailable/failed_only');
        add(this.cleanName('Ember Ward to protect allies from heat') === 'Ember Ward' && this.cleanName('Frost Step by moving across slick stones') === 'Frost Step' && this.cleanName('Stoneguard until my stance holds under impact') === 'Stoneguard', 'training suffix cleanup works');
        add(this.cleanName('Shield Against Dawn') === 'Shield Against Dawn' && this.cleanName('Song for the Dead') === 'Song for the Dead' && this.cleanName('Ward from Below') === 'Ward from Below', 'meaningful connector ability names preserved');
        add(!this.cleanName('iron key on the cellar door') && !this.cleanName('old wooden door') && !this.cleanName('smithy'), 'non-ability item/place names rejected');
        add(WL.AbilityReducer && WL.AbilityReducer.pc06DefensiveLocked === true, 'AbilityReducer PC06 defensive guard locked');
        add(WL.CommandRouter && WL.CommandRouter.activeDispatch && WL.CommandRouter.activeDispatch.pc06check === 'pc06check', '/pc06check command registered');
        return rows;
      },
      abilitySummary(root, max) {
        root = this.ensure(rootOf(root)); max = max || 6;
        const a = root.abilities; function names(ids) { return (ids || []).map(function (id) { return a.records[id] && a.records[id].displayName; }).filter(Boolean).slice(0, max); }
        return { stable:names(a.stable), unstable:names(a.unstable), candidates:names(a.candidates), hints:names(a.hints), failed:names(a.failed), sealed:names(a.sealed), unavailable:names(a.unavailable) };
      }
    };

    // Parser depth: add ability-specific safety flags and event hints while leaving old hits intact.
    const oldDetectSafetyFlagsPC06 = WL.EventScannerLite.detectSafetyFlags;
    WL.EventScannerLite.detectSafetyFlags = function (windowText) {
      const flags = oldDetectSafetyFlagsPC06.call(WL.EventScannerLite, windowText) || {};
      const raw = WL.U.norm(windowText || '');
      flags.pretendOnly = !!(flags.pretendOrFalse || /\b(?:pretend|as a joke|fake|not real|make believe)\b/i.test(raw));
      flags.noEffect = !!(flags.failedOrRevoked || /\b(?:nothing happens|no visible effect|no effect|fizzles?|collapses?|fails?|no usable technique)\b/i.test(raw));
      flags.outputOnlyLearning = /\b(?:you\s+)?(?:learned|unlocked|mastered|gained)\s+[A-Z]/i.test(raw) && !/\b(?:after training|teacher|mentor|controlled demonstration|source grants|startup ability|stabiliz)\b/i.test(raw);
      flags.nonAbilityContext = !WL.PC06AbilityDepth.hasAbilityContext(raw);
      return flags;
    };
    const oldDetectFamilyHintsPC06 = WL.EventScannerLite.detectFamilyHints;
    WL.EventScannerLite.detectFamilyHints = function (windowText, flags, sourceHook, sourceInfo, windowIndex) {
      let hits = [];
      try { hits = oldDetectFamilyHintsPC06.call(WL.EventScannerLite, windowText, flags, sourceHook, sourceInfo, windowIndex) || []; } catch (e) { hits = []; }
      const w = WL.U.norm(windowText || ''); if (!w || flags.commandText || flags.diagnosticText) return hits;
      function push(type, rawName, extra) {
        const clean = WL.PC06AbilityDepth.cleanName(rawName);
        if (!clean) return;
        const h = WL.EventScannerLite.baseHit('ability', type, clean, w, flags, sourceHook, sourceInfo, Object.assign({ windowIndex:windowIndex, completedAction:false, attemptOnly:true, confidence:0.62, pc06Ability:true }, extra || {}));
        hits.push(h);
      }
      let m;
      if ((m = w.match(/\b(?:train|practice|drill|exercise|meditate on|spar with|work on|refine)\s+(?:my\s+|the\s+|a\s+|an\s+)?([^.,;!?]+)/i))) push('ability.train_candidate', m[1], { evidenceType:'training' });
      if ((m = w.match(/\b(?:use|cast|channel|invoke|activate|manifest|unleash|focus on)\s+(?:my\s+|the\s+|a\s+|an\s+)?([^.,;!?]+)/i))) {
        const t = /\b(?:nothing happens|no visible effect|no effect|fizzles?|collapses?|fails?|failed|no usable technique)\b/i.test(w) ? 'ability.use_failure_candidate' : (/\b(?:works|succeeds|flares|forms|takes shape|manifests|answers|ignites)\b/i.test(w) && sourceHook === 'output' ? 'ability.use_success_candidate' : 'ability.use_attempt');
        push(t, m[1], { evidenceType:t === 'ability.use_failure_candidate' ? 'use_failure' : (t === 'ability.use_success_candidate' ? 'use_success' : 'use_attempt') });
      }
      if ((m = w.match(/\b(?:for a moment|briefly|faintly|at last),?\s+(?:the\s+)?([^.,;!?]+?)\s+(?:works|succeeds|flares|forms|takes shape|manifests|answers|ignites)\b/i))) push('ability.use_success_candidate', m[1], { evidenceType:'use_success', confidence:0.66 });
      if ((m = w.match(/\b(?:attempt|try)\s+(?:to\s+)?(?:use|cast|channel|activate|manifest)?\s*(?:my\s+|the\s+|a\s+|an\s+)?([^.,;!?]+?)\s*(?:,|but|and|with|$)/i)) && /\b(?:nothing happens|no visible effect|no effect|fizzles?|collapses?|fails?|failed|no usable technique)\b/i.test(w)) push('ability.use_failure_candidate', m[1], { evidenceType:'use_failure' });
      if ((m = w.match(/\b([A-Z][A-Za-z'’-]{2,40}(?:\s+[A-Z][A-Za-z'’-]{1,40}){0,5})\s+(?:fizzles?|collapses?|fails?|failed)\b/i))) push('ability.use_failure_candidate', m[1], { evidenceType:'use_failure' });
      if ((m = w.match(/\b(?:learned|unlocked|mastered|gained)\s+(?:the\s+|a\s+|an\s+)?([^.,;!?]+)/i))) push('ability.output_only_learning_claim', m[1], { evidenceType:'hint', outputOnlyLearning:true, confidence:0.4 });
      if ((m = w.match(/\b(?:teacher|mentor)\s+confirms\s+(?:the\s+|a\s+|an\s+)?([^.,;!?]+?)\s+(?:stabilizes|is stable|becomes stable)\b/i))) push('ability.stabilize_candidate', m[1], { evidenceType:'teacher_confirmation', confidence:0.78 });
      if ((m = w.match(/\b(?:stabilize|stabilized|stabilizes|mastered through training|teacher confirms|controlled demonstration of|source grants)\s+(?:the\s+|a\s+|an\s+)?([^.,;!?]+)/i))) push('ability.stabilize_candidate', m[1], { evidenceType:'teacher_confirmation', confidence:0.72 });
      if ((m = w.match(/\b(?:seal|sealed|locks away|blocks)\s+(?:the\s+|a\s+|an\s+)?([^.,;!?]+)/i))) push('ability.seal_candidate', m[1], { evidenceType:'seal' });
      if ((m = w.match(/\b([^.,;!?]{2,80})\s+(?:is|becomes|remains)\s+(?:unavailable|sealed|forbidden|blocked)\b/i))) push(/sealed/i.test(w) ? 'ability.seal_candidate' : 'ability.unavailable_candidate', m[1], { evidenceType:/sealed/i.test(w) ? 'seal' : 'unavailable_claim' });
      if ((m = w.match(/["“](?:use|cast|train|practice)\s+([^"”]{2,64})["”]/i))) push('ability.hint_candidate', m[1], { evidenceType:'hint', confidence:0.35 });
      // Coalesce exact duplicate ability hits from old/new scanners.
      const seen = {}, out = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < hits.length; i++) { const h = hits[i]; const key = [h.family, h.type, WL.U.slug(h.name || ''), WL.U.hash(h.localClausePreview || '')].join('|'); if (!seen[key]) { seen[key] = true; out.push(h); } }
      return out;
    };

    // ProposalBuilder: preserve PC06 ability event types for input training/use, add keys and data.
    const oldClassifyTypePC06 = WL.ProposalBuilder.classifyProposalType;
    WL.ProposalBuilder.classifyProposalType = function (hit, family) {
      if ((family || (hit && hit.family)) === 'ability' && /^ability\.(?:hint_candidate|train_candidate|use_attempt|use_success_candidate|use_failure_candidate|output_only_learning_claim|learn_candidate|stabilize_candidate|seal_candidate|unavailable_candidate|failed_only_candidate)$/.test(hit && hit.type || '')) return hit.type;
      return oldClassifyTypePC06.call(WL.ProposalBuilder, hit, family);
    };
    const oldSuggestOpPC06 = WL.ProposalBuilder.suggestOperationKey;
    WL.ProposalBuilder.suggestOperationKey = function (ctx, root) {
      const hit = ctx && ctx.hit || {}; const t = hit.eventType || hit.type || ''; const target = ctx && ctx.target || {}; const lc = ctx && ctx.localClause || {}; const source = ctx && ctx.source || {};
      if (/^ability\./.test(t)) {
        const targetKey = target.targetId || target.id || target.canonicalKey || WL.Resolver.canonicalId('ability', target.displayName || target.display || hit.name || 'unknown');
        let prefix = 'ability.evidence'; let durable = false; let repeat = false;
        if (/train/.test(t)) prefix = 'ability.train';
        else if (/use_success/.test(t)) { prefix = 'ability.use.success'; repeat = true; }
        else if (/use_failure|failed/.test(t)) { prefix = 'ability.failure'; repeat = true; }
        else if (/use_attempt/.test(t)) prefix = 'ability.use.attempt';
        else if (/stabilize/.test(t)) { prefix = 'ability.stabilize'; durable = true; repeat = true; }
        else if (/seal/.test(t)) { prefix = 'ability.seal'; durable = true; repeat = true; }
        else if (/unavailable/.test(t)) { prefix = 'ability.unavailable'; durable = true; repeat = true; }
        else if (/hint|output_only/.test(t)) prefix = 'ability.hint';
        return { suggestedKey: WL.OperationLedger.makeKey([prefix, targetKey, source.textHash || '', lc.localClauseHash || '']), keyFamily: durable ? 'permanent' : 'recent', repeatSensitive: repeat, durable: durable, reason:'PC06 ability evidence/status key', requiredBeforeCommit: repeat, notes:[t] };
      }
      return oldSuggestOpPC06.call(WL.ProposalBuilder, ctx, root);
    };
    const oldDataPayloadPC06 = WL.ProposalBuilder.dataPayload;
    WL.ProposalBuilder.dataPayload = function (hit, target, proposedChange, operation) {
      const data = oldDataPayloadPC06.call(WL.ProposalBuilder, hit, target, proposedChange, operation) || {};

        data.sanitizerUsed = 'AbilityNameSanitizer.pc06';
        data.outputOnlyLearning = !!(hit.raw && hit.raw.outputOnlyLearning);
      }
      return data;
    };

    // CanonValidator: ability evidence accepts safe non-mastery events; stable requires explicit stabilize proof.
    const oldValidateAbilityPC06 = WL.CanonValidator.validateAbility;
    WL.CanonValidator.validateAbility = function (p, root, s) {
      const t = p.type || p.eventType || ''; const safety = Object.assign({}, s || this.validateClause(p, root));
      const text = WL.U.norm(p.sourceText || p.localClausePreview || '');
      const target = WL.PC06AbilityDepth.cleanName(p.target && (p.target.display || p.target.displayName || p.target.raw) || '');
      if (!target) return this.reject(p, 'ability target failed PC06 AbilityNameSanitizer', ['PC06 ability name safety']);
      if (/^ability\.intent$/.test(t)) return this.pending(p, 'input ability mention is intent only', ['PC06 input intent']);
      if (/^ability\.output_only_learning_claim$/.test(t)) return this.pending(p, 'output-only learning claim is unsupported; no stable ability', ['PC06 output-only learning blocked']);
      if (/^ability\.hint_candidate$/.test(t)) return this.accept(p, 'ability hint/reference recorded as non-usable hint only', ['PC06 hint only']);
      if (/^ability\.train_candidate$/.test(t)) {
        if (safety.quotedSpeech || safety.dreamOrVision || safety.pretendOrFalse || safety.rumorOrClaim || safety.hypothetical || safety.futureIntent) return this.reject(p, 'unsafe training evidence blocked', ['PC06 training safety']);
        return this.accept(p, 'training accepted as candidate evidence, not mastery', ['PC06 training evidence']);
      }
      if (/^ability\.use_attempt$/.test(t)) {
        if (safety.quotedSpeech || safety.dreamOrVision || safety.pretendOrFalse || safety.rumorOrClaim) return this.reject(p, 'unsafe use attempt blocked', ['PC06 use safety']);
        return this.accept(p, 'ability use attempt evidence accepted, not mastery', ['PC06 use attempt']);
      }
      if (/^ability\.use_success_candidate$/.test(t)) {
        if (safety.quotedSpeech || safety.dreamOrVision || safety.pretendOrFalse || safety.rumorOrClaim || safety.failedOrRevoked || safety.negatedOrRefused || /\b(?:nothing happens|no visible effect|fizzles?|collapses?|fails?)\b/i.test(text)) return this.reject(p, 'unsafe/failed use success blocked', ['PC06 use success safety']);
        return this.accept(p, 'ability use success evidence accepted without auto-stabilizing', ['PC06 success evidence']);
      }
      if (/^ability\.(?:use_failure_candidate|failed_only_candidate)$/.test(t) || /\b(?:nothing happens|no visible effect|fizzles?|collapses?|fails?|no usable technique)\b/i.test(text)) return this.accept(p, 'ability failure evidence accepted; no stable ability', ['soft_fail','PC06 failure evidence']);
      if (/^ability\.stabilize_candidate$/.test(t)) {
        if (safety.quotedSpeech || safety.dreamOrVision || safety.pretendOrFalse || safety.rumorOrClaim || safety.failedOrRevoked || safety.negatedOrRefused) return this.reject(p, 'unsafe stabilization blocked', ['PC06 stabilize safety']);
        if (!/\b(?:stabiliz|mastered through training|teacher confirms|controlled demonstration|source grants|startup ability)\b/i.test(text)) return this.pending(p, 'stabilization requires explicit validated source/training proof', ['PC06 strict stabilization']);
        return this.accept(p, 'explicit stabilization/source proof accepted', ['PC06 stable ability']);
      }
      if (/^ability\.seal_candidate$/.test(t)) return this.accept(p, 'ability seal recorded as non-usable status', ['PC06 sealed']);
      if (/^ability\.unavailable_candidate$/.test(t)) return this.accept(p, 'ability unavailable status recorded', ['PC06 unavailable']);
      if (oldValidateAbilityPC06) return oldValidateAbilityPC06.call(WL.CanonValidator, p, root, s);
      return this.pending(p, 'ability event requires future specific validator: ' + t, ['PC06 ability shell']);
    };
    const oldRepeatPC06 = WL.ProposalBuilder.isRepeatSensitive;
    WL.ProposalBuilder.isRepeatSensitive = function (type, family) { return oldRepeatPC06.call(WL.ProposalBuilder, type, family) || /^ability\.(?:use_success_candidate|use_failure_candidate|stabilize_candidate|seal_candidate|unavailable_candidate)$/.test(type || ''); };

    // AbilityReducer owner: one PC06 owner path for all accepted ability events.
    WL.AbilityReducer.pc06DefensiveLocked = true;

    // Command renderer and router.
    WL.CommandRenderer.abilities = function (root) {
      root = WL.PC06AbilityDepth.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root()); const a = root.abilities;
      function rows(ids, fallback) { ids = Array.isArray(ids) ? ids : []; if (!ids.length) return '- ' + fallback; return ids.slice(0, 12).map(function (id) { const r = a.records[id] || a.candidatesById[id] || a.abilitiesById[id]; if (!r) return ''; const parts = [r.displayName || r.name || id]; if (r.reliability) parts.push(r.reliability); if (r.trainingCount) parts.push('training ' + r.trainingCount); if (r.successCount) parts.push('success ' + r.successCount); if (r.failureCount) parts.push('failure ' + r.failureCount); if (r.status && r.status !== 'stable') parts.push('not stable'); return '- ' + parts.join(' — '); }).filter(Boolean).join('\n') || '- ' + fallback; }
      const warnings = (a.warnings || []).slice(-5).map(function (w) { return '- ' + (w.message || w.reason || String(w)); }).join('\n') || '- none';
      return this.header('Abilities') + [
        'Stable abilities:', rows(a.stable || a.abilityIds, 'None recorded'), '',
        'Unstable abilities:', rows(a.unstable, 'None recorded'), '',
        'Candidate abilities:', rows(a.candidates || a.candidateIds, 'None recorded'), '',
        'Hints / mentions:', rows(a.hints, 'None recorded'), '',
        'Failed or collapsed attempts:', rows(a.failed, 'None recorded'), '',
        'Sealed / unavailable abilities:', rows((a.sealed || []).concat(a.unavailable || []), 'None recorded'), '',
        'Warnings:', warnings,
        'Rule: hints and candidates are not stable usable mastery. Failed attempts are evidence, not unlocks.'
      ].join('\n') + '\n';
    };
    WL.CommandRenderer.pc06check = function (root) {
      const tests = WL.ProductionChunk06.runSelfTests(); const pass = tests.filter(function (t) { return t.ok; }).length;
      const gates = WL.ProductionChunk06.inspect(root || WL.StateManager.root()); const gpass = gates.filter(function (g) { return g.status === 'PASS'; }).length;
      return this.header('PC06 Ability Depth Check') + 'PC06 self-tests: ' + pass + ' / ' + tests.length + ' pass\nPC06 gates: ' + gpass + ' / ' + gates.length + ' pass\n\n' + tests.map(function (t) { return (t.ok ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL') + ': ' + t.id + ' — ' + t.label; }).join('\n') + '\n\nGates:\n' + gates.map(function (g, i) { return g.status + ': PC06-G' + String(i + 1).padStart(2, '0') + ' — ' + g.label; }).join('\n') + '\n';
    };
    if (WL.MVP_ACTIVE_COMMANDS.indexOf('pc06check') < 0) WL.MVP_ACTIVE_COMMANDS = Object.freeze(WL.MVP_ACTIVE_COMMANDS.concat(['pc06check']));
    WL.CommandRouter.activeDispatch = Object.freeze(Object.assign({}, WL.CommandRouter.activeDispatch, { pc06check:'pc06check' }));
    WL.CommandRouter.outputCaps = Object.freeze(Object.assign({}, WL.CommandRouter.outputCaps, { pc06check:9000, abilities:3000 }));

    // Context packet: concise ability truth only.
    if (WL.ContextBuilderLite && typeof WL.ContextBuilderLite.build === 'function') {

    WL.ProductionChunk06 = {
      inspect(root) {
        root = WL.PC06AbilityDepth.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root()); const rows = [];
        function add(ok, label) { rows.push({ status: ok ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL', label: label }); }
        const a = root.abilities;

        add(WL.PC06AbilityDepth.cleanName('Ember Ward to protect allies from heat') === 'Ember Ward' && WL.PC06AbilityDepth.cleanName('Frost Step by moving across slick stones') === 'Frost Step' && WL.PC06AbilityDepth.cleanName('Stoneguard until my stance holds under impact') === 'Stoneguard', 'AbilityNameSanitizer training suffix cleanup works');
        add(!WL.PC06AbilityDepth.cleanName('iron key on the cellar door') && !WL.PC06AbilityDepth.cleanName('old wooden door') && !WL.PC06AbilityDepth.cleanName('smithy'), 'non-ability actions do not sanitize into abilities');
        add(typeof WL.CanonValidator.validateAbility === 'function', 'CanonValidator PC06 ability rules installed');
