        return Object.assign({ id:'defense_result_' + hash(k), attackerKey:data.attackerKey || '', defenderKey:data.defenderKey || '', resultType:data.resultType || 'unknown', method:data.method || '', sourceOperationKey:k, createdTurn:now(root), notes:[] }, data);
      },
      makeDamageRecord(root, data) {
        data = data || {};
        const k = data.key || key(['combat.damage', data.targetKey || 'unknown', data.damageType || 'damage', data.amount || data.severityLabel || 'unknown', data.clauseHash || hash(data.localClauseSummary || '')]);
        return Object.assign({ id:'damage_record_' + hash(k), key:k, targetKey:data.targetKey || '', targetType:data.targetType || 'unknown', amount:Number(data.amount || 0), amountKnown:!!data.amountKnown, damageType:data.damageType || 'physical', severityLabel:data.severityLabel || 'unknown', bodyPart:data.bodyPart || '', injuryKey:data.injuryKey || '', conditionKeys:[], hpDelta:0, sourceOperationKey:data.sourceOperationKey || k, sourceEventId:data.sourceEventId || '', createdTurn:now(root), applied:!!data.applied, warnings:[], notes:[] }, data);
      },
      makeHealingRecord(root, data) {
        data = data || {};
        const k = data.key || key(['combat.healing', data.targetKey || 'unknown', data.healingType || 'healing', data.amount || 'unknown', data.clauseHash || hash(data.localClauseSummary || '')]);
        return Object.assign({ id:'healing_record_' + hash(k), key:k, targetKey:data.targetKey || '', targetType:data.targetType || 'unknown', amount:Number(data.amount || 0), amountKnown:!!data.amountKnown, healingType:data.healingType || 'healing', resourceKey:data.resourceKey || 'hp', conditionKey:data.conditionKey || '', injuryKey:data.injuryKey || '', sourceOperationKey:data.sourceOperationKey || k, sourceEventId:data.sourceEventId || '', createdTurn:now(root), applied:!!data.applied, warnings:[], notes:[] }, data);
      },
      makeCombatDisputeRecord(root, data) {
        data = data || {};
        const k = data.key || key(['combat.dispute', data.disputeType || 'unknown', data.clauseHash || hash((data.inputClaim || '') + '|' + (data.outputClaim || ''))]);
        return Object.assign({ id:'combat_dispute_' + hash(k), key:k, disputeType:data.disputeType || 'unknown', attackerKey:data.attackerKey || '', defenderKey:data.defenderKey || '', inputClaim:data.inputClaim || '', outputClaim:data.outputClaim || '', resolvedResult:data.resolvedResult || 'deferred', confidence:data.confidence || 'medium', sourceOperationKey:data.sourceOperationKey || k, createdTurn:now(root), notes:[] }, data);
      },
      makeCombatOutcomeRecord(root, data) {
        data = data || {};
        const k = data.eventKey || key(['combat.outcome', data.outcomeType || 'unknown', data.attackerKey || 'unknown', data.defenderKey || 'unknown', data.clauseHash || hash(data.localClauseSummary || '')]);
        return Object.assign({ id:'combat_outcome_' + hash(k), eventKey:k, attackerKey:data.attackerKey || '', defenderKey:data.defenderKey || '', outcomeType:data.outcomeType || 'unknown', appliedEffects:[], blockedEffects:[], deferredEffects:[], sourceOperationKey:data.sourceOperationKey || k, createdTurn:now(root), notes:[] }, data);
      },

      isUnsafeCombatSource(text, source) {
        const s = norm(text);
        const src = slug(source || 'output');
        if (!s) return true;
        if (src && ['output','input'].indexOf(src) < 0) return true;
        if (/^\s*\//.test(s)) return true;
        if (/^\s*\[(?:WorldLedger|AIDRPG)\]/i.test(s)) return true;
        if (/\b(?:Story Card|World Info|Context:|Memory:|Debug Last|ReleaseCheck|Card Audit|Context Audit|State Audit|ParserCheck|ValidatorCheck|CommandRouter|Status:)\b/i.test(s)) return true;
        return false;
      },
      flags(text) {
        const s = norm(text), l = lower(s);
        return {
          quoted: s !== WL.U.unquoted(s) || /["“”]/.test(s),
          dream: /\b(?:dream|dreamed|dreamt|nightmare|vision|hallucination|imagined|imaginary|illusion)\b/i.test(s),
          rumor: /\b(?:rumou?r|people say|they say|it is said|supposedly|allegedly|claims?|claimed|legend says)\b/i.test(s),
          threatOnly: /\b(?:threatens?|warns?|promises?)\b.{0,80}\b(?:kill|gut|hurt|stab|cut|burn|destroy)\b/i.test(s) && !/\b(?:hits?|strikes?|cuts?|burns?|wounds?|takes? \d+ damage|blood spills|bleeding)\b/i.test(s),
          metaphor: /\b(?:dead tired|killing time|hit the road|stab of guilt|wounded pride|burning with shame)\b/i.test(s),
          trainingOnly: /\b(?:training|practice|sparring drill|dummy|wooden target)\b/i.test(s) && !/\b(?:real|actual|blood|wound|injury)\b/i.test(s),
          noEffect: /\b(?:no effect|nothing happens|fails?|failed|does not work|doesn't work|stale)\b/i.test(s),
          miss: /\b(?:misses?|sidesteps?|dodges?|ducks under|evades?|whiffs?)\b/i.test(s),
          block: /\b(?:blocks?|parries?|deflects?|turns? (?:the )?blade aside|armor (?:turns|absorbs)|shield blocks?)\b/i.test(s),
          graze: /\b(?:grazes?|scratches?|nicks?|thin line of blood|minor cut)\b/i.test(s),
          hit: /\b(?:hits?|lands?|connects?|strikes?|pierces?|smashes?|cuts?|bites?|burns?|arrow hits)\b/i.test(s),
          damage: /\b(?:takes? \d+ damage|for \d+ damage|loses? \d+ HP|cuts? your|blood spills|bleed(?:s|ing)?|wounds?|injur(?:es|y|ied)|burns?|poisons?|fractures?|breaks?|bites? your|spear cuts|arrow hits)\b/i.test(s),
          healing: /\b(?:heals?|restores? \d+ HP|recovers? \d+ HP|closes? (?:the )?(?:cut|wound)|stops? bleeding|cures?|stabilizes?)\b/i.test(s),
          victory: /\b(?:defeat|defeats|defeated|victory|wins?|slays?|falls defeated|surrenders?)\b/i.test(s),
          death: /\b(?:dies?|dead|killed|heart stops|burns? .* to ash|slain)\b/i.test(s),
          loot: /\b(?:drops?|dropping|loot|corpse holds|falls to the ground)\b/i.test(s)
        };
      },
      amount(text) { const m = norm(text).match(/(?:for|restores?|recover(?:s|ed)?|heal(?:s|ed)?|lose(?:s|d)?|takes?)\s+(\d{1,5})\s*(?:HP|hit points?|damage)?|\b(\d{1,5})\s*(?:HP|hit points?|damage)\b/i); return m ? Number(m[1] || m[2]) : 0; },
      bindTarget(text, preferPlayer) {
        const s = norm(text), l = lower(s);
        if (preferPlayer || /\b(?:you|your|yourself|player)\b/i.test(s)) return { key:'player', type:'player', displayName:'Player', ambiguous:false };
        const named = s.match(/\b(?:the\s+)?(goblin|wolf|bandit|dragon|orc|troll|skeleton|zombie|spider|guard|enemy|attacker|beast)\b/i);
        if (named) return { key:'actor_' + slug(named[1]), type:/enemy|attacker|beast/i.test(named[1]) ? 'generic_enemy' : 'actor', displayName:WL.U.title(named[1]), ambiguous:false };
        const proper = s.match(/\b([A-Z][A-Za-z'’-]{2,30})\b/);
        if (proper && !/^(You|The|A|An|I|Your|Mira|WorldLedger|AIDRPG)$/i.test(proper[1])) return { key:'actor_' + slug(proper[1]), type:'actor', displayName:proper[1], ambiguous:false };
        return { key:'unknown', type:'unknown', displayName:'unknown', ambiguous:true };
      },
      method(text) {
        const l = lower(text);
        if (/\bslash/.test(l)) return 'slash'; if (/\bstab/.test(l)) return 'stab'; if (/\bshoot|arrow|bow/.test(l)) return 'shoot'; if (/\bspell|cast|ember|ward|bolt/.test(l)) return 'ability'; if (/\bpunch/.test(l)) return 'punch'; if (/\bkick/.test(l)) return 'kick'; if (/\bbite/.test(l)) return 'bite'; return 'attack';
      },
      bodyPart(text) { const m = norm(text).match(/\b(arm|leg|side|chest|head|hand|shoulder|ankle|knee|torso|back)\b/i); return m ? m[1].toLowerCase() : ''; },

      recordCombatant(root, target) {
        root = this.ensure(root); target = target || { key:'unknown', type:'unknown', displayName:'unknown' };
        const c = root.combat;
        const snap = this.makeCombatantSnapshot(root, { combatantKey:target.key, combatantType:target.type, displayName:target.displayName, player:target.key === 'player', presenceStatus:target.key === 'player' ? 'present' : 'referenced' });
        const exists = c.combatants.some(function (x) { return x && x.combatantKey === snap.combatantKey; });
        if (!exists) c.combatants.push(snap);
        if (c.sceneState.combatantKeys.indexOf(snap.combatantKey) < 0) c.sceneState.combatantKeys.push(snap.combatantKey);
        cap(c.combatants, 80); cap(c.sceneState.combatantKeys, 40);
        return snap;
      },
      pushEvent(root, rec, bucket) {
        root = this.ensure(root); const c = root.combat;
        const k = rec.key || rec.sourceOperationKey || rec.eventKey || rec.id;
        if (k && c.operationKeys[k]) {
          const dup = Object.assign({}, rec, { resultStatus:'skipped_duplicate', duplicateOf:k, applied:false });
          c.events.push(dup); cap(c.events, 160); return { duplicate:true, record:dup };
        }
        if (k) c.operationKeys[k] = { turn:now(root), type:rec.eventType || rec.outcomeType || bucket || 'combat' };
        if (bucket && Array.isArray(c[bucket])) c[bucket].push(rec);
        c.events.push(rec); cap(c.events, 160); if (bucket) cap(c[bucket], bucket === 'recentAttempts' ? 60 : 100);
        return { duplicate:false, record:rec };
      },
      dispute(root, type, text, resolved, target) {
        root = this.ensure(root); const c = root.combat;
        const d = this.makeCombatDisputeRecord(root, { disputeType:type, outputClaim:norm(text).slice(0, 180), resolvedResult:resolved || 'blocked', defenderKey:target && target.key || '', clauseHash:hash(text) });
        const k = d.key;
        if (!c.operationKeys[k]) { c.operationKeys[k] = { turn:now(root), type:'dispute' }; c.disputes.push(d); c.events.push(this.makeCombatEventRecord(root, { eventType:'dispute_candidate', defenderKey:d.defenderKey, resultStatus:'disputed', disputeKey:d.key, sourceOperationKey:d.key, localClauseSummary:text })); }
        cap(c.disputes, 80); cap(c.events, 160); addDirty(root, 'combat', 'PC12 combat dispute'); addDirty(root, 'context', 'PC12 combat dispute'); return d;
      },

      processInputIntent(root, text) {
        root = this.ensure(root); const s = norm(text); if (!s || this.isUnsafeCombatSource(s, 'input')) return null;
        if (!/\b(?:attack|slash|stab|shoot|strike|punch|kick|bite|swing|cast|fire|throw)\b/i.test(s)) return null;
        const target = this.bindTarget(s, false), method = this.method(s);
        const attempt = this.makeAttackAttemptRecord(root, { attackerKey:'player', defenderKey:target.key, method:method, intentSource:'input', inputHash:hash(s), localClauseSummary:s, status:'intent_only' });
        const res = this.pushEvent(root, this.makeCombatEventRecord(root, { eventType:'attack_attempt', attackerKey:'player', defenderKey:target.key, resultStatus:'intent_only', sourceType:'input', sourceOperationKey:attempt.sourceOperationKey, localClauseSummary:s }), null);
        if (!res.duplicate) { root.combat.recentAttempts.push(attempt); this.recordCombatant(root, { key:'player', type:'player', displayName:'Player' }); this.recordCombatant(root, target); }
        root.combat.active = true; root.combat.sceneState.active = true; root.combat.sceneState.status = 'engaged'; root.combat.sceneState.lastCombatTurn = now(root); if (!root.combat.sceneState.startedTurn) root.combat.sceneState.startedTurn = now(root);
        addDirty(root, 'combat', 'PC12 attack attempt'); addDirty(root, 'context', 'PC12 attack attempt');
        return attempt;
      },

      processOutput(root, text, meta) {
        root = this.ensure(root); const s = norm(text); if (!s || this.isUnsafeCombatSource(s, 'output')) return { processed:false, reason:'unsafe_or_empty' };
        const f = this.flags(s); const before = meta && meta.beforeBody || null; const target = this.bindTarget(s, /\b(?:you|your|yourself)\b/i.test(s));
        if (f.quoted || f.dream || f.rumor || f.metaphor || f.trainingOnly || f.threatOnly) {
          if (f.damage || f.death || f.healing || f.hit) this.dispute(root, f.death ? 'death_claimed_but_unsafe' : (f.healing ? 'unsafe_healing_source' : 'unsafe_combat_claim'), s, 'blocked_noncanon', target);
          if (f.death && target.key === 'player' && !f.dream && !f.quoted && !f.rumor && !f.metaphor) { root.body.deathBoundary = 'unconscious'; pushUnique(root.body.bodyWarnings || (root.body.bodyWarnings = []), 'PC12 death claim protected as pending/unconscious, not confirmed death.', 40); }
          if (f.threatOnly) pushUnique(root.combat.warnings, 'Threat-only combat wording recorded with no damage: ' + s.slice(0, 120), 80);
          return { processed:true, reason:'noncanon_combat_blocked' };
        }
        const c = root.combat; let changed = false;
        const sourceHash = hash(s);
        const attacker = /\bgoblin|wolf|bandit|dragon|enemy|attacker|orc|skeleton|spider\b/i.test(s) && target.key === 'player' ? 'actor_enemy' : 'player';

        if (f.noEffect && /\b(?:heal|potion|restore|recover|stale)\b/i.test(s)) {
          const hkeyFail = key(['combat.healing', target.key || 'player', 'failed', sourceHash]);
          if (!c.healingKeys[hkeyFail]) {
            const recFail = this.makeHealingRecord(root, { key:hkeyFail, targetKey:target.key || 'player', targetType:target.type || 'player', amount:0, amountKnown:false, healingType:'failed', sourceOperationKey:hkeyFail, clauseHash:sourceHash, localClauseSummary:s });
            recFail.applied = false; recFail.notes.push('Healing failure/no-effect blocks healing.');
            c.healingKeys[hkeyFail] = { turn:now(root), targetKey:recFail.targetKey, amount:0, applied:false };
            c.healingRecords.push(recFail);
            c.events.push(this.makeCombatEventRecord(root, { eventType:'healing_failed_candidate', defenderKey:recFail.targetKey, resultStatus:'rejected', healingKey:hkeyFail, sourceOperationKey:hkeyFail, localClauseSummary:s }));
            c.recentOutcomes.push(this.makeCombatOutcomeRecord(root, { eventKey:hkeyFail, defenderKey:recFail.targetKey, outcomeType:'healing_failed', blockedEffects:['healing'], sourceOperationKey:hkeyFail, localClauseSummary:s }));
          }
          addDirty(root, 'combat', 'PC12 healing failed'); addDirty(root, 'context', 'PC12 healing failed');
          return { processed:true, changed:true, outcome:'healing_failed' };
        }

        if ((f.hit || f.damage) && target.ambiguous && !/\b(?:you|your|yourself)\b/i.test(s)) {
          this.dispute(root, 'ambiguous_target', s, 'damage_blocked_until_target_bound', target);
          return { processed:true, reason:'ambiguous_combat_target' };
        }

        if (f.miss || f.block || f.noEffect) {
          const resultType = f.miss ? 'miss' : (f.block ? 'block' : 'no_effect');
          const rkey = key(['combat.result', attacker, target.key, resultType, sourceHash]);
          if (!c.operationKeys[rkey]) {
            const defense = this.makeDefenseResultRecord(root, { attackerKey:attacker, defenderKey:target.key, resultType:resultType, method:this.method(s), sourceOperationKey:rkey, localClauseSummary:s });
            c.operationKeys[rkey] = { turn:now(root), type:'defense_result' };
            c.recentOutcomes.push(this.makeCombatOutcomeRecord(root, { eventKey:rkey, attackerKey:attacker, defenderKey:target.key, outcomeType:resultType, blockedEffects:['damage'], localClauseSummary:s, sourceOperationKey:rkey }));
            c.events.push(this.makeCombatEventRecord(root, { eventType:resultType === 'miss' ? 'miss_confirmed' : (resultType === 'block' ? 'block_confirmed' : 'combat_status_change'), attackerKey:attacker, defenderKey:target.key, resultStatus:'accepted', sourceOperationKey:rkey, localClauseSummary:s, notes:['Damage blocked unless a separate accepted damage clause exists.'] }));
            changed = true;
          }
          if (f.damage || f.hit) this.dispute(root, resultType === 'miss' ? 'input_claimed_hit_output_miss' : 'input_claimed_damage_output_block', s, resultType + '_blocks_damage', target);
          c.active = true; c.sceneState.active = true; c.sceneState.status = 'engaged';
          addDirty(root, 'combat', 'PC12 miss/block/no-effect outcome'); addDirty(root, 'context', 'PC12 miss/block/no-effect outcome');
          return { processed:true, changed:changed, outcome:resultType };
        }

        if (f.graze || (f.hit && !f.damage)) {
          const outType = f.graze ? 'graze' : 'hit_no_damage';
          const rkey = key(['combat.hit', attacker, target.key, outType, sourceHash]);
          if (!c.operationKeys[rkey]) {
            c.operationKeys[rkey] = { turn:now(root), type:outType };
            c.recentOutcomes.push(this.makeCombatOutcomeRecord(root, { eventKey:rkey, attackerKey:attacker, defenderKey:target.key, outcomeType:outType, deferredEffects:f.graze ? [] : ['numeric_damage'], localClauseSummary:s, sourceOperationKey:rkey }));
            c.events.push(this.makeCombatEventRecord(root, { eventType:f.graze ? 'graze_confirmed' : 'hit_confirmed', attackerKey:attacker, defenderKey:target.key, resultStatus:'accepted', sourceOperationKey:rkey, localClauseSummary:s }));
            changed = true;
          }
          c.active = true; c.sceneState.active = true; c.sceneState.status = 'engaged';
        }

        if (f.damage) {
          if (target.ambiguous) {
            this.dispute(root, 'ambiguous_target', s, 'damage_blocked_until_target_bound', target);
            return { processed:true, reason:'ambiguous_damage_target' };
          }
          const amount = this.amount(s) || (f.graze ? 1 : (/\bmassive damage\b/i.test(s) ? 0 : 5));
          const known = !!this.amount(s);
          const bodyPart = this.bodyPart(s);
          const dkey = key(['combat.damage', target.key, known ? amount : (f.graze ? 'graze' : 'injury'), bodyPart || 'body', sourceHash]);
          if (c.damageKeys[dkey]) {
            c.events.push(this.makeCombatEventRecord(root, { eventType:'damage_candidate', defenderKey:target.key, resultStatus:'skipped_duplicate', duplicateOf:dkey, damageKey:dkey, sourceOperationKey:dkey, localClauseSummary:s }));
            return { processed:true, duplicate:true };
          }
          const rec = this.makeDamageRecord(root, { key:dkey, targetKey:target.key, targetType:target.type, amount:amount, amountKnown:known, damageType:/burn/i.test(s) ? 'fire' : (/poison/i.test(s) ? 'poison' : 'physical'), severityLabel:f.graze ? 'minor' : (known ? 'numeric' : 'injury'), bodyPart:bodyPart, injuryKey:bodyPart ? 'injury_' + slug(bodyPart + '_combat') : '', sourceOperationKey:dkey, clauseHash:sourceHash, localClauseSummary:s });
          let applied = false;
          if (target.key === 'player') {
            const b = root.body || {}; const beforeHp = before && typeof before.hp === 'number' ? before.hp : b.hp;
            const oldAlreadyDamaged = typeof beforeHp === 'number' && typeof b.hp === 'number' && b.hp < beforeHp;
            if (known && oldAlreadyDamaged && b.hp !== Math.max(0, beforeHp - amount)) { b.hp = Math.max(0, beforeHp - amount); if (b.hpTrack) b.hpTrack.current = b.hp; applied = true; }
            if (known && !oldAlreadyDamaged && b.hp > 0) { b.hp = Math.max(0, b.hp - amount); if (b.hpTrack) b.hpTrack.current = b.hp; applied = true; }
            if (!known && !oldAlreadyDamaged && !f.graze && b.hp > 0) { b.hp = Math.max(0, b.hp - amount); if (b.hpTrack) b.hpTrack.current = b.hp; applied = true; }
            if ((bodyPart || /bleed|blood/i.test(s)) && arr(b.injuries).join('|').toLowerCase().indexOf(bodyPart || 'combat') < 0) { b.injuries.push((bodyPart ? bodyPart + ' ' : '') + (f.graze ? 'graze' : 'combat wound')); cap(b.injuries, 40); applied = true; }
            if (/bleed|blood/i.test(s) && b.conditions.indexOf('bleeding') < 0) { b.conditions.push('bleeding'); cap(b.conditions, 40); applied = true; }
            if (b.hp === 0 && b.deathBoundary !== 'dead_confirmed') b.deathBoundary = 'death_boundary_pending_or_incapacitated';
            if (WL.PC11StatsResources && typeof WL.PC11StatsResources.recalculateEffectiveStats === 'function') WL.PC11StatsResources.recalculateEffectiveStats(root, 'pc12 combat damage');
            rec.hpDelta = oldAlreadyDamaged ? (b.hp - beforeHp) : (applied ? -amount : 0); rec.applied = oldAlreadyDamaged || applied; rec.notes.push(oldAlreadyDamaged ? 'Body owner/PC11 already applied physical consequence before PC12 record.' : 'Damage routed through body resource/injury owner contract.');
          } else {
            rec.applied = false; rec.notes.push('NPC/actor body depth conservative; damage recorded as combat evidence, not full NPC HP mutation.');
          }
          c.damageKeys[dkey] = { turn:now(root), targetKey:target.key, amount:rec.amount, applied:rec.applied };
          c.damageRecords.push(rec); c.events.push(this.makeCombatEventRecord(root, { eventType:'damage_candidate', attackerKey:attacker, defenderKey:target.key, resultStatus:rec.applied ? 'applied' : 'deferred', damageKey:dkey, sourceOperationKey:dkey, localClauseSummary:s, applied:rec.applied }));
          c.recentOutcomes.push(this.makeCombatOutcomeRecord(root, { eventKey:dkey, attackerKey:attacker, defenderKey:target.key, outcomeType:rec.applied ? 'hit_with_damage' : 'hit_no_damage', appliedEffects:rec.applied ? ['damage_record'] : [], deferredEffects:rec.applied ? [] : ['owner_body_depth'], sourceOperationKey:dkey, localClauseSummary:s }));
          c.active = true; c.sceneState.active = true; c.sceneState.status = 'engaged'; c.sceneState.lastCombatTurn = now(root);
          addDirty(root, 'combat', 'PC12 damage record'); addDirty(root, target.key === 'player' ? 'body_status' : 'social_memory', 'PC12 damage record'); addDirty(root, 'context', 'PC12 damage record');
          changed = true;
        }

        if (f.healing || (f.noEffect && /\b(?:heal|potion|restore|recover)\b/i.test(s))) {
          const fail = f.noEffect && /\b(?:heal|potion|restore|recover|stale)\b/i.test(s);
          const amount = this.amount(s) || 0;
          const hkey = key(['combat.healing', target.key || 'player', fail ? 'failed' : (amount || 'condition'), sourceHash]);
          if (c.healingKeys[hkey]) { c.events.push(this.makeCombatEventRecord(root, { eventType:'healing_candidate', defenderKey:target.key || 'player', resultStatus:'skipped_duplicate', duplicateOf:hkey, healingKey:hkey, sourceOperationKey:hkey, localClauseSummary:s })); return { processed:true, duplicate:true }; }
          const rec = this.makeHealingRecord(root, { key:hkey, targetKey:target.key || 'player', targetType:target.type || 'player', amount:amount, amountKnown:!!amount, healingType:fail ? 'failed' : 'healing', resourceKey:'hp', sourceOperationKey:hkey, clauseHash:sourceHash, localClauseSummary:s });
          if (fail) { rec.applied = false; rec.notes.push('Healing failure/no-effect blocks healing.'); c.events.push(this.makeCombatEventRecord(root, { eventType:'healing_failed_candidate', defenderKey:rec.targetKey, resultStatus:'rejected', healingKey:hkey, sourceOperationKey:hkey, localClauseSummary:s })); }
          else if (rec.targetKey === 'player') {
            const b = root.body || {}; const beforeHp = before && typeof before.hp === 'number' ? before.hp : b.hp; const oldAlreadyHealed = typeof beforeHp === 'number' && typeof b.hp === 'number' && b.hp > beforeHp;
            if (!oldAlreadyHealed && amount > 0) { b.hp = Math.min(b.maxHp || 100, (typeof beforeHp === 'number' && beforeHp > b.hp ? beforeHp : (b.hp || 0)) + amount); if (b.hpTrack) b.hpTrack.current = b.hp; rec.applied = true; }
            if (/closes? (?:the )?(?:cut|wound)|stops? bleeding|cures?/i.test(s)) {
              if (Array.isArray(b.conditions)) b.conditions = b.conditions.filter(function (x) { return !/bleeding|poison/i.test(String(x)); });
              rec.applied = true;
            }
            if (!oldAlreadyHealed && amount > 0 && b.hpTrack && b.hpTrack.current !== b.hp) b.hpTrack.current = b.hp;
            rec.notes.push(oldAlreadyHealed ? 'Body owner/PC11 already applied healing before PC12 record.' : 'Healing routed through body resource/condition owner contract.');
            c.events.push(this.makeCombatEventRecord(root, { eventType:'healing_candidate', defenderKey:rec.targetKey, resultStatus:rec.applied ? 'applied' : 'accepted', healingKey:hkey, sourceOperationKey:hkey, localClauseSummary:s, applied:rec.applied }));
          } else { rec.notes.push('NPC healing recorded conservatively; NPC body owner depth deferred.'); c.events.push(this.makeCombatEventRecord(root, { eventType:'healing_candidate', defenderKey:rec.targetKey, resultStatus:'deferred', healingKey:hkey, sourceOperationKey:hkey, localClauseSummary:s })); }
          c.healingKeys[hkey] = { turn:now(root), targetKey:rec.targetKey, amount:rec.amount, applied:rec.applied };
          c.healingRecords.push(rec); c.recentOutcomes.push(this.makeCombatOutcomeRecord(root, { eventKey:hkey, defenderKey:rec.targetKey, outcomeType:fail ? 'healing_failed' : (rec.applied ? 'healing_applied' : 'healing_failed'), appliedEffects:rec.applied ? ['healing_record'] : [], blockedEffects:fail ? ['healing'] : [], sourceOperationKey:hkey, localClauseSummary:s }));
          addDirty(root, 'combat', 'PC12 healing record'); addDirty(root, rec.targetKey === 'player' ? 'body_status' : 'social_memory', 'PC12 healing record'); addDirty(root, 'context', 'PC12 healing record'); changed = true;
        }

        if (f.death && !/dead tired/i.test(s)) {
          if (target.key === 'player') {
            const b = root.body || {}; if (b.deathBoundary !== 'dead_confirmed') b.deathBoundary = 'unconscious'; pushUnique(b.bodyWarnings || (b.bodyWarnings = []), 'PC12 death claim protected as pending/unconscious, not confirmed death.', 40);
            this.dispute(root, 'death_claimed_but_unsafe', s, 'death_pending_not_auto_confirmed', target);
          } else {
            const dkey = key(['combat.death.pending', target.key, sourceHash]);
            if (!c.deathKeys[dkey]) { c.deathKeys[dkey] = { turn:now(root), targetKey:target.key, status:'pending' }; c.events.push(this.makeCombatEventRecord(root, { eventType:'death_candidate', defenderKey:target.key, resultStatus:'deferred', sourceOperationKey:dkey, localClauseSummary:s, notes:['Actor death pending; quote/rumor/unsafe sources remain blocked.'] })); }
          }
          changed = true;
        }

        if (f.victory) {
          const vkey = key(['combat.victory', 'player', target.key || 'unknown', sourceHash]);
          if (!c.operationKeys[vkey]) { c.operationKeys[vkey] = { turn:now(root), type:'victory' }; c.events.push(this.makeCombatEventRecord(root, { eventType:'victory_candidate', attackerKey:'player', defenderKey:target.key, resultStatus:'accepted', sourceOperationKey:vkey, localClauseSummary:s, notes:['Victory does not create XP or loot by itself.'] })); c.recentOutcomes.push(this.makeCombatOutcomeRecord(root, { eventKey:vkey, attackerKey:'player', defenderKey:target.key, outcomeType:'victory', deferredEffects:['xp_requires_separate_exact_xp_event','loot_requires_inventory_owner_event'], sourceOperationKey:vkey, localClauseSummary:s })); }
          c.active = false; c.sceneState.active = false; c.sceneState.status = 'resolved'; c.sceneState.endedTurn = now(root); changed = true;
        }

        if (changed) { cap(c.events, 160); cap(c.recentOutcomes, 80); cap(c.damageRecords, 100); cap(c.healingRecords, 80); addDirty(root, 'combat', 'PC12 combat output'); addDirty(root, 'context', 'PC12 combat output'); }
        return { processed:changed, changed:changed };
      },

      cleanup(root) {
        root = this.ensure(root); const c = root.combat;
        const before = c.events.length + c.recentAttempts.length + c.recentOutcomes.length;
        cap(c.events, 160); cap(c.recentAttempts, 60); cap(c.recentOutcomes, 80); cap(c.disputes, 80); cap(c.warnings, 80); cap(c.notes, 80);
        c.cleanupLog.push({ turn:now(root), message:'PC12 cleanup compacted low-risk combat logs only; durable keys, applied damage/healing, active injuries, and unresolved disputes preserved.', before:before, after:c.events.length + c.recentAttempts.length + c.recentOutcomes.length }); cap(c.cleanupLog, 80);
        return c;
      },

      combatLines(root) {
        root = this.ensure(root); const c = root.combat;
        const lines = [];
        lines.push('Combat status: ' + (c.sceneState && c.sceneState.status || 'none') + ' / active=' + !!c.active);
        lines.push('Combatants: ' + (c.sceneState && c.sceneState.combatantKeys && c.sceneState.combatantKeys.length ? c.sceneState.combatantKeys.join(', ') : 'none'));
        lines.push('Recent attempts: ' + (c.recentAttempts.length ? c.recentAttempts.slice(-5).map(function (a) { return a.attackerKey + ' -> ' + (a.defenderKey || 'unknown') + ' via ' + a.method + ' [' + a.status + ']'; }).join('; ') : 'none'));
        lines.push('Recent outcomes: ' + (c.recentOutcomes.length ? c.recentOutcomes.slice(-6).map(function (o) { return o.outcomeType + ':' + (o.defenderKey || o.attackerKey || 'unknown'); }).join('; ') : 'none'));
        lines.push('Damage records: ' + (c.damageRecords.length ? c.damageRecords.slice(-5).map(function (d) { return d.targetKey + ' ' + (d.amountKnown ? d.amount : d.severityLabel) + ' ' + d.damageType + ' applied=' + d.applied; }).join('; ') : 'none'));
        lines.push('Healing records: ' + (c.healingRecords.length ? c.healingRecords.slice(-5).map(function (h) { return h.targetKey + ' +' + (h.amountKnown ? h.amount : h.healingType) + ' applied=' + h.applied; }).join('; ') : 'none'));
        lines.push('Disputes: ' + (c.disputes.length ? c.disputes.slice(-5).map(function (d) { return d.disputeType + ' => ' + d.resolvedResult; }).join('; ') : 'none'));
        lines.push('Policy: attempts are not hits; hits are not damage; victory is not XP/loot; death is boundary-protected.');
        return lines;
      },

      inspect(root) {
        root = this.ensure(root || WL.StateManager.root()); const c = root.combat; const rows = [];
        const pass = function (id, label) { rows.push({ id:id, status:'PASS', label:label }); };
        const fail = function (id, label) { rows.push({ id:id, status:'FAIL', label:label }); };
        /^0\.18\.11-rc-assembly-pc12/.test(WL.BUILD_VERSION) ? pass('PC12-G00', 'PC12 build identity active: ' + WL.BUILD_VERSION) : fail('PC12-G00', 'PC12 build identity mismatch: ' + WL.BUILD_VERSION);
        c && c.pc12LockVersion === WL.PRODUCTION_CHUNK_12_LOCK_VERSION ? pass('PC12-G01', 'Combat root/schema lock present') : fail('PC12-G01', 'Combat root/schema lock missing');
        obj(c.sceneState) ? pass('PC12-G02', 'CombatSceneState structure present') : fail('PC12-G02', 'CombatSceneState missing');
        Array.isArray(c.events) && Array.isArray(c.recentAttempts) && Array.isArray(c.recentOutcomes) ? pass('PC12-G03', 'CombatEvent/Attack/Outcome ledgers present') : fail('PC12-G03', 'Combat event ledgers missing');
        Array.isArray(c.damageRecords) && obj(c.damageKeys) ? pass('PC12-G04', 'DamageRecord ledger and durable keys present') : fail('PC12-G04', 'Damage records/keys missing');
        Array.isArray(c.healingRecords) && obj(c.healingKeys) ? pass('PC12-G05', 'HealingRecord ledger and durable keys present') : fail('PC12-G05', 'Healing records/keys missing');
        Array.isArray(c.disputes) ? pass('PC12-G06', 'CombatDisputeRecord ledger present') : fail('PC12-G06', 'Combat disputes missing');
        typeof this.processInputIntent === 'function' && typeof this.processOutput === 'function' ? pass('PC12-G07', 'Input attempts and output outcomes are separated') : fail('PC12-G07', 'Combat processors missing');
        typeof this.dispute === 'function' ? pass('PC12-G08', 'CombatDisputeResolver present') : fail('PC12-G08', 'Dispute resolver missing');
        WL.CommandRouter.disabledFamilies && WL.CommandRouter.disabledFamilies.damage && WL.CommandRouter.disabledFamilies.heal && WL.CommandRouter.disabledFamilies.kill ? pass('PC12-G09', 'Manual damage/heal/kill commands disabled') : fail('PC12-G09', 'Manual combat commands not disabled');
        c.combatXPPolicy && /no_automatic/i.test(c.combatXPPolicy) ? pass('PC12-G10', 'Combat victory no-XP/no-loot policy locked') : fail('PC12-G10', 'Combat reward policy unsafe');
        /deferred/i.test(c.equipmentFormulaStatus) && /deferred/i.test(c.abilityFormulaStatus) ? pass('PC12-G11', 'Equipment/ability advanced combat formulas deferred') : fail('PC12-G11', 'Advanced formula boundary missing');
        /deferred/i.test(c.advancedCombatStatus) ? pass('PC12-G12', 'Advanced combat/party/warfare/absorption systems disabled') : fail('PC12-G12', 'Advanced combat boundary missing');
        WL.MVP_ACTIVE_COMMANDS.indexOf('combat') >= 0 && WL.CommandRenderer && typeof WL.CommandRenderer.combat === 'function' ? pass('PC12-G13', '/combat command registered') : fail('PC12-G13', '/combat command missing');
        WL.MVP_ACTIVE_COMMANDS.indexOf('pc12check') >= 0 && WL.CommandRenderer && typeof WL.CommandRenderer.pc12check === 'function' ? pass('PC12-G14', '/pc12check command registered') : fail('PC12-G14', '/pc12check missing');
        root.body && root.body.deathBoundary !== 'dead_confirmed' ? pass('PC12-G15', 'Death boundary protected by default') : fail('PC12-G15', 'Death boundary unsafe');
        c.damageHealingContractLockVersion === WL.DAMAGE_HEALING_CONTRACT_LOCK_VERSION ? pass('PC12-G16', 'Damage/healing owner-routing contract locked') : fail('PC12-G16', 'Damage/healing owner-routing contract missing');
        c.disputeResolverLockVersion === WL.COMBAT_DISPUTE_RESOLVER_LOCK_VERSION ? pass('PC12-G17', 'Dispute resolver lock registered') : fail('PC12-G17', 'Dispute resolver lock missing');
        obj(c.operationKeys) && obj(c.deathKeys) ? pass('PC12-G18', 'Durable combat/death operation keys present') : fail('PC12-G18', 'Durable combat/death keys missing');
        typeof this.cleanup === 'function' ? pass('PC12-G19', 'Combat cleanup preserves active truth contract') : fail('PC12-G19', 'Combat cleanup missing');
        typeof this.runSelfTests === 'function' ? pass('PC12-G20', 'PC12 player-breaker combat tests registered') : fail('PC12-G20', 'PC12 self-tests missing');
        return rows;
      },

      runSelfTests() {
        const rows = []; const add = function (id, ok, label) { rows.push({ id:id, ok:!!ok, label:label }); };
        const preserve = globalThis.state;
        try {
          let root, before, after, out, n, xp, inv;
          globalThis.state = {}; root = WL.StateManager.root(); WL.onInput('I slash the goblin across the chest.'); root = WL.StateManager.root(); add('PC12-001', root.combat.recentAttempts.length >= 1 && root.body.hp === root.body.maxHp && root.combat.damageRecords.length === 0, 'input attack creates attempt only, no damage');
          globalThis.state = {}; WL.onInput('I stab the goblin.'); WL.onOutput('The goblin sidesteps, and your blade misses.'); root = WL.StateManager.root(); add('PC12-002', root.combat.recentOutcomes.some(function (o) { return o.outcomeType === 'miss'; }) && root.combat.damageRecords.length === 0, 'output miss blocks damage');
          globalThis.state = {}; WL.onOutput('The goblin blocks your sword with its shield.'); root = WL.StateManager.root(); add('PC12-003', root.combat.recentOutcomes.some(function (o) { return o.outcomeType === 'block'; }) && root.combat.damageRecords.length === 0, 'output block blocks damage');
          globalThis.state = {}; WL.onOutput("Your blade grazes the goblin's arm, drawing a thin line of blood."); root = WL.StateManager.root(); add('PC12-004', root.combat.recentOutcomes.some(function (o) { return /graze|hit_with_damage|hit_no_damage/.test(o.outcomeType); }) && (!root.combat.damageRecords[0] || root.combat.damageRecords[0].amount <= 1 || root.combat.damageRecords[0].targetKey !== 'player'), 'graze is minor/not full player damage');
          globalThis.state = {}; WL.onOutput("The goblin's spear cuts your side, and blood spills down your armor."); root = WL.StateManager.root(); add('PC12-005', root.combat.damageRecords.length >= 1 && root.body.injuries.join(' ').match(/side|combat|wound/i) && root.body.hp < root.body.maxHp, 'confirmed player injury routes to body');
          before = root.body.hp; n = root.combat.damageRecords.length; WL.onOutput("The goblin's spear cuts your side, and blood spills down your armor."); root = WL.StateManager.root(); add('PC12-006', root.body.hp === before && root.combat.damageRecords.length === n, 'duplicate injury skipped');
          globalThis.state = {}; WL.onOutput('The arrow hits you for 5 damage.'); root = WL.StateManager.root(); add('PC12-007', root.combat.damageRecords.some(function (d) { return d.amount === 5; }) && root.body.hp === root.body.maxHp - 5, 'numeric HP loss accepted and routed');
          globalThis.state = {}; root = WL.StateManager.root(); before = root.body.hp; WL.onOutput('[AIDRPG] Status: HP -5.'); root = WL.StateManager.root(); add('PC12-008', root.body.hp === before && root.combat.damageRecords.length === 0, 'command-style HP loss is non-canon');

          globalThis.state = {}; root = WL.StateManager.root(); root.body.hp = 20; root.body.hpTrack.current = 20; root.body.injuries.push('side combat wound'); WL.onOutput('The potion closes the cut on your side and restores 5 HP.'); root = WL.StateManager.root(); add('PC12-010', root.combat.healingRecords.some(function (h) { return h.amount === 5; }) && root.body.hp === 25, 'healing success accepted and routed');
          n = root.combat.healingRecords.length; before = root.body.hp; WL.onOutput('The potion closes the cut on your side and restores 5 HP.'); root = WL.StateManager.root(); add('PC12-011', root.body.hp === before && root.combat.healingRecords.length === n, 'duplicate healing skipped');
          globalThis.state = {}; root = WL.StateManager.root(); before = root.body.hp; WL.onOutput('You hold the red healing potion.'); root = WL.StateManager.root(); add('PC12-012', root.body.hp === before && root.combat.healingRecords.length === 0, 'healing from item name alone rejected');
          globalThis.state = {}; root = WL.StateManager.root(); xp = root.player.xp; WL.onOutput('You defeat the goblin.'); root = WL.StateManager.root(); add('PC12-013', root.combat.events.some(function (e) { return e.eventType === 'victory_candidate'; }) && root.player.xp === xp && Object.keys(root.inventory.itemsById).length === 0, 'victory no XP/loot by itself');
          globalThis.state = {}; root = WL.StateManager.root(); WL.onOutput('You defeat the goblin and gain 5 XP.'); root = WL.StateManager.root(); add('PC12-014', root.player.xp === 5 && root.combat.events.some(function (e) { return e.eventType === 'victory_candidate'; }), 'victory plus exact XP routes XP only through progression');
          globalThis.state = {}; WL.onOutput('The goblin falls, dropping a rusty dagger.'); root = WL.StateManager.root(); inv = root.inventory; add('PC12-015', !inv.ownedIds.some(function (id) { return /rusty_dagger/.test(id); }), 'combat loot drop is not automatically owned');
          globalThis.state = {}; root = WL.StateManager.root(); before = root.body.hp; WL.onOutput('The bandit threatens to gut you.'); root = WL.StateManager.root(); add('PC12-016', root.body.hp === before && root.combat.damageRecords.length === 0, 'threat does not damage');
